Founding UI/UX Artist, Unannounced Game
jobs.description:
This is your opportunity to join a small group of obsessed game makers, building an ambitious mobile game focused on collection and social.

As our founding UI & UX Artist you will be the owner of the entire UX structure at a high level, down to the UI art pixels in detail. You will work intimately with engineers, artists, designers from the vision level, down to the hands on implementation. Not settling for industry good, but pioneering new UX paradigms, head turning UI art style and hyper juicy interactions.

We’re looking for someone who is passionate about their craft, making social game experiences, and also a student of behavioral psychology. Someone who plays games seriously, but understands that at least a bit of silliness is needed for success. Someone who thinks about all the edge cases, but knows doing it alone, will always leave blind spots. If you feel you have great ability, a growth mindset, and high ambition, then join us at the start of our journey!

Side quest: Read this new page about making new games at Supercell.

What You'll Be Doing

  • UX flow design for entire game experience

  • Creation and implementation of UI screens, assets and animations

  • Involved in pioneering a modern workflow and optimise assets for performance

  • Discover and manage external partners where needed

What You Have

  • 5+ years of experience shipping UI/UX design for apps/games

  • Portfolio showcasing end-to-end UI/UX work on game projects, with examples of UI and UX flows

  • Proven ability to translate game design requirements into intuitive and visually stunning UI solutions

  • Experience collaborating closely with engineers, game designers and artists

  • Passionate about both UI & UX design

  • Range of 2D Art skills (UI elements, illustrations, animations, etc.)

  • Proficient understanding of Graphic Design and Typography

  • A self-starter approach to use AI: you've found ways to use it in your day-to-day work, you experiment, figure things out and bring the same energy to every new challenge.

Would Be Nice if You Also Have

  • At the forefront with AI tools and actively experimenting

  • Enjoys TCGs

Where You'll Be

This opportunity is based in our London office, and because we value a collaborative work environment and genuine human interactions, it is mostly an office‑based role.

Supercell New Games

This is a dedicated environment for building from zero and shaped around a core belief: the best developers don’t need more direction, they need more freedom and fewer barriers. This is where games get the space they need to become cultural phenomenons.

Players are waiting for your vision and ambition to build the next forever game a.k.a. the best work of your career. We back this up with creative and operational autonomy, and the infrastructure, capital, and experience needed to take a game from an idea to global scale.

This is not for everyone. Building towards a billion-dollar game is going to be hard. But let's not kid ourselves: it should also be fun.

You build the rocket. We bring the launchpad.

Game-changing Financial Model

Supercell is great with stuff around benefits and wellbeing, but most importantly you get to focus on what matters: making games. Skip the Venture Capital pitch decks and looking at runway spreadsheets. In exchange, we're offering a compensation model that makes this opportunity financially life-changing.

About Supercell

Supercell is a games company from Helsinki, Finland, with offices also in San Francisco, Seoul, Shanghai, and London. You might know us as the makers of Hay Day, Clash of Clans, Boom Beach, Clash Royale, and Brawl Stars. Our mission is to create great games that as many people as possible play for years and that are remembered forever.

So, how do we make great games? By putting together the best teams and giving them the freedom and independence to succeed. And by taking risks, failing, sharing learnings, and killing lots of projects.

Relocation? Yes!

No matter where you’re moving from, our dedicated mobility team and partners will support you throughout your move. We’ll ensure the process is as smooth as possible for you and anyone joining you – whether they’re family members of the human or animal kind!

You Probably Should Fill in the Form Below

The bar is high, but if this opportunity excites you, do it! Our team is here to help you succeed. Also, we're happy to learn about any specific accommodations you may need to fully engage in our recruitment process.

Wishing you all the best,
The Supercell Recruitment team

About Alta Ares


Alta Ares is an air defense Neoprime. We build AI-guided interceptors to counter drones and cruise missiles, along with the software platform that powers them.

Our customers are NATO-aligned militaries and defense institutions, and our systems are regularly deployed during live exercises and operational demonstrations across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.

Founded in 2024, we have grown to 90 people, raised over $60M, and increased revenue 40× this year. We are now entering a new phase of international expansion, industrial scaling, fundraising, and product development.

Role & Mission

As a Fixed-Wing Test Pilot, you will operate Alta Ares' fixed-wing drones during development and demos. You will act as the Safety Pilot during experimental flights, ensuring mission success and platform integrity. Over time, you will also contribute to training, documentation, and continuous improvement of operational procedures.

Flight Operations

  • Operate fixed-wing UAVs during development tests and demos

  • Execute manual piloting tasks, including executing non-standard or complex takeoff and landing procedures.

  • Serve as Safety Pilot during avionics hardware and software testing, closely monitoring aircraft behavior and taking manual control when required.

Aircraft Maintenance

  • Ability to troubleshoot propulsion systems, particularly turbines.

  • Familiarity with flight-control systems, tuning, and parameter testing.

  • Hands-on skills in maintenance and repair of UAV platforms.

  • Strong safety mindset and ability to operate under test-flight conditions.

jobs.title: Special Projects Associate (GTM)
jobs.description:
We're unlocking access to the NHS, because healthcare is not truly free until it's truly accessible 💙

The world’s best healthcare, for free. It's not a new idea, it's called the NHS. But the largest healthcare provider is fundamentally broken. Patient satisfaction is at an all time low, and the biggest reason cited is lack of access. So we’re on a mission to fix it with technology that actually works.

We're building the front door of UK healthcare, creating a future where one billion NHS appointments are transparent and instantly bookable, and patients are guided to the right service first time using AI.

We're developing critical national infrastructure. Today, 26% of GP practices in England use our patient registration software, while one in five GP practices in London use Bookable Search to help new patients find and book appointments seamlessly.

Our latest product, Bookable Navigator, extends this vision by automatically booking appointments for existing patients.

We operate from within a working GP practice in East London 🏥 We're backed by Y Combinator, Innovate UK and the NHS Clinical Entrepreneur Programme, and were previously ranked the 8th fastest-growing startup in the UK and 33rd fastest-growing in Europe 🚀

⛩️ Our Principles

Exciting challenges lie ahead. Guided by our principles, we’ll meet these challenges with a thoughtful and caring approach. These principles drive everything we do at Healthtech-1:

  1. 💙 Care deeply

  2. 🏋️‍♀️ Work hard

  3. 🤝 Be your word

  4. 💬 Trust in radical truth and transparency

  5.  🚀 Do your life's best work

  6. 🥳 Find the fun

Read more about our principles and our "why" in the Healthtech-1 Handbook.

🎯 Goal expectations

As our Special Projects Associate (GTM), you’ll be the right-hand to our Growth Lead.

You’ll own GTM tools, systems and special projects delivery. The immediate need is to uplift reporting (revenue and performance) and CRM hygiene. Future special projects may include (but are not limited to) lead generation, sales enablement, enterprise sales support, AE onboarding, etc.

This is an exciting and varied IC role for an analytical operator who wants exposure to strategy and operations in a fast-growing GTM org. We want someone smart, detail-oriented and humble.

🏆 Objectives in your first 90 days

Objective 1: Uplift our systems

You will pick up and own Attio (our CRM) as a source of truth. This means making sure our customer data is current and usable for AEs. It also means making sure we have an accurate way to report and predict our sales pipeline. You will set up Attio well, then build tooling on top of it using AI (e.g. dashboards and maps).

Objective 2: Give the team and leadership clear visibility

You will uplift the way we report to leadership, and within the growth team. You will build and maintain dashboards tracking revenue growth, cycle targets and product adoption. You will work with our Growth Lead on pipeline analysis. In owning this reporting work, you will have exposure to decision-making on growth strategy and performance management.

Objective 3: Enable the growth team to sell more

The Growth team are your customer and you will find ways to solve their problems and make them more effective! You will build and maintain quality lead lists. You will support AEs with operational queries, targets and tooling. You will build automations and workflow improvements that save them time. You will help new growth hires ramp faster.

⚠️ This role is not for everyone

This is a high-ownership, high-expectation role. You'll be working in a fast-moving commercial environment where accuracy, speed, and proactivity all matter at the same time.

You probably won't enjoy this role if you:

  • Prefer to be told what to do over figuring out what to do

  • Treat ops as a support function rather than a growth lever

  • Aren't comfortable getting your hands dirty with data

  • Are content to maintain the status quo rather than improve it

  • Have never built things with AI

You will enjoy this role if you are detail-oriented, want extreme ownership, and thrive on making people around you more effective!

👍 Required experience

  • You have worked in an early-stage startup before (e.g. in GTM, operations or as founder's associate), where you've owned systems, data or process improvement

✅ Must-have traits

  • Proactive problem solver - you don't wait for someone to flag a problem; you find it and fix it end-to-end.

  • Detail oriented - you’re obsessed with the detail and CRM being the source of truth

  • Love data - you can build dashboards, spot trends, and make data useful for decision-making

  • Bias to action - you ship improvements quickly rather than over-planning

  • Team player - low ego, approachable and feedback-oriented; you get a kick from seeing the impact your work has on unlocking the sales team

  • Clear communicator - you keep stakeholders informed without being chased

  • Great with AI - you know how to leverage AI well, whilst thoroughly checking accuracy

😊 The hiring process (4 stages)

  • 👋 Intro chat - with our Talent Partner, to learn more about each other

  • 🤿 CV & work experience deep dive - with our hiring manager, to understand your career journey

  • 💼 An in-office work trial - work with the growth team on a real problem [half day, fully paid]

  • ⛩️ Principles interview - with a Founder, to understand that our values align

  • 🎉 Offer!

💙 A bit about us

💙 We’re all NHS staff. We’re inside-outsiders. Trusted with one of the biggest datasets in the world.

🏥 Our office is within a GP practice. This is our unfair advantage. Got a question? Pop down the corridor. Want to learn how your work affects real patients? Pop downstairs to reception.

💪🏼 4 days in the office and 1 day WFH (for most roles). We highly prioritise in-person communication and prefer candidates who want to work 4+ days a week in the office. Our anchor days are Mon, Tues, Thurs and Fri. Homemade breakfast and lunch are on the house every day when you're in the office, ensuring you're fuelled for success!

🌀 We work in growth cycles. Every 8 weeks we do the same set of activities. 1 week outside of Business-as-Usual to research, strategise, plan our work. 7 weeks to knuckle down and deliver it.

🤝 We’re highly collaborative. One of the benefits of a high trust team is we often work autonomously, but as a team we’re very collaborative by nature. Two heads are often better than one, and we frequently lean on each other to solve problems together.

🤜🏽 We’re backed by industry leaders. We’re on the DigitalHealth.London Accelerator, backed by the NHS Clinical Entrepreneur Program, winners of the London Business School Healthtech Challenge, Innovate UK, and Y Combinator (S23).

🚀 An opportunity for real upside

💉 Paid volunteer days. We offer an additional 2 paid days off per year where you can give back to your mission of choice.

🎢 Every 8 weeks we take a day off to socialise as a team. In the past we’ve hiked box hill, raved at All Points East and spent one rainy day at Thorpe park. This works out as 6 working days a year.

📚 Learning budget of £250 annually and time off to spend it - we care about this; this is flexible and based on need but everyone will receive a yearly allocation towards their continual growth.

🍽️ Homemade breakfast and lunch are on the house when you're in the office, ensuring you're fuelled for success!

🥡 Team takeaways every Monday night

🥗 Health and fitness budget of £60 per month - see more here

🧘‍♂️ An additional 7 days of paid leave is available if you want to take time to learn how to meditate.

💫 Tooling; You’ll have your choice of operating systems and any additional tools you need to do your best work (e.g. keyboard, additional monitors, mouse etc). If you’re on our Engineering teams you’ll receive the latest MacBook Pro and our Growth & Ops teams receives a MacBook Air.

🩺 We know health and family come first which is why we have a generous sick leave policy with additional days that can be taken for mental health leave.

✈️ We prioritise time outside of work to bond, once a year we’ll holiday together! Destination chosen by popular vote. In 2025, we spent 8 days in a surf camp in France!

👎 No private medical insurance, because we believe in the NHS and we are here to improve it!

🐥 Parental leave: Post passing probation it is: statutory - 6 weeks 90% pay then, SMP for 33 weeks; if you've been an employee for a year: 12 weeks 100% pay then, SMP for 27 weeks; and if you have been here for 2 years: 18 weeks 100% pay then, SMP for 21 weeks. This will improve over time. We also include up to £9,000 of childcare contribution for primary caregivers to support a five-day return where possible.

👪 Fertility leave. We understand how difficult a fertility journey can be. This is why we give an extra 5 days off per year if you or your partner are going through fertility treatment.

🐖 Pension - We operate a standard 3% employer contribution and employees auto-contribute 5% of their salary. We use Nest as our provider.

🏡 Local living benefit - A one-off benefit to support living closer to the office: £5,000 if you live within a 30-minute walk, or £2,500 within a 30-minute bike. It is optional, available immediately on signing, and not linked to performance or progression.

🚕 If you choose to work late in the office, you can expense dinner after 7pm and an Uber home after 9pm, or earlier if you feel unsafe travelling in the dark. This is optional and about wellbeing, not performance or expectations.

⛵️And of course, an adventure of a lifetime!

🌈 Inclusive & Diverse by Design

We care about building a product that is loved and a culture that is rich in perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds.

Our team represents more than ten different cultures. We come together every lunch time for a home cooked meal, rotated among team members!

We want everyone in our team to know that they belong. We are purposeful about this and are proactively building a company that is inclusive of all people; from race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, neurodiversity, disability, colour, and national origin - essentially every type of diversity. We don’t just want people who fit in, we want them to fit together. We're active in continually improving the way we make this happen.

jobs.description:
TLDR; Conduct's first revenue operations hire. You will build RevOps from scratch: the systems, planning and data our whole go-to-market team runs on, and make it AI-native from day one.

Why Conduct

The world's largest companies compete by being different, and most of that difference lives in the software they've built for themselves, which decides everything from how parcels reach your door to how food gets onto supermarket shelves. That software is a real advantage, but it's also the hardest part of the business to change safely, so good ideas often wait months or even years for the systems to catch up.

Every large enterprise has a software company hiding inside it, and Conduct is building the operating system for it. We read a company's code and processes, work out what needs to change, and help the business and its systems move forward together, wherever custom software has become too complex to change safely.

Fortune Global 500 companies like DHL and Daimler Truck already trust us with their most critical systems, and we've just raised a $60M Series A from Index Ventures, ICONIQ and SAP.

We're a talent-dense team of about 70, growing fast across London and New York, with people from Palantir, G-Research, Legora and Sequoia. Extreme ownership, high velocity, low-ego collaboration. What you build here will shape the company and how the world's largest companies operate.

About the role

Our go-to-market team is growing fast in London and New York, and over the next year we'll scale it several times over, with new account executives and regional directors joining across both offices. They sell a technical product to CIOs and IT leaders at some of the world's largest companies, in long deals with many stakeholders, often alongside partners like SAP and the major consultancies. To grow at that pace, everyone needs one clear picture of the business and an operating rhythm they trust.

Today there's no RevOps function, so you'll be starting from a blank page. You'll decide how we plan, measure and run go-to-market, then build it yourself: the CRM and the systems around it, the planning cycle, the forecast and the analytics that tell leadership where to focus.

We're an AI company, so we expect RevOps to be AI-native too. Agents should do the work that headcount does elsewhere, so a small team can have an outsized impact. You'll work closely with our founders, sales leaders, partnerships, marketing and finance.

What you'll do

  • Build the function from scratch. Hire and lead a small founding team, and set one set of definitions, KPIs and data standards across sales, marketing, partnerships and deployment strategy, so the whole company works from a single source of truth.

  • Own the GTM tech stack. Implement and run the CRM and the tools around it, with clean data captured at the source rather than fixed after the fact.

  • Put agents to work. Design and ship AI workflows for account research, enrichment, routing, pipeline hygiene and forecast inputs, and decide where a human stays in the loop and how the output is checked before anyone acts on it.

  • Run the planning cycle. Own territory and coverage design, capacity and headcount planning, quota setting and comp plan design for enterprise land-and-expand deals.

  • Run the revenue rhythm. Lead forecast calls, pipeline reviews and QBRs, build a forecast leadership can rely on, and deliver board-ready reporting with the story behind the numbers.

  • Set commercial guardrails. Work with our deal desk on pricing discipline, approvals and contracting workflows for complex enterprise and partner deals.

  • Decide where we play next. Turn win/loss, conversion and customer data into decisions, size the market by vertical and geography, and build the case and the infrastructure for new markets.

What we're looking for

  • A track record of building or scaling RevOps at a high-growth B2B software company, ideally one selling complex, technical products to enterprises. You've owned territory design, quota and comp plans, forecasting and pipeline management, and hired the team to run it.

  • Deep, hands-on CRM expertise (Salesforce or HubSpot at admin level) and experience designing an integrated GTM stack.

  • AI-native. You've put AI agents or LLM-powered workflows into production for a business team, and can show what broke, what you changed and the impact. Your default is to automate.

  • Strong analytical skills, including SQL and BI tools, with experience sizing markets and turning data into go-to-market decisions.

  • Equally strategic and hands-on. You design the system and also build the models, dashboards and workflows yourself.

  • A clear communicator who earns credibility with sales leaders, founders and the board.

  • Experience with long enterprise sales cycles, the SAP ecosystem or systems integrator co-sell motions is a strong plus.

  • An appetite for being in the office every day, close to the team and the work.

Your seniority does not matter. Ambition, craft and the ability to turn ideas into high-quality work quickly do. We sponsor visas from everywhere. We're convinced diverse teams build better products, and we especially encourage people from groups underrepresented in tech to reach out.

jobs.title: LNG Commodity Owner
jobs.description:
We Are Sparta

Sparta is the AI leader for commodity trading, home to Leonidas AI, the first operating system for oil and commodity traders.

Backed by $42 million in Series B funding led by One Peak, with participation from returning investors FirstMark and Singular, the same investors behind AI leaders like Legora, Dataiku, and Synthesia. Most companies are building a chatbot on top of data. We've built an agent with an actual reasoning layer, grounded in years of proprietary market data and in-house trading expertise nobody else has.

We're scaling fast, and it's an exciting time to join. From independents to multinationals, the world's leading commodity teams use Sparta and Leonidas AI to move faster, trade smarter, and stay ahead of the market.

At Sparta, you'll be trusted to take ownership, backed by a team who wants you to succeed. AI is how we build here, not just what we sell. Good ideas move fast, and yours could go from staging to production in a couple of hours, whatever department you're in. You'll be challenged, supported, and given room to grow, building the AI that's changing how commodity trading gets done.

Your work has reach. From shaping Leonidas AI, to powering smarter decisions for traders around the world, to changing how commodity trading is done. And because we're growing fast, you'll accelerate your career with a level of ownership and impact you simply won't get at bigger, slower-moving companies.

LNG Commodity Owner, Sparta Commodities

Singapore, Geneva or London

 

LNG moves on netbacks, shipping and a handful of hubs that rarely agree with each other. Plenty of people write about that. We want the person who builds the system that connects all the pieces of the puzzle, and then puts it in front of traders and makes it sell.

Sparta is building the data platform that energy traders, analysts and commercial teams use to make faster, better decisions. We cover forward curves, price assessments, market intelligence and trade flows across the global energy complex. LNG is our next vertical, and we want an exceptional builder to lead it.

 

The role

 

This is a builder's seat. It isn't just an analyst position, a sales role or a thought-leadership seat. You will be leading the development of Sparta's LNG offering, from the first netback model to the AI analyst that puts together a forward view on LNG markets autonomously, working with our engineering, product, data and commercial teams. You will set the direction and stay hands-on: prototyping, testing and shipping with the team, not handing over a spec and waiting. Building on its own is not enough. The job is to build a product LNG desks will pay for, which means time with clients is as much a part of the role as time in the code.

 

We are looking for someone who knows LNG deeply: JKM, TTF and Henry Hub relationships, netbacks and delivered economics, shipping and regasification costs, cargo arbitrage between basins and contract structures. Your job is to turn that knowledge into products. Expect a good part of your week to be hands-on with AI coding tools: prototyping a pricing model in Python, standing up a data pipeline, creating market-leading knowledge graphs that an AI agent follows and testing its answers against desk judgement. The rest goes on working with engineers to harden, scale and ship what the team builds.

 

The role reports to our Head of Commodities.

 

What you'll do

 

Building products, data pipelines and AI agents (~55% of role)

  • Lead the design and build of Sparta's LNG product set: netbacks, arbitrage routes, delivered price curves and the analytical tools that sit on top of them

  • Build the LNG expert inside Leonidas with our AI engineers: the tools it calls, the domain rules it follows and the knowledge base behind them

  • Build automated products with the team: a daily LNG brief autonomously written by AI analyst, alerts on the curves and spreads that matter, and the quality checks that catch errors before clients see them

  • Build evaluation sets that test the AI against desk judgement, and keep them passing as the product changes

  • Build the data pipelines behind the vertical with data and engineering colleagues: price inputs, freight and regas assumptions, vessel and terminal data, route onboarding and automated data quality checks

  • Ship to production with engineering through our normal process (pull requests, code review, tests, CI), and hold the bar on scale, security and reliability

 

Owning the LNG vertical (~25% of role)

  • Own the LNG vertical end to end: what we build, how well it works and how it performs commercially

  • Set and sequence the LNG roadmap with product and technology, so clients get something useful early and more every few weeks

  • Write the rules: the LNG conventions, definitions and desk judgement that every Sparta product and agent follows

  • Lead the people working on LNG across product, engineering and data: set priorities, unblock them and raise the bar on quality

  • Be the person the business comes to for any LNG decision

 

Building a product clients pay for (~20% of role)

  • Lead discovery conversations and technical demos with LNG trading desks, analysts and commercial teams, and use what they tell you to decide what to build next

  • Work with sales and account management on the first LNG deals and on adding LNG to existing oil and freight accounts: you bring the market credibility and the product, sales runs the commercial process

  • Give sales a clear account of what the product does and why a desk would pay for it, so they can sell it without you in the room

  • Represent Sparta at industry events, conferences and client visits as the LNG expert

 

What we're looking for

 

Required

  • Deep LNG market expertise: strong working knowledge of global LNG pricing (JKM, TTF, Henry Hub and the relationships between them), netbacks and delivered economics, shipping and regasification costs, cargo arbitrage between basins and contract structures

  • A track record of building, not just specifying: tools, models, pipelines or products you built hands-on and that other people rely on

  • Strong Python and SQL, and comfort with the rest of a modern stack: APIs, databases, cloud services and version control

  • Heavy, daily use of AI coding tools to prototype and ship far faster than a traditional build cycle, and the judgement to spot where an LLM gets the market wrong

  • Ownership and drive: you scope the problem, pull in the right people, get it built and shipped, and fix it when it breaks, without waiting for a detailed spec

  • Credible in front of trading desks: able to run a discovery call and a technical demo, and to hear what a client will pay for and what they won't

  • Experience leading or working closely with engineers, and the technical credibility to set direction with them

  • Experience in a commodity-facing role within energy trading, data/analytics, financial services or a closely related field

  • Ability to turn market complexity into rules, tests and code that make an AI agent answer like a good desk analyst

 

Desirable

  • Experience building AI agents or LLM applications: tool calling, prompt design, retrieval and evaluation

  • Experience shipping work to production alongside an engineering team (code review, testing, CI/CD)

  • Familiarity with LNG data sources: price assessments, vessel tracking and shipping data, terminal and regasification data

  • Experience with pricing, data or analytics platforms in the energy space, or with building one from scratch

  • An existing network within the LNG trading community

 

What success looks like

 

In your first six months, you will have:

  • Led the build and launch of the first version of Sparta's LNG offering: netbacks, arbitrage routes and delivered price curves in clients' hands

  • Built, with the AI team, an LNG expert in Leonidas that answers the way a good desk analyst would, with an evaluation set that proves it

  • Launched at least one automated product, such as a daily brief or a set of alerts, that runs every day

  • Written the LNG rules every Sparta product and agent follows

  • Set up, with data and engineering, pipelines that run and check themselves, so the vertical scales without manual work

  • Put the product in front of LNG desks, helped sales land the first LNG clients, and fed what the market told you back into the roadmap

 

Is this you?

 

This role is for you if you'd rather build the tool than write the note about it, you like being hands-on, you make the people around you build faster too, and you measure what you've built by whether a desk will pay for it. It probably isn't for you if the part of the job you enjoy most is publishing your market view, or you'd rather hand over a spec than help build what's in it.

Why Join Sparta?

At Sparta, our culture is built on innovation, collaboration, and high performance. We thrive in a fast-paced environment where initiative is celebrated, challenges are embraced, and impact is rewarded.

• Equity in a high-growth, VC-backed company

• $42M in Series B funding — strong market traction and investment

• Early-stage growth — build your career as we scale

• Market-leading product — we are redefining commodity trading intelligence

• Top-tier tools and technology to support your success

What's the Culture Like at Sparta?

At Sparta, our culture isn't just a set of values on a wall — it's how we work. We embrace a dynamic environment where initiative is celebrated, challenges are met head-on, and innovation thrives. You'll collaborate with people who are passionate about our mission and committed to building outstanding products and outcomes for our customers.

The Sparta Code

Understanding is non-negotiable

Understanding leads to believing. Believing leads to winning.

The 'why' is the difference between compliance and conviction. Before we execute, we ask: why does this matter, who does it serve, what changes if we win? People who understand the mission don't need to be managed.

Ask for forgiveness, not for permission

Most decisions are reversible. Most fears are not.

90% of decisions are reversible. Make them, ship, iterate. Perfection is the enemy of efficiency. Bias for action means moving before you have all the answers, but it isn't recklessness. The rule: tell the rest of us what you did, what changed, what you learned.

Fall in love with the problem

The mission wins. Your idea doesn't have to.

Solutions flatter our ego. They feel like progress. But solutions without problems are opinions, and opinions don't move customers, markets, or teammates. The goal is to find what's true, not to win the room. If your idea gets killed because a better one comes along, that's the system working.

It's your fault. Lucky you.

If it's on you, it's in your control.

True ownership sounds harsh until you feel how liberating it is. If every problem is yours, you stop spending energy on who to blame and start spending it on how to fix it. Effective leaders default to 'it's on me'. Not out of guilt, but out of agency.

Conflict is a gift

Honesty is an expression of care.

Withholding feedback is choosing comfort over growth, yours and your colleague's. Staying silent deprives others of the chance to learn. We challenge openly and with positive intent. Done with care, this builds trust. Done with ego, it destroys it.

jobs.description:
About Tessl

AI is transforming how software is built, and at Tessl, we're building the infrastructure for what comes next.

We're developing a platform that enables engineering teams to build and run AI-powered software factories, where coding agents take on real development work, from picking up engineering tickets to implementing changes and creating pull requests.

By combining structured context, reusable agent skills, automated workflows and evaluations, we're making AI-powered development more reliable, repeatable and scalable, while keeping humans in control. We're tackling some of the biggest challenges in autonomous software development, from code quality and security to helping organisations confidently adopt AI agents at scale.

Founded by Guy Podjarny, previously founder of Snyk, Tessl is a fast-growing Series A startup backed by over $100 million in funding from investors including Index Ventures, Accel, GV and Boldstart.

Joining Tessl means helping define an entirely new category of technology, solving ambitious technical challenges and shaping the future of software development.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re hiring a Demand Generation Manager to build and scale Tessl’s growth engine.

You’ll own pipeline creation across channels — from experimentation to execution. This is a hands-on, data-driven individual contributor role focused on building repeatable, measurable demand in a developer-first market.

You’ll work closely with Product Marketing, Content, and Sales to ensure we’re attracting the right audiences and converting attention into high-quality pipeline.

If you love testing hypotheses, building systems from scratch, and turning signal into scalable growth, this role is for you..

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Pipeline Strategy & Execution

  • Own demand generation strategy across paid, organic, partnerships, and community channels

  • Build and optimise multi-channel campaigns aligned to product launches and GTM priorities

  • Drive MQL → SQL pipeline growth with clear attribution and reporting

Experimentation & Optimisation

  • Run rapid growth experiments across paid media, landing pages, email, and content distribution

  • Manage budget allocation across channels based on performance

  • Improve conversion rates across the funnel

Performance & Analytics

  • Define and track core growth metrics (CAC, CPL, conversion rates, pipeline contribution)

  • Build dashboards and reporting frameworks

  • Use data to continuously refine strategy

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Product Marketing on launch amplification

  • Align with Sales on ICP targeting and pipeline quality

  • Work with Content to maximise distribution and reach

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Must have:

  • 4–8+ years in demand generation or growth marketing (B2B SaaS preferred)

  • Experience owning paid acquisition and multi-channel campaigns

  • Strong analytical skills and comfort with attribution models

  • Demonstrated success building pipeline in early-stage or high-growth environments

  • Bias for action and experimentation mindset

Nice to have:

  • Experience marketing to developers or technical audiences

  • Familiarity with PLG + sales-assisted hybrid funnels

  • Experience with marketing automation and CRM tooling (e.g. HubSpot, Salesforce)

Application Process

  1. Introductory call

  2. Hiring manager interview

  3. Practical growth case discussion

  4. Cross-functional interviews

  5. Final conversation with leadership

Life at Tessl

We want Tessl to be a place where you can do meaningful work, keep learning and enjoy being part of the team. Alongside competitive compensation, we offer benefits designed to support you both inside and outside work.

What we offer

  • Competitive compensation and equity: Market-benchmarked salaries and EMI share options.

  • Time off: 25 days of annual leave, plus UK public holidays, and two paid volunteering days each year.

  • Private healthcare: Vitality medical insurance, including dental, optical and mental health support, with cover included for partners and dependants.

  • Pension: A 5% employer pension matched contribution through Smart Pension.

  • Life assurance: Company-paid life insurance with MetLife providing cover of four times your annual salary.

  • Family Leave: We offer enhanced Maternity, Parental and Adoption Leave from day one to support you and your growing family.

  • Learning and development: We support opportunities to continue developing your skills with a £1,000 per year to spend.

  • Commuting benefits: Financial support for eligible team members commuting from outside Greater London, plus a Cycle to Work scheme.

  • Summer & winter offsites: Twice a year, we bring the whole Tessl team together for a week-long offsite. It's a chance to step away from our usual routines, collaborate on big ideas, build stronger relationships and enjoy shared experiences together. And of course, we have a lot of fun along the way!

Our London HQ

Our office is in the heart of King's Cross, surrounded by London's growing AI and technology community.

We work together in person on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays, giving us time to collaborate, exchange ideas and build relationships. You'll also enjoy catered lunches (Tuesday & Thursday), plenty of office snacks, regular team lunches and socials, plus a pet-friendly workplace.

How we work

Our operating principles shape how we collaborate and make decisions. We move quickly and learn by doing, build on ideas before challenging them, get stuck in wherever we can help, and give people real ownership. We encourage thoughtful debate, curiosity and a willingness to try things that haven't been done before. Read our five operating principles.

We're AI native

AI isn't just what we're building - it's central to how we work every day, across every function. We actively use AI to improve how we work, solve problems and challenge traditional ways of doing things.

You don't need to be an AI expert to thrive at Tessl, but you do need curiosity, an appetite for experimentation and a willingness to embrace new ways of working. We expect everyone to use AI regularly, invest time in learning how to get the most from it and keep experimenting when something doesn't work the first time, rather than defaulting to manual approaches.

We're also big believers in sharing what we learn. We encourage transparency about how we're using AI, what's working, what isn't and how we can help each other improve. Being AI native doesn't mean removing human judgement, it means using AI thoughtfully, while taking ownership of the quality and outcomes of our work.

Everyone is welcome at Tessl

We're committed to building an inclusive environment where people from different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives can thrive.

We particularly welcome applications from people who are underrepresented in technology. If you're excited about the opportunity but don't meet every requirement, we'd still encourage you to apply.

If you need any adjustments or additional support during the recruitment process, please let us know. We're happy to work with you to make the process accessible and comfortable.

Come build with us

We're moving fast, experimenting boldly and figuring things out as we go. There's plenty to build, lots to learn and real opportunities to make your mark.

If you're excited by big ideas, enjoy getting stuck in and want to be part of something from the ground up, we'd love to hear from you!

OVERVIEW OF THE ROLE

Join our engineering team to build real-time AI Native workflows, tooling, and interfaces that will reshape how developers create and maintain software.

This is a product engineering role with a platform twist. Most of your time, you'll do what every Tessl engineer does: design, prototype and ship product features end to end, collaborating closely with product, design and the wider engineering team in a fast-paced, high-autonomy environment. What makes you different is that when the work goes below the application layer, you light up rather than back away: complex networking scenarios such as site-to-site VPN and private connectivity, multi-cloud and multi-region deployments, observability, and the machinery that makes Tessl straightforward to deploy, operate and support wherever it needs to run.

We expect you to be relentlessly AI native about it: instead of triaging alerts at 2 am, you'll build or deploy the agent that does it. Instead of reacting to scaling bottlenecks, you'll create systems that spot them before they happen. Deep expertise is the foundation, because you can't automate what you don't know, but your ambition should be to make agents do the bulk of the operational work, with you supervising and steering.

We're open on level for this role, from mid-level to senior: trajectory and appetite matter more to us than years.

What success looks like: Within your first year, you're shipping product features end to end like any Tessl engineer. When infrastructure work arises, from deployment architecture to networking to observability, you're the one who takes it on and lands it well, with support where you need it. Our deployment and operational practices are stronger because of you, agentic tooling handles a growing share of the toil, and the infrastructure work you touch is compliant by default, keeping our ISO 27001 and SOC 2 journey unblocked.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

No two days will be the same at Tessl! You'll have a high level of autonomy and be empowered to make decisions based on what you believe will help you deliver the most success. Here's an insight into just a few of the things you would be doing:

Product engineering (most of your time)

  • Design and implement new functionality end to end, from initial design and prototypes to fully scoped production implementations, reviewed with the product team

  • Rapidly prototype new capabilities to prove or disprove an idea, then develop a plan for a scalable implementation

  • Pair with designers and other engineers to make the experience intuitive and slick, and integrate third-party services so we can focus our cycles on Tessl's core capabilities

  • Gather requirements from customers and stakeholders, turn ambiguity into agreed plans, and deliver them

Platform & infrastructure

  • Lean into infrastructure work as it arises: our AWS estate (EKS/Kubernetes), infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD with GitHub Actions, and our observability stack (Dash0/OpenTelemetry, Sentry, PostHog)

  • Contribute to the architecture & build of our more complex networking and deployment scenarios, such as private connectivity and multi-region setups

  • Improve developer experience and platform ergonomics so every engineer at Tessl ships faster

  • Partner with our Infosec team so that everything you build is compliant by default, contributing infrastructure controls and evidence towards ISO 27001 and SOC 2

AI-native automation

  • Build or deploy agentic tooling that picks up firing alerts and works through diagnostic steps autonomously, giving a human supervisor a detailed assessment with recommended actions

  • Build agents that keep our estate healthy without human toil: dependency upgrades that test and merge themselves, alerts that arrive pre-diagnosed, runbooks that execute instead of sitting in a wiki

  • Continuously spot repetitive manual work, across product, platform and on-call workflows, and convert it into agent-driven automation

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We're looking for someone who is as excited as we are to be part of a dynamic team that is shaping the future of AI and software development. We're committed to building a diverse team and strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences.

Must-haves

  • Proven experience as a Software Engineer (TypeScript/Node preferred): you care about code modularity, structure and aesthetics, and you're equally comfortable contributing to a mature codebase with strict CI criteria or hacking up a quick prototype to prove an assumption

  • A genuine pull towards platform and infrastructure work, backed by hands-on experience: you've deployed and operated real systems (Kubernetes, cloud environments, infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD), and when the chance came to go deeper, you took it, whether that was owning platform or DevOps work in a previous role or picking up the infrastructure tasks nobody else wanted

  • Solid systems and networking fundamentals: DNS, TLS, VPCs, firewalls; you can reason and debug below the application layer with confidence

  • Demonstrated use of AI coding tools and agents to accelerate your own work, and excitement about experimenting with new AI approaches to transform how engineering is done

  • Comfortable with fast-paced, high-autonomy environments: you turn loose requirements into plans and shipped work without waiting to be told

Nice-to-haves

  • You self-host things for fun: a homelab, your own services, a Kubernetes cluster nobody asked you to run

  • Production AWS/EKS experience, or hands-on work with private connectivity, VPNs, or multi-region architectures

  • Experience producing infrastructure evidence for certifications such as ISO 27001 or SOC 2

  • You've thrived in an early-stage startup before

  • Have a cool project to show us (GitHub links welcome!)

The kind of person you are

  • You're a product engineer first: you measure infrastructure by what it lets the team ship, and you see platform work as making every engineer faster, never a domain to guard

  • You're calm under pressure, including when production is misbehaving and the answer is three layers down the stack

  • You think big about how AI changes the job: the best engineers automate themselves out of the repetitive loop and operate at the scale of a team

  • You're comfortable with ambiguity and rapid change, and you grab a shovel when something needs doing outside your lane

  • You communicate clearly and bring people along: product, security, engineers and customers all need to trust your judgement

Here's an outline of what you can expect during our interview process:

  1. Introductory Call with one of our engineering leaders. A relaxed chat to learn about your background, interests, and career goals. We'll also share more about the role, Tessl's vision, and answer any questions you have.

  2. Take-Home Exercise. You'll receive a practical challenge based on real scenarios you might tackle at Tessl: an opportunity to showcase your approach to problem-solving on your own schedule.

  3. On-site Technical Session. You'll pair with two of our lead engineers to build on your take-home exercise. This session simulates working together on real problems and allows us to explore your technical expertise more deeply.

  4. Culture Conversation with our People Lead. A two-way dialogue about our values, team dynamic, and your motivations. Feel free to ask about life at Tessl, growth opportunities, or anything else you're curious about.

  5. Leadership Discussion with Maurilio (Head of Engineering), and potentially also with Guy (CEO) or Dru (Head of Product). Our final stage focuses on strategic alignment and long-term vision. You'll learn more about Tessl's roadmap and how you could contribute to our mission.

jobs.title: Account Executive, Defence
jobs.description:
Applied Intuition, Inc. is powering the future of physical AI. Founded in 2017 and now valued at $15 billion, the Silicon Valley company is creating the digital infrastructure needed to bring intelligence to every moving machine on the planet. Applied Intuition services the automotive, defense, trucking, construction, mining and agriculture industries in three core areas: tools and infrastructure, operating systems, and autonomy. Eighteen of the top 20 global automakers, as well as the United States military and its allies, trust the company’s solutions to deliver physical intelligence. Applied Intuition is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with offices in Washington, D.C.; San Diego; Ft. Walton Beach, Florida; Ann Arbor, Michigan; London; Stuttgart; Munich; Stockholm; Bangalore; Seoul; and Tokyo. Learn more at applied.co.

We are an in-office company, and our expectation is that full-time employees primarily work from their Applied Intuition office 5 days a week. However, we also recognize the importance of flexibility and trust our employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work, starting the day with morning meetings from home before heading to the office, or leaving earlier when needed to accommodate family commitments. This in-office expectation does not apply to contractor positions

About the role

You will be the commercial lead for our major European partners and our UK Land programmes, and for new partner, prime and Land accounts across the UK and Europe. You will own these relationships, grow live pilots into multi-year programmes and partnerships, and coordinate our Growth, Solutions and Forward Deployed Engineering teams to deliver. You will be based in London and spend regular time with customers across the UK and with our partners in Europe.

At Applied Intuition, you will:

  • Own relationships with our major partners and UK Land customers end to end: engagement cadence, stakeholder map across business units, and a clear account plan

  • Grow live pilots into multi-year programmes and partnerships, shaping follow-on work across our Axion, Acuity and platform products

  • Coordinate internal teams around active pursuits, keep pipeline and account plans current, and align customer and partner priorities with what we can deliver

  • Drive continuity through award and delivery, manage escalations, and find follow-ons, renewals and adjacent programmes

  • Open new partner, prime and Land accounts across the UK and Europe, finding new budget lines, programmes and contacts

  • Shape the scope of technical deals with our Solutions Engineers rather than selling off a price sheet

  • Work within export-control, classification and data-sovereignty constraints in every engagement

We're looking for someone who has:

  • A track record of owning customer or partner relationships and driving deals to award in European defence, as an account executive, BD lead or ex-military acquisition or capability officer

  • Experience managing and growing a strategic partner, prime or OEM relationship, or selling into UK Land programmes

  • A consultative, solution-selling approach and enough technical literacy to be credible with engineers

  • A live network across UK Land and European defence primes and programmes

  • Strong organisational discipline: account plans, meeting notes, follow-up tracking and CRM (Salesforce) hygiene

  • High energy, a natural networking instinct, and comfort with ambiguity and rejection

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent military experience

Travel requirements

  • Regular travel to Europe and to customer sites across the UK.

Security requirements

  • Must have the ability to obtain UK Security Clearance (SC)

Nice to have

  • UK Land domain (British Army, DE&S) or European defence industry experience

  • Experience at a defence-tech start-up, autonomy company or prime

  • Knowledge of UK and European defence acquisition (MOD, DE&S, FMV)

  • Familiarity with structured sales qualification such as MEDDPICC

  • Service in the UK or allied armed forces

Don’t meet every single requirement? If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

jobs.title: Senior Sales Engineer - Focus Enterprise
jobs.description:
The Opportunity

The Senior Field Sales Engineer drives Sophos’ growth by technically engaging with our existing enterprise customer base to broaden our presence in accounts as well as winning customers who have not previously adopted any of our technologies.

This role requires skills and experience in the technical management of existing customers, building a trust relationship focused on driving the business benefits to be gained from the adoption of the Sophos solution set, together with the ability to drive new logo business.

You will have a demonstrably strong background in supporting the sale of security technologies including XDR/MDR, network security, and endpoint solutions.

Alongside strong technical skills around the enterprise security stack, the role requires effective technical storytelling, and commercial appreciation in order to quickly establish trust from first contact.

You will work alongside nominated members of the sales team and members of our reseller partner network to develop the existing client base and drive new-logo opportunities. Key to your success in this role will be your ability to become a trusted business partner for your nominated sellers and other internal Sophos stakeholders e.g. Customer Success Managers, Product Managers, drive compelling technical value propositions into your customers and prospects.

 

What You'll Do

  • Lead technical engagement for existing and net‑new prospects from first conversation through to technical win, focusing on competitive differentiation and value‑led positioning.

  • Rapidly assess a prospect’s environment, risks, and security maturity to recommend impactful solutions that connect with their business objectives

  • Take ownership of those solutions including internal stakeholder management to bring appropriate levels of resource into opportunities and liaise with internal stakeholders such as Customer Success Managers

  • Conduct structured, deep‑dive discovery sessions to identify/clarify customer objectives, technical challenges, risks, and desired business outcomes.

  • Uncover explicit and latent requirements using advanced questioning and active listening techniques.

  • Translate discovery insights into tailored architectures and solution recommendations aligned to customer needs, timelines, and strategic goals.

  • Position technical outcomes in terms of operational efficiency, risk reduction, and total cost of ownership benefits.

  • Deliver high‑impact, outcome‑driven demonstrations that resonate with the customer’s stated priorities.

  • Build and lead PoCs with clear success criteria, technical validation milestones, and structured paths to closure.

  • Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to both technical and non‑technical audiences.

  • Create and deliver engaging presentations that demonstrate Sophos’ value and differentiation.

  • Tailor messaging to senior stakeholders, influencers, and hands‑on practitioners.

  • Represent Sophos at events, webinars, and field activities with confidence and clarity.

  • Establish rapport quickly with new customers and position Sophos as a long‑term strategic partner.

  • Offer unbiased, advisory‑led recommendations grounded in discovery outcomes and market understanding.

  • Work closely with account executives, product specialists, and product teams to shape competitive strategy.

  • Support demand‑generation campaigns and activities focused on new business acquisition.

  • Maintain up‑to‑date knowledge of competitor technologies and articulate Sophos’ differentiators with authority.

  • Provide insights from customer engagements to influence product direction and go‑to‑market strategy.

  • Engage with customers across the UK and Ireland.

  • Travel expected to be approximately 25%–50%.


What You'll Bring

  • Proven technical pre‑sales experience in cybersecurity or a closely related field.

  • Ability to articulate the value of a multi‑product security portfolio across endpoint, MDR/XDR, network, email, identity, and cloud.

  • Exceptional discovery capabilities, including identifying explicit and hidden customer needs.

  • Ability to run structured discovery conversations that uncover business drivers, pain points, risks, and success criteria.

  • Capability to convert discovery findings into solution designs and persuasive technical narratives.

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills across technical and executive audiences.

  • Confident in building and delivering engaging demonstrations, workshops, and technical evaluations.

  • Skilled in simplifying complex concepts and presenting them with clarity, impact, and relevance.

  • Ability to tailor messaging for different stakeholders — from CISOs to analysts and architects.

  • Comfortable building influence, understanding, and trust from scratch within greenfield accounts.

  • Skilled at guiding organisations with no prior Sophos experience through a structured evaluation process.

  • Deep understanding of cybersecurity trends and common customer challenges.

  • Ability to provide balanced, customer‑centric guidance and establish long‑term technical trust.

  • Capable of working independently in the field while collaborating effectively across the sales ecosystem.

  • Able to manage multiple concurrent workstreams — PoCs, demos, meetings — with strong organisation and prioritisation.

Relevant Knowledge Areas

  • MDR / XDR

  • Network Security

  • Endpoint Security / EDR

  • Cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP)

  • Microsoft Security Stack

What does remote mean at Sophos?
Sophos supports flexible ways of working, with many roles offered remotely and others working in a hybrid model. For remote roles, you may work remotely within the location specified in the job posting. Candidates must reside in and be authorized to work in that location. Our teams collaborate across locations and time zones, using technology to stay connected and deliver results.

 

Our Commitment To You

Sophos welcomes applicants with diverse experiences, perspectives, and backgrounds. We believe great ideas come from different ways of thinking, and we are committed to building a workplace where people can contribute, grow, and succeed.

We evaluate all candidates based on job-related skills, qualifications, and experience, and are committed to providing equal employment opportunities consistent with applicable laws and regulations.

If you require a reasonable accommodation during any stage of the recruitment process, please let your recruiter know. Any information shared will be used only to evaluate and provide the requested accommodation.

jobs.title: Head of Growth // AI Music Video Platform
jobs.description:
Neural Frames is a leading AI music video generator, turning any song into a fully produced music video in minutes. We're bootstrapped, profitable, and generating more than $7M in annualized revenue. Our ambition is to build a category-defining company that helps tens of millions of audio creators visualize and promote their work. Our next target is a $15M run rate.

We grew around 3x in the last year with a small team and a founder who ran most of growth himself. We now have specialists across content, creators, design, paid, SEO and growth engineering, and we need the person who leads them: someone who owns the numbers, sets the direction and still does the work.

As our Head of Growth, you'll work directly beside the founder. You'll own new top of funnel traffic, paying customers, and acquisition cost, decide where the team spends its time, approve what goes out, and personally work on whatever is the biggest bottleneck. You'll also build the rest of the marketing team.

Tasks

  • Own our growth numbers: top of funnel traffic, new paying customers, acquisition cost by channel

  • Set quarterly goals, run the weekly growth meeting, and make sure every person on the team owns one number

  • Work hands-on on the biggest bottleneck, from landing page tests and onboarding emails to paid campaigns and creator deals

  • Approve paid creatives and content, and raise the creative and messaging bar across the team

  • Come up with the big messaging ideas, test them across landing pages, ads, social and email, and keep what wins

  • Build AI workflows and automations that make the whole team faster

  • Lead and grow the marketing team, including hiring the next roles

  • Plan and run campaigns such as product launches and seasonal offers together with product

Requirements

  • You have owned growth numbers at a B2C or self-serve product, ideally a consumer subscription or creator tool, and can show what you changed in paying customers, conversion or acquisition cost

  • You are hands-on. You still build campaigns, tests and ads yourself, and you're happy doing it

  • You have deep expertise in at least one of SEO/GEO, performance marketing or social media growth, and a good working knowledge of the others

  • You have a strong eye for creative and messaging, and you know how to improve an ad based on its numbers

  • AI is fully part of how you work. You build your own automations, agents and bots, and can show us some

  • You are analytical and comfortable in tools like PostHog, SQL and ad managers

  • You have built something on your own, whether a company, a side project, music or a sport, and you bring that drive to work

  • You communicate clearly, challenge directly and take ownership without waiting for instructions

  • You are based in Berlin or ready to relocate, and can join us in the office at least four days per week

Bonus points:

  • You have led people before, and you make the people around you better

  • Experience with music, video, creator tools or AI products

  • You have built a growth function from scratch at a small company

  • You make music or video yourself

How we measure success

Within your first month, you understand our product, users and channels, own a weekly growth scorecard with clear baselines, and we have agreed on targets for the quarter. You're already running the first experiments on the biggest bottleneck.

Within 90 days, you run growth and content without the founder in the loop, messaging tests run every month with clear winners, the numbers are moving, and you're hiring the next person on the team.

Within a year, marketing runs as a team with clear owners and goals, new paying customers are growing steadily against our targets, and growth no longer depends on the founder.

Benefits

We are building a vertically integrated, AI-native property operations and financial services business serving landlords and tenants. Letly runs rental homes end to end; Aravis is building the accounts, payments and finance around those relationships.

Our ambition is to make managing money and financing a home radically easier and cheaper. We’re a small, AI-native team in London, building for global scale.

 

The role

You’ll own the user experience of Aravis, turning complex financial tasks into clear, usable journeys. Working directly with the founders, product owners and engineers, you’ll take problems from research through to tested, shipped experiences.

We’re looking for exceptional UX judgement: understanding how people navigate, interpret information, make decisions and recover when something goes wrong.

  • Customer understanding: speak to landlords and tenants, observe how they complete tasks and identify where they struggle.

  • The ability to simplify an experience while preserving the information customers need to make sound decisions.

  • Fluency in Figma, interactive prototyping and design systems, with effective use of AI to explore and test ideas.

  • Strong attention to accessibility, product language and visual clarity.

  • Clear communication and sound judgement when working through commercial, technical and risk constraints with others.

Experience designing financial products or similarly complex customer journeys is useful.

 

How we work

  • Agency: we move fast, own outcomes, and take responsibility for our work end to end.

  • Craft: we go deep on problems and build with care, down to the smallest detail.

  • Intensity: we outwork our competition and continually raise our team’s talent density.

We work together in our London office and expect a high baseline commitment of time, energy and focus. Sustained intensity is an essential part of how we will win.

 

Benefits

Private health insurance, paid gym membership, three meals a day in the office, and Ubers home on late nights.

Compensation: £110K – £140K

CuspAI is the frontier AI company on a mission to solve the breakthrough materials needed to power human progress. While nature took billions of years to perfect molecules, we are harnessing AI to unlock trillion-dollar materials breakthroughs in months, not millennia. Our founding team is the most cited in the world, comprised of world-class researchers in AI, chemistry and engineering.

We are working on some of the hardest and most important challenges including energy, clean water, the future of compute, and carbon capture, and this is just the start of what our 'search engine' for next-generation materials will unlock.

We invite you to be part of a diverse, innovative team at the intersection of AI and materials science, working to create impactful partnerships that drive innovation, scalability, and industry collaboration. This work matters. Your work matters.

We’re on the cusp of the on-demand materials era. Join us.

The Role

Due to rapid growth, we are seeking an experienced Product Marketing Lead to own how the world understands our products and ecosystem. They will work closely with the product teams to frame product positioning, commercial narratives, and GTM strategies across our agentic platform, AI Materials Foundry and new products as they emerge.

Your Impact

In this role you will be building the product marketing function that transforms CuspAI's deep scientific breakthroughs into clear, credible narratives, accelerating our GTM engine and scaling the global impact of our AI Materials Foundry.

Over time, you will scale the function by hiring, coaching, and leading a high-performing product marketing team.

What You Will Do

Platform Launch & Go-to-Market

  • Lead the end-to-end launch of science products, from early-access and design-partner programmes through announcement and general availability.

  • Plan and execute GTM for subsequent releases, new modules, scientific milestones, and strategic ecosystem announcements, building a repeatable launch process.

  • Work with Product, Commercial and Finance on pricing and packaging.

  • Build the product marketing for self-serve adoption, including website product pages, onboarding content and in-product messaging that turn early users into paying customers.

  • Partner with Comms/PR on press and analyst narratives, Partnerships on co-marketing campaigns, and Creative teams on high-impact visual assets.

  • Co-own narrative alignment and onboarding sessions for new Foundry participants.

Product Positioning & Messaging Architecture

  • Own the messaging and naming architecture for new products, the AI Materials Foundry, and emerging product capabilities, working with leadership and Brand as the platform expands through regular releases.

  • Build segment- and persona-level messaging tailored to the experimental scientists who use the platform day to day, the technical buyers who sign off on it (e.g. CTOs and Heads of R&D), and Foundry partners (e.g. industrial customers, compute partners, and research labs).

  • Collaborate with AI Researchers, Product, and Engineering teams to ensure all performance claims are scientifically defensible and reflect current platform capabilities.

  • Own competitive positioning against general-purpose AI science assistants and specialist materials-discovery platforms, and keep competitive intelligence current for Commercial, Product and the Founders.

Foundry & Partner Ecosystem Marketing

  • Define and articulate the Foundry membership proposition, framing how network effects compound scientific discovery over time.

  • Drive co-marketing programs with founding and future partners (e.g. joint case studies, event presence, and co-authored thought leadership).

  • Develop recurring quantitative proof points that demonstrate real-world validation outcomes and accelerated R&D timelines.

Sales Enablement & Customer Intelligence

  • Equip Commercial and Partnerships teams with pitch decks, one-pagers, and demo scripts.

  • Build customer case studies and reference stories in multiple formats.

Must Have Skills & Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in product marketing within deep tech, scientific software, enterprise AI/ML platforms, semiconductors, or advanced industrial sectors.

  • Proven track record of building product positioning, messaging architectures, and GTM frameworks from scratch in high-growth environments.

At LOGEX, we're on a mission to improve healthcare through data-driven insights. Every day, hospitals and healthcare organizations across Europe use our solutions to increase efficiency, improve quality of care, and make better decisions.

As we continue our rapid expansion in the UK market, we're looking for a Senior Business Development Representative who thrives on creating opportunities, building relationships, and generating new business within the healthcare sector.

This is an exciting opportunity to join a fast-growing international health-tech company and play a key role in accelerating our commercial growth in the UK.

What you'll do

As a Senior Business Development Representative, your primary mission is to create qualified sales opportunities for our commercial team.

You will proactively identify, engage, and nurture prospects across NHS Trusts, private healthcare providers, and other healthcare organizations.

Your responsibilities include:

  • Generating high-quality outbound leads through targeted prospecting activities

  • Building and executing strategic outreach campaigns across phone, email, LinkedIn, and other channels

  • Identifying key decision makers and understanding their challenges and priorities

  • Qualifying opportunities and managing the early stages of the sales process

  • Collaborating closely with Account Executives and Marketing to maximize pipeline creation

  • Conducting market research to identify new growth opportunities

  • Maintaining accurate prospect and activity data within our CRM

  • Representing LOGEX professionally in meetings, conferences, and industry events

  • Consistently achieving and exceeding pipeline generation targets


What you'll bring

We're looking for someone who is highly motivated, commercially driven, and passionate about creating opportunities.

You have:

  • 4+ years of experience in Business Development, Sales Development, Lead Generation, or a similar outbound sales role

  • A proven track record of generating pipeline and booking meetings with senior stakeholders

  • Strong prospecting and outreach skills

  • Excellent communication and relationship-building capabilities

  • Experience with modern sales tools such as Salesforce, HubSpot, Sales Navigator, Outreach or similar platforms

  • The ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams

  • A structured and data-driven approach to sales development

  • Fluency in English

Experience within healthcare, SaaS, health technology, data analytics, or consulting environments is considered a strong advantage.

Why LOGEX?

Healthcare faces major challenges. Rising costs, workforce shortages, and increasing demands require smarter decision-making. LOGEX supports healthcare organizations with actionable data and analytics that enable meaningful improvements for patients and providers alike.

When you join LOGEX, you'll become part of an international team of experts who are passionate about making healthcare better.

We offer:

  • A meaningful role with direct impact on healthcare outcomes

  • The opportunity to help drive LOGEX's ambitious growth in the UK market

  • A collaborative, entrepreneurial, and international working environment

  • Competitive salary and bonus structure

  • Flexible and hybrid working arrangements

  • Professional development and career growth opportunities

  • Modern equipment and tools to help you succeed
