jobs.title: Senior Medewerker Finance & Accounting
jobs.description:
Krijg jij energie van een financiële administratie die tot in de puntjes klopt? Heb je ruime ervaring met boekhouding en houd je graag overzicht over financiële processen? Bij Normec Foodcare zoeken we een ervaren Senior Medewerker Finance & Accounting die zelfstandig de financiële administratie beheert, afwijkingen signaleert en bijdraagt aan een correcte maand- en jaarafsluiting.

Jouw rol

Als Boekhoudkundig Medewerker ben je verantwoordelijk voor een correcte en tijdige verwerking van de financiële administratie. Je houdt je bezig met debiteuren, crediteuren, cashmanagement en grootboekcontroles. Daarnaast bereid je de maand- en jaarafsluiting voor en werk je nauw samen met de Financial Controller en andere collega's binnen Finance. Je maakt deel uit van een Finance-team van zeven collega's en rapporteert rechtstreeks aan Patricia Pouw, Finance Manager.

Jouw verantwoordelijkheden zijn verder:

  • Debiteuren- en crediteurenbeheer: Je beheert de openstaande posten, verwerkt ontvangsten en inkoopfacturen en onderhoudt contact met klanten en leveranciers over betalingen en factuurverschillen.

  • Cashmanagement: Je verwerkt bankmutaties, bewaakt de geldstromen en bereidt betalingen voor. Ook ondersteun je bij de liquiditeitsplanning.

  • Voorbereiden van de maand- en jaarafsluiting: Je zorgt dat de administratie volledig en tijdig is bijgewerkt. Je bereidt boekingen, reserveringen en balansspecificaties voor en ondersteunt bij de jaarafsluiting en accountantscontrole.

  • Grootboek en financiële controles: Je controleert grootboekrekeningen en financiële aansluitingen, onderzoekt afwijkingen en bereidt correcties voor.

  • Aanvullende administratie: Je houdt je bezig met intercompany-afstemmingen, vaste activa en de voorbereiding van btw-aangiften.

  • Procesverbetering: Je signaleert knelpunten, doet verbetervoorstellen en helpt de kwaliteit en efficiëntie van de financiële administratie verder te verbeteren.

Daarnaast ben je een inhoudelijk aanspreekpunt voor collega's bij complexere boekhoudkundige vraagstukken en ondersteun je hen met jouw kennis en ervaring.

Ons aanbod

Een afwisselende functie bij Normec Foodcare, met ruimte om zelfstandig te werken, mee te denken en jezelf verder te ontwikkelen. Je komt terecht in een betrokken team waarin samenwerking centraal staat. Wat je verder mag verwachten:

  • Een jaarcontract met uitzicht op een vast dienstverband

  • Een salaris tussen € 4.000 en € 4.500 bruto per maand op basis van een fulltime dienstverband, afhankelijk van jouw ervaring

  • Een dienstverband van bij voorkeur 40 uur per week. Een dienstverband van 32 uur per week is ook bespreekbaar

  • Hybride werken en flexibele werktijden: je kunt je werkdag indelen tussen 07.00 en 19.00 uur

  • 25 vakantiedagen en 8% vakantietoeslag

  • De mogelijkheid om extra vakantiedagen te kopen

  • Een goede pensioenregeling

  • Een reiskostenvergoeding

  • De mogelijkheid om deel te nemen aan het fietsplan

  • Een continu ontwikkelprogramma waarin je wordt gestimuleerd om je talenten verder te ontwikkelen

  • Een collectieve ziektekostenverzekering bij VGZ

  • Een actieve personeelsvereniging die het hele jaar door diverse leuke activiteiten organiseert

Jouw profiel

Je bent een positief kritisch ingestelde en betrokken professional, die graag meedenkt en bouwt aan onze Finance-afdeling.

Daarnaast beschik je over:

  • Mbo+/hbo werk- en denkniveau in een financiële of boekhoudkundige richting

  • Minimaal 3 jaar relevante werkervaring als Boekhouder, Financieel Administratief Medewerker of in een vergelijkbare financiële functie

  • Ruime ervaring met zelfstandig boekhouden, debiteuren- en crediteurenbeheer en het voorbereiden van maandafsluitingen

  • Een goed begrip van grootboekadministratie, balansposten, btw en de samenhang tussen boekingen en financiële rapportages

  • Goede vaardigheden in Excel en ervaring met een ERP-systeem. Kennis van Exact Online of Business Central is een pré

  • Je hebt een goede beheersing van de Engelse taal, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk

  • Een nauwkeurige, gestructureerde en proactieve werkwijze. Je voert niet alleen werkzaamheden uit, maar onderzoekt ook zelfstandig afwijkingen en denkt mee over oplossingen

  • Goede communicatieve vaardigheden en het vermogen om prettig samen te werken met klanten, leveranciers en collega's. Je deelt graag je kennis en ondersteunt anderen waar nodig

  • Je bent bij voorkeur 40 uur per week beschikbaar

Over Normec

Normec Foodlab Ede is onderdeel van Normec, toonaangevend in de Testen, Inspectie, Certificering en Compliance (TICC) industrie. Onze expertise raakt essentiële gebieden zoals water-, lucht- en bodemkwaliteit, brandveiligheid en voedselveiligheid, waarbij we de hoogste normen van kwaliteit en veiligheid garanderen in verschillende sectoren. Normec is opgericht in 2016 en is een ambitieuze, onafhankelijke en snelgroeiende organisatie.

We bieden onze collega’s de kans om actief bij te dragen aan onze missie én tegelijkertijd hun eigen carrière te ontwikkelen binnen een dynamische en snelgroeiende organisatie. Samen werken we aan impactvolle oplossingen voor onze klanten en aan een duurzame toekomst. De cultuur binnen Normec is informeel, open, energiek en ondernemend en is verankerd in onze GROWTH-principes. Middels ons The Normec Fit-programma, waarmee de deze principes tot leven brengen, zorgen we ervoor dat niet alleen ons bedrijf groeit, maar ook iedereen die er deel van uitmaakt.

Interesse? Laten we kennismaken!

Ben je geïnteresseerd in deze vacature? Dan kijken we uit naar jouw sollicitatie! We behandelen jouw gegevens vertrouwelijk en zorgen ervoor dat je binnen vijf werkdagen een reactie van ons ontvangt.  Voor vragen over deze vacature kun je contact opnemen met team Recruitment, via . Zij helpen je graag verder.

De procedure:

  • Eerste telefonische screening en verdere bespreking van de vacature

  • Persoonlijk gesprek bij Normec

  • Referentiecheck (na jouw goedkeuring)/ assessment

  • Tweede gesprek/bespreken arbeidsvoorwaarden bij Normec

  • Gefeliciteerd, je hebt je nieuwe uitdaging gevonden

 Op zoek naar een nieuwe uitdaging binnen de voedingsmiddelenindustrie, maar is deze functie niet helemaal wat je zoekt? Volg Careers at Normec Foodcare op LinkedIn en blijf op de hoogte van al onze vacatures.

Ongevraagde acquisitie door bureaus wordt niet op prijs gesteld en zal niet worden beantwoord.

jobs.title: Group Design Platform Software & AI Architect (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Transform with us the future of energy ⚡

The SGB‑SMIT Group is an international transformer manufacturer with locations in Europe, Asia and America. With reliable transformer technology, the company actively supports the global energy transition in areas such as renewable energy, industry and urban energy infrastructure.

As a key link between power generation, transmission and distribution, SGB‑SMIT Group develops and manufactures power transformers, distribution transformers, cast‑resin transformers and custom solutions for data centers, industrial applications and e‑mobility. These products ensure efficient, stable and secure energy flows worldwide.

With more than 3,800 employees worldwide, the SGB‑SMIT Group stands for quality, innovation and sustainability and offers a stable environment to work on technologies that shape the energy systems of the future.

We combine the strength of an international technology company with an employee-oriented corporate culture:

  • Meaningful work at the heart of the energy transition

  • Short decision-making processes and direct cooperation

  • Stable, growing company with long-term prospects

Your contribution counts – both professionally and personally.

  • Flexible working hours and hybrid working models

Your tasks: 📌

  • Evaluate technical alternatives, dependencies and risks, and document architecture decisions and recommendations transparently.

  • Collaborate with Product Owners, project managers, engineering experts, users and development teams to deliver appropriate technical solutions.

Your profile: 🔎

  • Strong hands-on expertise in C# and the .NET ecosystem, ideally gained in complex engineering, desktop, web or service applications.

  • In-depth knowledge of software architecture, domain-driven design, modular architectures, design patterns, APIs, data architecture and system integration.

  • Practical experience with AI-enabled software, model integration, data pipelines, workflow orchestration, evaluation, monitoring and governance.

  • Good knowledge of DevOps, CI/CD, source control, automated testing, release pipelines and secure software development.

  • Strong analytical, communication, mentoring and stakeholder-management skills, combined with the ability to guide distributed and external development teams.

  • English skills at C1 level or equivalent. Knowledge of German and experience with industrial engineering software, PLM, CAD, SAP, databases or cloud architectures are additional advantages.

jobs.title: Stage: Optimalisatie Processen Industry
jobs.description:
Over Nedlin

Nedlin is een industriële textielverzorger voor Healthcare, Hospitality en Industry, waar veiligheid, kwaliteit, continu verbeteren en verantwoord ondernemen centraal staan. Als groeiend B-Corp familiebedrijf investeren we graag in jong talent en versterken we de verbinding tussen onderwijs en arbeidsmarkt. Daarom bieden we studenten de kans om praktijkervaring op te doen, zich te ontwikkelen en Nedlin te leren kennen, met waar mogelijk mooie doorgroeikansen na het afstuderen.

De stageopdrachten

Tijdens deze stage binnen Nedlin Industry ga je aan de slag met een actueel vraagstuk uit onze dagelijkse operatie. Je onderzoekt waar verbeterkansen liggen, brengt processen en knelpunten in kaart en werkt jouw bevindingen uit tot concrete verbetervoorstellen.

Afhankelijk van jouw interesse kun je kiezen uit één van de volgende stageopdrachten:

  1. Klantcompleetheid verbeteren
    Onderzoek waar en waarom klantorders niet volledig worden geleverd, breng knelpunten binnen productie en expeditie in kaart en werk concrete verbeteringen.

  2. Transportkosten reduceren
    Analyseer transportkosten en routes, onderzoek de beladingsgraad en leverfrequenties en breng mogelijke kostenbesparingen in kaart.

  3. Doorlooptijden magazijn verbeteren
    Breng de magazijnprocessen in kaart, identificeer wachttijden en onnodige handelingen en werk verbeteringen uit om de doorlooptijd te verkorten.

  4. Gebruik van AI binnen de organisatie
    Onderzoek de mogelijkheden voor AI binnen de organisatie, bepaal kansrijke toepassingen voor de dagelijkse operatie en werk deze concreet uit.

  5. Werkinstructies vouwers en inpak verbeteren
    Beoordeel de huidige werkinstructies en onderzoek hoe deze eenvoudiger, duidelijker en visueler kunnen worden gemaakt voor medewerkers.

Wat bieden wij?

  • Stagevergoeding:

    • € 300,- bruto per maand voor mbo-studenten (op basis van 40 uur per week);

    • € 400,- bruto per maand voor hbo-studenten (op basis van 40 uur per week);

  • Een leerzame stage binnen één van de modernste en duurzaamste wasserijen van Europa;

  • Ruimte en begeleiding om te werken aan jouw (afstudeer)opdracht;

  • Persoonlijke begeleiding en korte lijnen;

  • Een familiaire en positieve sfeer: samen feestdagen vieren, een jaarlijkse familiedag en leuke uitjes;

  • Kans op een (bij)baan bij Nedlin na afronding van je stage, bij wederzijdse match.


Wie ben jij?

  • Je volgt een hbo-opleiding of een mbo-4-opleiding en kunt aantoonbaar zelfstandig werken.

  • Je studeert bijvoorbeeld Technische Bedrijfskunde, Operations Management, Kwaliteitsmanagement, Human Factors, Communicatie of een vergelijkbare richting.

  • Je bent analytisch en oplettend, schrijft helder en kunt informatie eenvoudig en visueel overbrengen.

  • Je werkt zorgvuldig en zelfstandig en legt gemakkelijk contact met collega’s op de werkvloer.

  • Je zoekt een onderzoeks- en implementatiestage, waarbij gedeeltelijk meewerken in de praktijk mogelijk is..

Pak het moment

Wil jij tijdens je stage niet alleen werken aan een interessante opdracht, maar vooral ook leren, ervaring opdoen en jezelf ontwikkelen? Bij Nedlin krijg je de ruimte om jouw kennis vanuit je opleiding toe te passen in de praktijk, mee te kijken binnen onze organisatie en samen te werken met ervaren collega’s. Maak van jouw stage een waardevolle stap richting je toekomst. Solliciteer eenvoudig via de solliciteerknop. Heb je eerst nog vragen over de stage of de opdracht? jobs.title: Principal Transformation Consultant
jobs.description:
About Valiantys

Valiantys is a global leader in consulting and services for the Atlassian ecosystem, helping businesses transform their IT operations and business processes. With a focus on driving operational excellence, innovation, and agility, we empower organizations to achieve their goals through tailored solutions for Atlassian tools and adjacent technologies. 
Joining Valiantys means becoming part of a growing company driven by a culture of innovation, collaboration, and respect for individuals, where every contribution helps shape the digital future of businesses.

 

 

Job summary

As a Principal Transformation Consultant, you will be responsible for managing key client relationships, ensuring the successful delivery of consulting engagements, and driving business growth. You will act as a strategic partner to senior client stakeholders, helping them navigate complex transformation initiatives, including large-scale cloud migrations and technology modernisation programmes, while expanding the firm’s footprint within the accounts you manage.

A core aspect of the role is consultative-led selling: identifying client needs through deep discovery, shaping compelling value propositions, and converting those into tangible engagements. You will blend strategic advisory with commercial acumen, playing a leading role in both winning and delivering transformation work. You will report to the Transformation Consulting Director

Things you will be working on

Client partnership & engagement delivery

  • Serve as the senior point of contact for client stakeholders across transformation initiatives, building trusted advisor relationships at C-level and programme director level.
  • Understand clients’ business goals, technology landscape, and transformation drivers, aligning solutions based on the Atlassian stack and related technologies.
  • Lead and support delivery teams to ensure smooth execution, quality outcomes, and client satisfaction across complex, multi-workstream programmes.
  • Contribute to the coordination and success of transformation projects—including cloud migrations, platform consolidation, and enterprise toolchain modernisation—focusing on measurable business value.

    • Technology & Transformation

  • Bring experience of enterprise technology environments, with a strong understanding of cloud platforms, migration methodologies, and the technical and organisational challenges of moving from on-premise to cloud at scale.
  • Guide clients through migration readiness assessments, architecture considerations, and transition planning for digital platforms.
  • Stay current with evolving Atlassian capabilities, cloud-native tooling, and wider enterprise technology trends to ensure our advisory is credible, differentiated, and forward-looking.
  • Bridge the gap between technical delivery teams and business stakeholders, translating complex technology decisions into clear strategic narratives.
  • Knowledge of AI solutions and use cases.

    • Consultative-Led Selling & Business Development

  • Lead consultative selling efforts: conduct structured discovery with clients, identify pain points and opportunities, and shape proposals that connect directly to business outcomes.
  • Own and drive account growth strategies for assigned accounts, identifying upsell, cross-sell, and expansion opportunities through ongoing client engagement.
  • Collaborate closely with the sales team using MEDDPICC-aligned qualification to progress opportunities from identification through to close.
  • Develop compelling Statements of Work, business cases, and go-to-market assets that position Valiantys’s transformation capabilities clearly and credibly.
  • Support strategic planning and proposal efforts, contributing commercial and technical insight to pricing, scoping, and risk assessment.

    • Solution Design & Value Creation

  • Co-develop transformation offerings in collaboration with internal practices (e.g. AI, Cloud, ITSM, Agile at Scale).
  • Translate business and IT requirements into clear value propositions, project scopes, and transformation roadmaps.
  • Contribute to building reusable approaches, templates, and frameworks (e.g. for ITSM transformation, AI, cloud migration, PPPM maturity) that codify Valiantys’s methodology.

    • Team Collaboration & Knowledge Sharing

  • Act as a mentor and sparring partner for consultants at all levels, contributing to knowledge growth, capability development, and team performance.
  • Share market intelligence, client insights, and delivery learnings internally to enhance offering development and delivery practices.
  • Champion a culture of continuous improvement, professional rigour, and client-centricity across the UKI consulting team.

    • Do you have what it takes to be a Transformation Principal?

    Essential Experience & Skills

  • A minimum of 10 years’ experience in consulting, professional services, or transformation delivery roles, with significant exposure to business and IT transformation programmes.
  • Proven experience leading or playing a senior role in enterprise cloud migration or technology modernisation initiatives.
  • Demonstrable track record in consultative selling, shaping opportunities through discovery, building client business cases, and converting advisory engagements into revenue.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise technology landscapes, including cloud platforms (Atlassian Cloud, AWS), DevOps toolchains, and ITSM/PPPM disciplines.
  • Proven ability to build and sustain trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders (Director, VP, C-level) and to influence decision-making at that level.
  • Experience managing and growing client accounts with a clear contribution to revenue targets.
  • Excellent communication, facilitation, and presentation skills, comfortable leading workshops, steering committees, and executive briefings.
  • Adaptable and proactive, thriving in dynamic environments where you balance strategic thinking with hands-on problem solving.

    • Desirable

  • Experience working within or alongside the Atlassian ecosystem (Jira, Confluence, Jira Service Management) or comparable enterprise platforms.
  • Familiarity with MEDDPICC or similar structured sales qualification methodologies.
  • Experience with Agile at Scale frameworks (SAFe, LeSS, or bespoke) and their application in large enterprise settings.
  • Exposure to managed services or Total Care-style ongoing client engagements.
  • Relevant certifications (e.g., Atlassian, ITIL, PMP, SAFe, cloud platform certifications).
  • Ability to shape Valiantys AI Strategy based on actual Customer Outcomes and Use Cases.
    • Location & Working Arrangements

    This role is based in the United Kingdom. We are opened to remote working across the UK with regular travel to client sites and the London office as required.

    Some travel within the wider EMEA region may be expected.


    Why Join Valiantys?
    Join a fast-growing, innovation-driven organization where transformation is at the heart of everything we do. As part of our team, you’ll help shape the future of Developer Experience transformation by working with global enterprises to optimize software delivery. You'll collaborate closely with top-tier experts in IT consulting, business transformation, and DevEx, all within a dynamic and entrepreneurial environment that values impact, creativity, and continuous improvement.

jobs.title: Quality Assurance Engineer
jobs.description:
Help Us Build The Future of Travel

At Airalo, we're making it easier for people to stay connected wherever they travel. As the world's first eSIM store, we help millions of travelers access affordable mobile data in 200+ countries and regions around the world.

Today, we're a team of 400+ people across 60+ countries, building a product used by travelers every day. We've grown quickly, but we've worked hard to keep what matters: trust, ownership, and the freedom for people to do great work without unnecessary layers or bureaucracy.

We're fully remote by design, genuinely global, and united by a shared mission to make travel simpler for everyone.

Your Next Destination

  • Location: Remote.
  • Contract: Full-time, permanent.
  • Benefits: Learn more about our benefits here in this link - https://airalo-public.notion.site/Benefits-25396a97ffca81fb9bc1f0be479f1be3?pvs=74 
  • Languages: English is our main working language day to day, so you'll need to be comfortable communicating in it both in meetings and async.

 


What you'll do
  • Design and maintain IREG-based test campaigns for roaming partners, network changes and service launches across Data, Voice and SMS.
  • Manage the test SIM and eSIM fleet, remote test probes, campaign configuration, scheduling, execution, reporting and coverage history.
  • Build repeatable test pipelines, integrate smoke and regression suites into CI/CD, and provide clear release gates; so that core network changes and Steering of Roaming adjustments never quietly break the existing footprint.
  • Define the KPIs, baselines and thresholds that tell us the service is healthy. Correlate synthetic test results with production KPIs and real customer journeys, and turn what you find into alerts and runbooks the Operations team can act on.
  • Design and run the tests that show our geo-redundancy behaves as designed, i.e. site failover and failback, Diameter and GTP path recovery, session survival, data consistency after a switch; and verify that our core platforms deliver the capacity they were dimensioned for, under sustained load and under signalling bursts.
  • Analyse PCAP, MAP/SS7, Diameter, GTP and DNS traces alongside monitoring data to isolate failures, support root cause analysis, validate fixes and strengthen regression coverage.

    • What you'll bring
  • You've worked in telecom QA, network testing, service assurance or roaming validation.
  • You know how LTE/EPC fits together. Give you a registration or session flow and you'll find where it broke.
  • Wireshark is where you go first, not last.
  • You write your own automation in Python or something close, and you keep regression suites running in CI/CD.

    • Nice to have
  • Experience at a roaming hub, IPX provider, mobile operator or MVNO, including partner interoperability testing.
  • Hands-on SIM box or remote testing probe management.
  • Exposure to 5G roaming and VoLTE roaming, including S8HR and SMS over IP.
  • Familiarity with HSS/HLR, PCRF and OCS functions, and how they show up in roaming failures.
  • Working knowledge of GSMA roaming procedures and documents, including IR.21, IR.24, IR.35, IR.38 and IR.92.      

    • Why People Join Us

    We started Airalo to make staying connected effortless, wherever you are in the world. Today, millions of travelers rely on our eSIMs, and many of the people building the product were customers first.

    Our team spans 60+ countries, united by a shared belief that great work happens when people are trusted to own what they do. There's trust to own what you do, space to focus without constant layers of process, and a clear sense of what you're responsible for from day one.

    As Airalo continues to grow, so do the opportunities to learn, take on new challenges, and make a real impact - from anywhere in the world.

    Before You Hit Apply

    By applying, you acknowledge and agree that, in case of successful application, Airalo may request to run background checks as a condition for entering into an agreement with you. Rest assured that these checks will only occur upon your prior consent and at the end of the selection process, and will be strictly limited to what is allowed under the laws that are applicable to you. All data that you share or that we collect in connection with such checks will be processed in accordance with our Privacy Policy, available here: www.airalo.com/more-info/privacy-policy?srsltid=AfmBOooBT0rXAj1FaNelZ3VfN0wvhwzvAoxdtHnOKSVETpiSjiXVuycy

jobs.title: Experienced / Senior Fullstack Engineer (Productivity)
jobs.description:
Notre mission ⚖️

Chez Doctrine, nous construisons le leader de l’IA juridique en Europe.

Notre conviction ? Le droit ne doit pas être ralenti par des tâches répétitives. Il doit être augmenté par une IA spécialisée, conçue pour comprendre, analyser et produire du raisonnement juridique avec un haut niveau d’exigence.

Notre ambition ? Permettre aux professionnels du droit de gagner en fiabilité, en efficacité et en sérénité, grâce à une plateforme unique, exhaustive et sécurisée.

Aujourd’hui, 27 000 professionnels du droit, répartis dans cinq pays (France, Italie, Allemagne, Espagne, Luxembourg), nous font confiance.

Notre développement est guidé par une approche claire : une vision globale, ancrée dans une compréhension fine des spécificités locales.

Derrière cette ambition, une équipe d’environ 250 personnes, réunies autour d’un même objectif : accompagner les juristes et avocats à toutes les étapes de leur travail, de l’analyse à la rédaction.

Et nous n’en sommes qu’au début.


Le contexte
 
La squad Productivity est au cœur de la transformation produit autour de la gestion des affaires contentieuses de bout en bout.
Le scope de la squad s'est considérablement enrichi, au-delà du seul gain de productivité, en allant vers l'accompagnement de la réflexion et de l'argumentation juridique, à travers plusieurs langues.
 
Aujourd’hui, elle est responsable de toute la chaîne de valeur :
1. Analyse de documents
2. Rédaction automatisée des conclusions et documents juridiques
3. Réflexion stratégique sur l’argumentation
 
C’est le cœur de notre IA appliquée au raisonnement juridique : travail avancé sur les modèles LLM, le machine learning et la structuration de documents complexes.1.
 
Tu peux trouver des détails sur l’ensemble de la stack sur Github !
 
A savoir : il n’est pas nécessaire d’avoir une expérience professionnelle dans le domaine du droit, cependant l’envie de s’investir et de monter en compétence dans la compréhension des documents juridique est importante :)

Les missions 🛠
  • Concevoir et développer des features produit de bout en bout — de la modélisation back-end à l'interface utilisateur, en ownership complet sur tes sujets.
  • Intégrer des modèles d'IA et LLM dans les flux produit — pour enrichir l'expérience des avocats et juristes qui utilisent Doctrine au quotidien.
  • Maintenir et faire évoluer notre architecture cloud — stack moderne, scalabilité, fiabilité des services en production.
  • Participer activement aux choix techniques de ta squad — revues de code, décisions d'architecture, amélioration continue de la qualité du code.
  • Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes Produit et Design — pour transformer des problèmes métier complexes en solutions techniques concrètes et utiles.
  • Contribuer à la roadmap technique transverse — outillage, dette technique, documentation, et montée en compétences collective.

    • Le profil idéal 👀
  • Tu maîtrises TypeScript/JavaScript côté back et front, et tu es à l'aise sur une stack moderne en production (Node.js, React ou équivalent).
  • Tu as une vraie culture backend — modélisation de données, APIs robustes, performance, gestion de la dette technique. Le front ne te fait pas peur, mais c'est le back qui te définit.
  • Tu es autonome et orienté ownership — tu prends un sujet, tu le cadres, tu le livres. Tu n'attends pas qu'on te dise quoi faire.
  • Tu travailles bien avec le Produit — tu comprends le besoin utilisateur, tu sais challenger un spec, et tu penses impact avant technologie.
  • Tu as une appétence pour l'IA — tu n'es pas forcément expert LLM, mais tu t'y intéresses activement et tu vois comment ça transforme les produits.
  • Tu aimes partager et faire grandir les autres — revues de code constructives, documentation, pair programming. Tu laisses la codebase meilleure qu'à ton arrivée.

    • Les à côtés du poste 👁
  • Comme tous les ingénieurs de Doctrine, tu participeras à un de nos chapters transverse, en l’espèce le chapter Web. Au sein de ce chapter, tu contribueras à des projets internes pour améliorer nos process et notre vision long-terme. Le chapter se réunit toutes les semaines pour :
  • 🤝 Partager des connaissances : suivit de l’état de l’art, revue de papiers scientifiques, amélioration continue, bonnes pratiques,…
  • 🎯 Proposer des évolutions : nouveaux outils à expérimenter, nouveaux process à mettre en œuvre
    •  
  • Tu participeras également au 👩‍💻 recrutement : tous les contributeurs individuels rencontrent des candidats à l’occasion de tests techniques ou d’entretiens.

    • Ce qui t'attend si tu rejoins Doctrine 🤝

    • Contribuer à un projet ambitieux, avec un impact réel et positif sur la société : rendre le droit plus accessible et plus ouvert.
    • Un onboarding très complet permettant une intégration et une montée en compétence rapides.
    • Une aventure dans laquelle la formation et le partage des connaissances font partis du quotidien.
    • Rejoindre une entreprise avec une vie d’équipe riche et dynamique : conférences, team-buildings, déjeuner, offsite, afterwork, etc.

    Nos valeurs 🤝

    Chez Doctrine, nos 4 valeurs nous accompagnent au quotidien et dans notre ambition de faire bouger les choses.

    • Challenge the status quo : nous défendons les idées audacieuses qui contribuent à l’évolution de tout un secteur.
    • Liberty and responsibility : nous encourageons l’autonomie, l’impact de chacun·e et l’ownership.
    • Knowledge is power : l'information est au cœur de la mission de Doctrine, et nous cherchons constamment à progresser.
    • Release early, release often and listen to your customers : nous croyons au pouvoir de l’itération et à l’importance d’écouter en permanence notre marché, nos client·e·s et leurs problématiques.
     

    Nos avantages pour faire la différence ☀️

    🏡 Une politique de télétravail flexible permettant - selon les équipes - jusqu’à trois jours de télétravail par semaine.

    🌴 Une politique de congés flexibles

    🌱 Des opportunités concrètes de mobilité interne

    🏄‍♂️ Des évènements collectifs réguliers

    📚 Un vrai accent sur la formation individuelle et collective, avec un budget annuel de 750€ pour toute formation en lien avec ton poste - et des formations en équipe ou pour toute l'entreprise

    🏋️‍♀️ Un abonnement Gymlib pour les activités sportives et bien-être

    🧘 Un accès gratuit à la plateforme d'accompagnement à la santé mentale Moka.care et un accompagnement individuel allant jusqu’à 6 séances par an

    👩‍⚕️ Une assurance santé avec Alan

    🍱 🚲 Une carte Swile pour tes tickets restaurants et ton forfait mobilité durable (66,60 euros par mois)

    💡 Des réductions et avantages négociés grâce à notre CSE via la plateforme Happypal

    🍏 Un équipement de travail neuf chez Apple

     

    Notre processus de recrutement 🚀

    • Un premier échange de 30 min avec l’un.e de nos Talent Acquisition Manager pour bien comprendre ton projet professionnel et te présenter ce qu'on construit chez Doctrine
    • Une rencontre d’1h avec ton/ta futur.e manager, pour détailler le poste et le scope de l’équipe, mais aussi répondre à toutes tes questions.
    • Un ou deux tests techniques pour évaluer concrètement tes compétences
    • Une venue dans nos bureaux pour : un déjeuner avec 3 personnes de différents départements chez Doctrine, pour te donner un aperçu de tes futur.e.s collègues ; un échange sur les valeurs de l’entreprise pour te partager notre vision, et une rencontre avec notre CEO, Guillaume.
    (si nécessaire le processus pourra être adapté pour répondre à tes contraintes personnelles et professionnelles)
     
     
    Mesdames, autorisez-vous à candidater !
    Certaines études scientifiques montrent qu'en particulier les femmes ont moins tendance à postuler à une offre d'emploi quand elles n'ont pas toutes les qualifications. Si cela peut vous rassurer, sachez que cette fiche de poste est indicative donc prenez la comme telle : c'est un guide, ni plus ni moins.
    Si Doctrine vous intéresse, sachez que nous aurons plaisir à recevoir votre candidature !
     
    Diversité & inclusion
    Toutes nos offres sont ouvertes aux personnes en situation de handicap, n'hésitez pas a nous en parler lors du process de recrutement.
    Nous nous engageons à mettre en place tous les aménagements nécessaires pour garantir un environnement de travail adapté a chacun et chacune

jobs.description:

Loft Orbital is looking for an intern to join the End-to-End Validation & Performance (EVP) team and contribute to image-processing and calibration/validation (CAL/VAL) activities for Earth-observation missions. In this internship, you’ll explore how AIT captures and routine onboard imagery can support optical performance testing and radiometric calibration, and turn that work into an evaluated engineering prototype.

  • Review DSNU, radiometric calibration, and relevant EVP processing and CAL/VAL practices.

  • Prepare a reproducible dataset and establish reference baselines, including a holdout evaluation strategy that avoids tuning and testing on the same acquisitions.
  • Implement a baseline estimator: a data-fit term combined with a regularizing prior.
  • Investigate additional AI/ML methods only where suitable training or validation data are available; compare them against the baseline rather than assuming they are superior.
  • Evaluate correction quality, residual fixed-pattern structure, stability across images, runtime, and failure cases.
  • Package the workflow as a prototype script or notebook with plots, quality checks, and an auditable record of inputs, parameters, and outputs.
  • Present findings and recommendations to EVP and CAL/VAL stakeholders; document what evidence would be needed before operational use.

    • Radiometric calibration and CAL/VAL for space-based optical imaging.

jobs.title: AI/ML Engineering Intern: System 1 Models for Reactive Space Operations
jobs.description:
Wanna join the adventure?

Loft Orbital flies other people's payloads on standardized satellites, giving our customers a fast, simple, and reliable path to orbit. Our AI for Space team is looking for a motivated intern to explore how fast, lightweight “System 1” models can boost reactivity, performance, and usability across our satellite operational chains.

Reactivity use cases are at the heart of Loft's vision, and we are scaling them: from single-satellite reactive loops, to two-satellite / two-sensor tip & cue (a detection from one sensor automatically cueing an acquisition by another), and ultimately multi-satellite scenarios. Today we mostly rely on “System 2” models — powerful but slow and heavy at inference — from our partners. “System 1” models (fast, intuitive) are coming back strongly and could add value not only on reactivity, but also on performance and ease of use. This internship will assess that added value and prototype it on our reactivity scenarios.

Location: Toulouse office, city center (Jeanne d’Arc metro station)
Duration: 6-month, end-of-studies internship — target start date: early 2027.


About this role:
  • Review the state of the art on System 1 / fast, intuitive models and compare them with the System 2 models used today, including our partners' models.
  • Map where System 1 models could bring value in our operational chain for reactivity use cases, from detection to tasking.
  • Define benchmark scenarios of increasing complexity with the team: a single-satellite reactive loop, then a two-satellite / two-sensor tip & cue loop, and, as a stretch goal, a multi-satellite scenario.
  • Set the latency budget, accuracy needs, and execution context for each scenario.
  • Build datasets and evaluation sets from Loft data, partner outputs, and open datasets.
  • Train or fine-tune System 1 models and benchmark them against System 2 baselines on reactivity (latency), performance (accuracy, compute footprint), and ease of use (integration and operational effort).
  • Prototype an end-to-end reactive loop, possibly as a hybrid design where System 1 triggers and System 2 validates, and assess how it extends to multi-satellite coordination.
  • Document results and recommendations for production use, and deliver a final demo.

Must Haves:
  • Final-year engineering or Master's student specialized in ML / deep learning / computer vision.
  • Solid Python and PyTorch skills, and good software engineering practices.
  • Strong understanding of the state of the art in LLM / VLM / Reinforcement Learning.
  • Practical experience training neural networks (language models or computer vision) and/or LLM manipulation.

Nice to Haves:
  • Model optimization (quantization, distillation, edge inference).
  • Exposure to satellite or geospatial data.
  • Multi-agent or distributed systems experience.
  • Genuine interest in space.

What Can We Offer?
You will join the AI for Space team and directly support the scaling of reactivity use cases, a core part of Loft's vision — working toward shorter detection-to-tasking latency on single-satellite and tip & cue scenarios, and a first step towards multi-satellite reactive operations. jobs.title: Werkstudent Medisch Acceptatie
jobs.description:
Over ons

Europa verandert. Steeds meer mensen kiezen voor vrijheid — als zzp'er, freelancer of ondernemer. Ze bepalen zelf wanneer, hoe en met wie ze werken. Maar die vrijheid komt met een keerzijde: onzekerheid.

Bij Insify geloven we dat ondernemers zich geen zorgen moeten maken over verzekeringen. Daarom bouwen we iets wat de verzekeringswereld hard nodig heeft: transparante, eerlijke en volledig digitale verzekeringen, speciaal voor mensen die voor zichzelf werken. Geen ingewikkeld papierwerk, geen gedoe. Vandaag geregeld, morgen verzekerd.

We verzekeren inmiddels duizenden klanten in heel Europa — en we zijn nog maar net begonnen.


Het Operations Team

Wij zijn het gezicht van Insify. Bij elk telefoontje, elke e-mail en elk gesprek bouwen we vertrouwen op. We zorgen ervoor dat klanten zich gehoord, gesteund en goed geholpen voelen — ook als het ingewikkeld wordt. Snelheid en kwaliteit gaan bij ons hand in hand, en we verbeteren continu op basis van wat we leren. Met een groeiend medisch acceptatieteam en uitbreiding naar meerdere Europese landen, speel jij een directe rol in iets wat echt impact maakt.


Jouw rol

Als Medisch Acceptatie Werkstudent ben jij het eerste aanspreekpunt voor onze klanten in een van de meest persoonlijke momenten van hun ondernemerschap. Je werkt nauw samen met medische specialisten en zorgt ervoor dat aanvragen soepel, nauwkeurig en klantgericht verlopen. Dit is geen standaard bijbaan — je draait mee in een snel groeiend team waar jouw bijdrage echt telt.


Wat ga je doen
  • Klantcontact. Je beantwoordt vragen via telefoon, e-mail en chat. Je legt complexe verzekeringspolissen en medische beslissingen uit op een manier die klanten écht begrijpen.
  • Gegevensbeheer. Je vraagt medische dossiers op bij huisartsen en specialisten, controleert de volledigheid en verwerkt alles nauwkeurig in ons systeem.
  • Samenwerken met specialisten. Je fungeert als schakel tussen de klant en de medisch specialist — je vat informatie samen, signaleert complexe vraagstukken en houdt de communicatie helder.
  • Administratie. Je houdt klantgegevens up-to-date, verwerkt poliswijzigingen en bewaakt deadlines.

    • Wat je meebrengt
  • Je studeert momenteel, bij voorkeur in een richting met raakvlakken aan zorg, communicatie of bedrijfskunde.
  • Je bent beschikbaar voor 24 tot 32 uur per week.
  • Je Nederlands is uitstekend — zowel mondeling als schriftelijk. Dit is een harde eis, omdat je dagelijks contact hebt met Nederlandstalige klanten.

jobs.title: Insurance Product Manager / Underwriter (P&C)
jobs.description:
Most insurance product roles ask you to perfect one product in one market. This one asks you to build Europe’s SME insurance products: decide what we cover and who we insure, negotiate it with our carriers and get it live, market after market.

Deep in the wording. Fast in the build.

About Insify

Insurance for entrepreneurs is still built the old way: one market at a time, wordings nobody reads, and cover that leaves out the very businesses that need it most.

We're doing it differently.

Insify is a high-growth scale-up backed by €43M in total funding from world-class investors like Accel, Munich Re Ventures, and Formula 1 champion Nico Rosberg. In five years, we've expanded from the Netherlands into France, Germany and Ireland, and we're just getting started. Our mission: become the European leader in AI-powered SME insurance.

We aren't just building a company; we're leading a revolution. Our culture is intense, high-stakes, and mission-driven. We hire smart, ambitious "owners" who possess a relentless drive to win. This is an environment for those who thrive on challenges, value intellectual honesty, and share our mindset of becoming a global category leader.

Our founding team consists of seasoned entrepreneurs who have previously built iconic businesses like HelloFresh, Bloomon, and SumUp. We bring that same bias for speed, scale, and high standards to one of the most structurally broken experiences in financial services. Together, we combine that deep fintech and e-commerce expertise with cutting-edge AI to stay ahead of the curve.


What you’ll own in your first year

You won’t inherit a finished product shelf. You’ll build the engine that fills it.

  1. Build the product engine. Turn how we benchmark a market into a system: compare cover, limits and exclusions across local players, our Dutch home product and our other markets, so every new product starts from facts, not gut feeling.
  2. Make the call on cover. Decide what we cover, what we don’t and who we insure, and turn it into a proposal. The tools do the comparison; the judgment is yours.
  3. Get it signed. Take the proposal to our risk carriers and negotiate it. You know what to push on, what to let go and which clause will set off six red flags.
  4. Get it live. Adapt our wordings to each new market, run the legal review and launch. Less writing from scratch, more making one strong product fit the next market. Then track loss ratios, competition and customer feedback, and sharpen it.
  5. Build what doesn’t exist yet. In the markets where we double down, own custom products from the insurance side, including cover for the trades and businesses others decline.

Who you are

You’re an insurance expert first and a builder second, but a real one.

  • You have 5+ years hands-on in commercial P&C (Property & Casualty) at an insurer, MGA, (re)insurer or specialist broker, across underwriting, product and wordings, ideally for SMEs.
  • You know what is covered, what isn’t and what should be. Hand you a wording from a market you’ve never worked in and you’ll spot the gaps within minutes.
  • You’ve worked across more than one line, product or market, and you can apply what you know to a market you’ve never seen.
  • You’ve sat at the table with insurers or capacity providers and know where the red lines are.
  • You’d rather fix insurance than complain about it. Maybe you already tried: at an insurtech, an MGA, your own startup, or on the carrier side building products with insurtechs.
  • You think like the customer: plain questions, fair cover, and no excluding everything just to be safe.
  • You’re at home in Excel and data, and curious about what automation and LLMs can take off your plate. You don’t need to code; our product and tech teams build the digital journey with you.
  • You work fluently in English; German, French or Dutch is a big plus.

    • What we offer
  • Real ownership. You decide what we cover and work directly with the MT, close to where decisions get made.
  • Range. More products and markets in a year than most people see in a decade at an incumbent.
  • A share in what we build. Equity, so you share in the value you build.
  • A team that cares. We live by four values: Grit, Care, Impact and Entrepreneurship.
  • Growth. Room to grow into leading our insurance product work as we add markets, plus an in-house coaching and leadership program.
  • The package. Competitive salary package + 6% pension, holidays, well-being budget and rich social events (ski trip, summer and winter party).
  • The basics, done well. Office in central Amsterdam, laptop, hybrid working. Relocation support.

    • If you know insurance inside out and you’d rather build products than maintain them, we’d like to meet you. No cover letter needed.

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer
jobs.description:
Senior Product Designer

Didomi is looking for a Senior Product Designer to take end-to-end ownership of design across multiple products within our Privacy and Consent Management Platform. This is a senior IC role reporting directly to the Design Director, acting as design peer-lead within the Product team, supporting our Product Managers and their engineering teams. Design is currently the one shared resource across the entire product org, and this role is central to how we scale it.

You'll help shape the future of our product, creating experiences that are intuitive, efficient, and user-centric, while collaborating closely with cross-functional partners. You'll get involved early, shaping problems alongside Product and Engineering rather than just executing against requirements handed to you, and take ownership of your workstreams once scope is assigned based on where the business needs it most.

What you'll do

  • Own the process end-to-end. Lead discovery through delivery for your assigned product areas, handing off finalized UX/functional design to our creative team for UI polish.
  • Shape decisions upstream. Get involved before requirements are locked, and bring evidence and clear rationale to engineering-first decisions rather than reacting after the fact.
  • Take ownership across ambiguity. Hold multiple complex workstreams and adapt as scope shifts with business priorities.
  • Build the research muscle. Help establish research and usability practices that don't fully exist today, and translate findings into decisions Product and Engineering can act on.
  • Reduce design debt. Flag and help prevent downstream friction from features shipping without a design pass.
  • Prototype fast with AI. Use tools like Figma Make or Claude to turn concepts into high-level, testable prototypes quickly, helping the team validate direction and unblock decisions without waiting on full design cycles for every idea.
  • Foster a strong design culture. Share knowledge, mentor peers, and help improve team processes.

What you'll bring

  • 5+ years in product/UX design, with real ownership of complex products and a strong portfolio of shipped work.
  • Fluency in Figma or equivalent design/prototyping tools.
  • Comfort working in ambiguous, fast-moving, engineering-heavy environments with limited day-to-day oversight.
  • Strong interaction and systems thinking. You can untangle complex flows and design for edge cases.
  • Experience building or contributing to a research practice where formal resourcing is limited.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work efficiently with cross-functional teams.
  • Proven experience designing zero-to-one products, new platforms, or defining new product spaces.
  • Hands-on experience using AI tools (Figma Make, Claude, or similar) to generate high-level prototypes and accelerate concept validation.

Strongly preferred: experience in privacy, compliance, or another highly regulated/technical domain.

We don't expect candidates to meet every point above. If most of this resonates, we'd love to hear from you.

Recruitment Process:

1. HR Screen (15 minutes)

2. Hiring Manager Interview (30 minutes)

3. Live White boarding session (1h30) 

4. Peer interview with our Creative Lead

5. Final Interview with our CTO

jobs.title: Senior Security Operations Engineer
jobs.description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

As a member of our Security Operations Team, you will collaborate with a global team of engineers to monitor and respond to security events, lead security incidents as Incident Commander, and lead digital forensic investigations in support of Employee Relations, Legal, Compliance, or Information Security cases.

Although you will be focused on security incident response, you will also have the opportunity to create and maintain runbooks, and automated workflows, and assist in process refinement and implementation. You will collaborate with a diverse team of engineers, and key stakeholders on security initiatives across the company. Above all, your focus is bringing Security expertise to the table in a collaborative, humble, and practical manner.

Location: This role is open to candidates residing in the UK

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Every phone call you answer and every email you send can affect whether truck drivers deliver goods on time and without accidents, whether students get dropped off safely from school, or whether power gets restored quickly after a natural disaster.
  • You thrive the most when solving problems: Our constantly expanding technology and the complexities faced by our customers provide an exciting range of challenges for our Customer Success teams. With a growth mindset and a desire to learn, you will strategically partner with our customers to find unique solutions to help keep their operations safe, efficient, and sustainable.
  • You are a natural relationship builder: Whether the relationship is with our customers or with cross-functional teams in Samsara, you are in constant communication and collaboration with key stakeholders to win as a team.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. This Customer Success team is still shaping its future and you will have plenty of autonomy and opportunities to master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by the best and brightest professionals out there.

In this role, you will: 

  • Monitor security events and provide technical analysis on alerts
  • Lead information security incidents and employee insider investigations by developing the incident response strategy, lead the execution through incident closure, while providing incident updates to key stakeholders throughout the incident
  • Deliver security guidance clearly and concisely for incident response and insider threat initiatives
  • Coordinate the building of services, capabilities, integrations, and implementations of technologies to support security operations, incident response, and insider threat
  • Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices
  • Participate in our on-call rota covering weekends

Minimum requirements for the role:

  • 5+ years of experience in Security Incident Response
  • Ability to communicate investigative findings and strategies to technical staff, executive leadership, and legal
  • Ability to build scripts or tools to support Samsara's investigation processes, with proficiency in Python
  • Mentor and train security operation engineers on data collection, analysis, and reporting technical analysis
  • Practical experience acting as a lead during security incident response, including monitoring and triaging alerts, and coordinating across teams
  • Understanding of analysis and forensics techniques on macOS, Windows, and Linux
  • Experience utilizing SIEM tools to perform log reviews
  • Experience in cloud architecture and security (AWS, GCP) and cloud-based services
  • Participation in an on-call rotation, with the potential to work outside standard business hours, including late evenings, when responding to high-severity incidents as part of our global incident response team.

The company is building an AI native software backbone for specialist manufacturers, initially across mission critical pharmaceutical and chemical supply chains. Many of these businesses still run critical order, planning and procurement processes through ageing ERP systems, spreadsheets and knowledge held by a small number of experienced employees.

The product combines workflow automation, AI agents and human approval to help operational teams respond faster while maintaining accuracy, traceability and compliance. The engineering team works close to customers, including visits to operational environments, to understand how work happens and turn it into dependable software.

You will work directly with the founders, influence architecture and engineering standards, and stay close to the users whose workflows you are improving.

Why consider it

You will have meaningful influence over the architecture, product and early engineering culture.

The technical work combines AI enabled systems, enterprise integration and demanding operational constraints.

The product supports essential European industries where software reliability and human judgement both matter.

The package includes a competitive base salary and meaningful early stage equity through a VSOP.

What you will do

  • Build end to end product features with TypeScript, Node.js, React and Next.js.

What AI native means here

The company uses external language models and coding agents to build and ship software faster. The role involves engineering reliable AI enabled workflows around those models. It does not involve training foundation models or conducting AI research. Strong software engineering judgement remains central, particularly around evaluation, failure modes, observability and human oversight.

What you bring

  • Around 3 to 5 or more years of experience building and operating production software.

  • Strong backend engineering skills with Node.js, API design and system architecture.

  • Experience integrating REST APIs and external systems.

jobs.title: Mission Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Join SE3 Labs as Mission Operations Manager

Run the field exercises that put SE3's autonomous systems in the hands of military units, and bring back the insight that shapes what we build next.

About SE3

SE3 Labs builds spatial intelligence and autonomy software for unmanned systems. We combine 3D computer vision, state estimation and AI to help autonomous platforms perceive their surroundings, know where they are and operate when GPS and other sensors become unreliable. Defence is a core application of our work today.

We are growing to a team of 100+ people. Join at a stage where you can shape our Mission Operations team, help build the team and grow your responsibilities as the company expands.

Our founding team's research has received more than 90,000 citations. You will work closely with technical founders and engineers with deep experience in computer vision and autonomous systems, turning that research depth into systems that work in the field.

About the Role

As Mission Operations Manager, you'll plan and run the exercises and trials that prove SE3's autonomous systems and Spatial AI in realistic conditions. You'll be the day-to-day point of contact for the operational units we work with, partnering closely with our engineering, product and commercial teams and travelling regularly across Europe. What you capture in the field becomes the evidence and requirements that move our product and programmes forward.

What You'll Work On

  • Exercise Planning: Plan trials and exercises within our exercise programme, from component tests through to multi-system exercises, with clear scenarios, objectives and success criteria.

  • Exercise Delivery: Run exercises on the ground, coordinating the people, systems and logistics involved so that each one delivers usable results.

  • User Liaison: Act as the day-to-day contact for operational units. Build trusted working relationships and keep a steady flow of feedback between users and SE3.

  • Operational Assessment: Assess how our systems perform in realistic conditions and document their operational value, limitations and integration needs in clear post-exercise reports.

  • Requirements Capture: Translate user feedback and field observations into structured requirements that product and engineering can prioritise and act on.

  • Programme Support: Supply the commercial team with operational evidence, demonstrations and field insight that help turn engagement into awarded programmes.

  • Team Building: Help establish the processes, templates and ways of working that let the Mission Operations team scale as SE3 grows.

Your Profile

  • You take ownership of outcomes and get things done without waiting for direction. You turn plans into well-run activities and hold yourself to a consistently high standard.

  • You bring several years of experience in military operations, trials or capability development, ideally as a serving or former officer or NCO, or in a field or trials role with a defence supplier.

  • You have a solid technical understanding of unmanned systems, autonomy or software-defined defence, and engage credibly with both engineers and operators.

  • You're highly organised and comfortable running complex activities with many moving parts, often outdoors and under time pressure.

  • You communicate clearly and build trust quickly with military users, partners and internal teams.

  • You're willing to travel regularly across Europe and into other markets where SE3 operates.

  • You speak native-level German and have full professional fluency in English, written and spoken. Given the nature of SE3's work in the defence sector, candidates must be eligible to obtain and hold the security clearance required for this role.

Especially Valued Bonus Skills

  • Experience planning or running military exercises, trials or experimentation campaigns involving unmanned or autonomous systems.

  • Hands-on experience operating drones, with EU UAS operator certificates a plus.

  • Experience in NATO or other multinational exercise environments.

  • Familiarity with defence procurement and how operational trials lead to funded programmes.

Perks & Benefits

  • Real Ownership: Participate in SE3's growth through our employee participation programme

  • Work Environment to Excel at: Find a high-quality and modern toolset, flat hierarchy and a skilled, driven team which will push the limits together with you

  • AI-boosted workplace: We empower every employee with best-in-class AI tools and agents, giving you unlimited access to the latest advancements and a true productivity edge

  • 31 Paid Days Off: 30 vacation days plus your birthday off

  • Well-being Access: Free membership to gyms, yoga, and wellness through EGYM Wellpass

  • Team Offsites: We go on 2 company retreats per year, our last ones were in Italy and Greece

  • Mentorship: Work closely with experienced engineers and get paired with a professional mentor to support your growth

Our Process

HG has recently changed its logistics service arrangements, consolidating most local warehouses into one central location as part of a cost-saving initiative. At the same time, a new ERP system is being implemented. This creates an interesting and dynamic environment in which existing budget models, cost allocation models, reporting and financial processes need to be further developed to reflect the new operating model and provide a solid basis for financial control and decision-making.

What you will do

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Owning the operational cost lines between Net Sales and Contribution Margin for the whole group and. act as a strong Finance business partner to the Chief Operating Officer and his team, translating operational developments into actionable financial insights;

  • Identifying and driving continuous improvements to the operational business, improving insights while reducing costs.

  • Being the financial business partner for the country managers in the UK and Germany, including reviewing commercial deals and business cases.

  • Analyzing budget versus actuals and explaining significant variances.

  • Developing a clear understanding of budgeted versus actual purchase prices and identifying the key drivers behind price variances.

  • Providing insight into raw material and purchase price developments and translating these into expected P&L impact.

  • Quantifying and tracking the financial impact of Procurement and product-costing initiatives and other savings programmes.

  • Establishing and further developing standard COGS based on expected cost developments.

  • Build a thorough understanding of the warehouse and distribution budget, operational performance and key savings initiatives. 

  • Track whether the expected savings from the recently implemented warehouse and transport provider change are being realized in the P&L. 

  • Further developing cost allocation models for individual markets, using meaningful drivers, and working towards more complete and reliable management reporting.

  • Ensuring the Operations P&L, budget and actual costs are consistently captured and reported in the same structure.

  • Translating inventory developments into financial impact and creating a clear link between stock levels, budget assumptions and cost allocation.

  • Supporting and improving an efficient month-end closing process, ensuring Operations costs are accurately and consistently booked, allocated and reconciled.

  • Establish or improve proper accounting entries together with Finance Administration and relevant operational partners.

  • Co-lead the annual budget cycle and budget presentations to the Board.

  • Using and improving Power BI, ERP data and financial processes to reduce manual work and increase transparency.

You will report directly to the Chief Financial Officer and work closely with colleagues in Finance, Procurement and Operations. You will also have regular contact with the Germany and UK country managers.

This position requires more than strong analytical skills. You will need to explain your insights clearly, engage stakeholders and constructively challenge where necessary. You will be a knowledgeable sparring partner who asks questions, brings structure and takes responsibility from analysis through to implementation. You proactively identify opportunities to improve financial processes, controls, reporting and transparency across Operations.

HG is a compact, fast-growing and international organization where you can directly see the impact of your work. This requires ownership, initiative and a pragmatic, results-oriented mindset. The team culture is open, pragmatic and focused on results, encouraging you to bring ideas forward, challenge constructively and take responsibility. Everything we do is guided by our three core values: Aim High, Be Brave, Be Connected.


What you bring

We are looking for a financially strong, hands-on and improvement-oriented controller who combines analytical capability with a practical understanding of Operations. The ideal candidate is comfortable working across Finance, Procurement and Operations and is able to turn complex cost drivers into clear insights and concrete actions. 

You bring a proactive mindset, strong stakeholder-management skills and a natural drive to simplify and improve processes. You are comfortable challenging existing ways of working, creating structure in a changing environment and taking ownership from analysis through implementation. 

You will also have:

  • A completed university master’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration or a related field. A Registered Controller (RC) qualification is a strong advantage.

  • Around 10 years of relevant experience in business control, operations control or a comparable financial role.

  • Experience in a manufacturing environment is important, including knowledge of production processes, procurement and cost calculations.

  • A sound understanding of business control, financial controls and treasury.

  • Experience with ERP systems and an understanding of how financial data and accounting flows are structured.

  • Good knowledge of Power BI. You do not need to build everything from scratch, but you can independently investigate, improve and develop analyses.

  • Experience working with consolidation tools.

  • Strong analytical, communication and stakeholder management skills.

  • A proactive, hands-on and improvement-oriented mindset, with the ability to create structure in a changing environment.

  • Fluency in English. Knowledge of Dutch is desirable, and German is an advantage.

  • Experience with AI tools, such as Copilot.

  • Willingness to travel to the United Kingdom and Germany several times a year.

Please note that we do not offer visa or work permit sponsorship for this position. You must therefore hold a valid EU work permit

What do we offer

At HG, you will not be stepping into a role where everything is already set in stone. Changes in our logistics operations, systems and reporting create opportunities to further professionalize financial control and implement improvements yourself.

You can expect:

  • a senior role with broad responsibility and direct influence on financial and operational decision-making;

  • a salary appropriate to the seniority of the role, with an indicative range of €85,000 to €100,000 gross per year;

  • an annual on-target bonus of 25% of your gross annual salary; 

  • full-time employment with 30 days of annual leave; 

  • a pension scheme; 

  • a commuting allowance; 

  • a full-time role based at our head office in Almere. Hybrid working is possible on a limited basis, with office attendance being an important part of the role;

  • a dynamic and ambitious working environment where initiative and ownership are valued;

  • a friendly, welcoming team, with a free shared lunch every Monday and monthly social drinks.

We are HG

HG is a leading European brand in specialist cleaning and maintenance products.

We believe a home should be a place where people can live carefree, with confidence in the products they use to care for the spaces and belongings around them. Our products are developed to do exactly what they promise: deliver effective, reliable and specialist cleaning solutions that help consumers solve real household problems.

HG’s mission is to help people enjoy their homes without worrying about what might go wrong. We do this through high-quality products, specialist expertise, clear advice and a relentless focus on performance.

We are dedicated to delivering superiority, innovation, quality and customer satisfaction. With a strong presence across Europe and beyond, we are continuously investing to make an even bigger impact.

HG does what it promises.


Do you have any questions?

Our colleague Ilse de Groot, Corporate Recruiter, will be happy to answer any questions. You can contact her at .

(Remote)

In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to collaborate with talented professionals, contribute to cutting-edge projects, and help drive the digital transformation of industries worldwide. If you're ready to make an impact and contribute to meaningful change, we want to hear from you! 

This role is a fixed, permanent position. All successful applicants will receive a permanent employment contract regardless of location.  

 

The role:  

 

  • Own and grow a defined territory of named enterprise accounts across France / Benelux / Southern Europe. 

  • Take commercial ownership of the full sales cycle, from identifying and developing new opportunities through to negotiation, closing and account expansion. 

  • Deliver an individual annual revenue target of €1.1M once ramped, driving new business acquisition and growth within existing accounts. 

  • Build and develop a sustainable pipeline of high-value enterprise opportunities, supported by SDRs and strategic partners. 

  • Lead complex enterprise sales engagements, typically involving deal values of €150K–€300K, multiple stakeholders and extended sales cycles. 

  • Develop strategic relationships with enterprise customers, technology partners and consulting firms to drive commercial opportunities. 

  • Position and sell complex, data-driven SaaS solutions to large enterprise organisations, translating technical capabilities into measurable business value. 

  • Support the introduction and commercialisation of new products, helping establish market presence and identify new growth opportunities. 


  • Excellent proficiency in French verbal and written skills. 

  • Proven ability to sell complex, high-value SaaS solutions into large enterprise organisations, managing long sales cycles and significant deal values. 

  • Ability to develop territory strategies, build account plans and identify opportunities for new business acquisition and account expansion. 

  • Strong hunting mentality with the ability to independently identify, engage and convert new enterprise prospects. 

  • Skilled in navigating multi-stakeholder sales processes, coordinating internal and external teams and managing sophisticated commercial negotiations. 

  • Ability to understand complex customer challenges, conduct effective discovery and position solutions around business outcomes rather than product features. 

  • Strong commercial acumen and ability to build business cases, demonstrate ROI and communicate the financial and operational value of technology investments. 

  • Experience working alongside technology, consulting and implementation partners to develop opportunities and close enterprise deals. 

  • Ability to understand and communicate complex data-driven technology, analytics, software and technical solutions to both technical and business stakeholders. 

  • Practical experience applying structured sales methodologies such as MEDDPICC, Force Management or similar enterprise sales frameworks. 

  • Ability to prioritise named accounts, identify whitespace opportunities and develop strategic approaches to maximise territory revenue. 

  • Strong negotiation skills with the ability to manage commercial objections, procurement processes and executive-level discussions. 

  • Comfortable operating in a changing environment, launching new products and navigating ambiguity. 

  • Proficiency with modern sales tools, including HubSpot, Microsoft Office 365 and pipeline forecasting platforms. 

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to engage and influence senior executives and technical decision-makers. 

  • Nice to have: experience selling services. 

  • Residing in and legally permitted to work in the EU. 

 

What We Offer: 

 

  • Competitive Salary – We reward your skills and experience with a compensation package that reflects your value. 

  • 30 Days Paid Time Off – Take the time you need to recharge and maintain a healthy work-life balance. 

  • Remote-First Flexibility – Work from anywhere in the EU, with the option to collaborate in person at our offices in Stuttgart, Berlin (role dependent). 

  • Generous Learning & Development Budget – We invest in your growth, providing ample resources for personal and professional development. 

  • Choose Your Ideal Work Equipment – Whether you prefer Apple or Microsoft, we’ll equip you with the tools you need to excel. 

  

The Experience: 

 

  • Purpose-Driven Work – Build something meaningful. Here, you’re not just creating another app; you’re contributing to a transformative vision that you can be proud of. 

  • Great Colleagues – Join a team that’s open, transparent, and international. We value inclusivity and foster a culture of collaboration and mutual respect. 

  • Work-Life Balance – As a remote-first company, we trust you to do your best work, your way. You have the flexibility to work when it suits you, ensuring a healthy balance between personal and professional life. 

  • Pride in Impact – We're already making a significant difference with global, well-known customers who share our vision. Be part of something that matters. 

  • Stability with Ambition – With realistic growth plans, we’re committed to changing the way things are made—without sacrificing our ambitious goals for innovation and impact. 

 

If you want to find out more about what it’s like to work at Makersite, check out our Careers Page here 

  

Diversity and Inclusion 

If you have a medical condition or an individual need for an adjustment to our process, and you believe this may affect your ability to be at your best – please let us know so we can talk about how we can best support you and make any adjustments that may be needed.  

 

At Makersite, we are dedicated to fostering an environment that champions diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging. We believe that diverse teams drive innovation and success, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and will consider all applications regardless of age, disability, gender identity, marital status, pregnancy or maternity, race, nationality, religion, sex, sexual orientation, or any other status protected by applicable law. Rest assured, all applications will be handled with the utmost confidentiality.
