jobs.title: POST-DOCTORANT.E / INGENIEUR.E : Conception de systèmes et d’interfaces capteurs et énergie pour les systèmes électroniques étirables autonomes – CDD 12 mois
jobs.description:
Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne, c’est s’engager dans une institution où la science et l’innovation bâtissent un avenir plus durable. Une école d’excellence où chacun a l’opportunité de révéler son plein potentiel et de contribuer à relever les défis de demain.

Classée parmi les meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France et reconnue mondialement, notre école, membre de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, forme les talents de demain tout en contribuant activement à relever les grands défis industriels, numériques et environnementaux. Avec nous, vous intégrez une communauté de 500 collaborateurs, 2500 étudiants, et participez à un projet ambitieux : conjuguer excellence académique, recherche d’avant-garde et impact sociétal positif.

 L’Institut Mines-Télécom fédère les grandes écoles françaises autour des défis industriels majeurs, numériques, énergétiques et écologiques. Avec ses 8 Grandes Écoles publiques et 2 écoles filiales, il est le premier institut public dédié aux ingénieurs et managers. Ensemble, nous imaginons et construisons un avenir durable, en formant les acteurs qui façonneront les transitions de demain.

🎯 Ce que nous attendons de vous

En tant que Concepteur(trice) de Systèmes Etirables Autonomes, vous êtes au cœur de nos missions en formation, recherche et innovation affecté au département électronique flexible. Au sein de ce département vous conjuguez passion scientifique et goût pour l’innovation.

Au sein du Centre Microélectronique de Provence, le département FEL mène ses recherches dans le domaine de l'électronique flexible et étirable, pour des applications dédiées aux objets "wearable" et au « monitoring » environnemental. La conception de systèmes complets, du capteur au module de de communication, en fonction des contraintes énergétiques et environnementales est un élément essentiel permettant la réalisation de prototypes compatibles avec les cas d'usages étudiés.

Vous aurez pour mission principale, à partir du savoir-faire du département de développer l'expertise électronique dans le domaine des objets autonomes / autoalimentés pour le monitoring environnemental (Projet Hydrademo) et des interfaces "wearable" pour la perception augmentée( Projet flexeo3D). Par ailleurs, vous contribuerez au développement de modules de formation en mastère spécialisé, dans le cadre du programme EDU4chip

  ·           Vous accompagnez le développement de systèmes autonomes dans le cadre de différents projets du département

·           Vous contribuez au montage à la dispense d'un module d ’enseignement en conception de systèmes autonomes (25h) à destination des étudiants du mastère spécialisé « Concepteur de Circuits Microélectroniques »  

·           Vous assurez la conception et la réalisation des interfaces spécifiques capteurs et énergie pour nos démonstrateurs systèmes

·           Vous participez à la réalisation de prototypes innovants et à leur test en étroite collaboration avec nos équipes de recherche

Votre capacité à travailler en mode projet et à faire dialoguer enseignement, recherche et application concrète sera essentielle pour réussir.

 


🔍 Ce que nous recherchons

Vous êtes titulaire d’un :

·      Titulaire d’un Diplôme de doctorat ou d’ingénieur ou équivalent en électronique

·      Junior accepté : oui si expérience pertinente lors des stages

 

En outre, vous possédez :

•      Une expérience dans le développement de systèmes à microcontrôleurs

•      Une expérience pratique de la conception et de la réalisation des cartes électroniques

•      De bonnes connaissances en électronique analogique

•      La connaissance de procédés d’intégration électronique sur support flexible serait un plus

Vos atouts supplémentaires :

•           Votre sens pratique et votre esprit « maker »

•           Votre capacité à évoluer dans un environnement collaboratif de recherche et développement

•           Votre autonomie et votre sens de l’initiative

🌍 Pourquoi rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne ?

Nous accompagnons chacun de nos collaborateurs sur le chemin de l’excellence, avec la conviction qu’ensemble, nous pouvons avoir un impact durable et significatif sur notre monde.

Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne, c’est l’opportunité de trouver :

·           Un environnement stimulant : des moyens expérimentaux de pointe, un réseau international solide (T.I.M.E., EULIST) et des campus à taille humaine avec un environnement urbain

·           Un impact réel : des projets de recherche contractuelle à hauteur de 11 M€/an, majoritairement avec des partenaires industriels, un centre de culture scientifique la Rotonde qui s’engage depuis 25 ans dans la médiation des sciences avec plus de 50 000 visiteurs/an

·           Une qualité de vie incomparable : 49 jours de congés et RTT, télétravail partiel, prise en charge des transports en commun à 75 %, soutien financier au covoiturage et au vélo et un baromètre social où 83 % des collaborateurs plébiscitent la qualité de vie au travail

Construisons un avenir plus durable, à travers la science, l’ingénierie, et des projets qui font sens.

jobs.title: Post-doctorante ou Post-doctorant en transmission et détection sur fibres à cœurs creux - CDD de 18 mois
jobs.description:
Qui sommes-nous ?

Télécom Paris, école de l’IMT (Institut Mines-Télécom) et membre fondateur de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris, est une grande école du top 6 des écoles d’ingénieurs généralistes françaises.

La Raison d’Être de Télécom Paris est de former, imaginer et entreprendre pour concevoir des modèles, des technologies et des solutions numériques au service d’une société et d’une économie respectueuses de l’humain et de son environnement.

Nous recherchons une Post-doctorante ou un Post-doctorant en transmission et détection sur fibres à cœurs creux pour rejoindre le département COMELEC à Télécom Paris.

Les fibres à cristaux photoniques à cœur creux (Hollow-Core Photonic Crystal Fibers, HCPCF) ont récemment franchi une étape technologique majeure, avec des pertes de propagation pouvant atteindre 0.1 dB/km à 1550 nm, comparables, voire inférieures, à celles des fibres télécoms standards [1–2]. La lumière se propageant principalement dans l’air, les HCPCF présentent une latence réduite de 30 à 40 %, une dispersion ultra-faible et des non-linéarités optiques négligeables. Ces propriétés uniques en font des technologies particulièrement prometteuses pour les systèmes de télécommunications de nouvelle génération, la distribution quantique de clés (Quantum Key Distribution, QKD) sur longue distance et les applications de détection distribuée.

Le projet proposé vise à développer et démontrer la prochaine génération de fibres à cristaux photoniques à cœur creux (HCPCF) pour la transmission de données à haut débit et les applications de détection. La propagation de la lumière dans l’air plutôt que dans le verre permet aux HCPCF d’offrir une latence réduite et des non-linéarités optiques négligeables par rapport aux fibres de silice, répondant ainsi à certains des enjeux majeurs des futurs centres de données et réseaux optiques. Notre ambition est de démontrer une transmission à 400 Gbit/s sur quelques kilomètres à travers des échantillons de fibres issus de nouvelles architectures, et d’étudier le potentiel de ces HCPCF pour des applications de détection. La réalisation de ces objectifs nécessite de répondre à des spécifications exigeantes en matière de guidage monomode, de contrôle de la polarisation, ainsi que de faibles pertes par courbure et par couplage.

Deux équipes complémentaires assureront conjointement l'encadrement de ces travaux : le GPPMM, reconnu internationalement pour ses activités de conception et de fabrication de HCPCF [3–5], et le GTO, leader dans la démonstration de systèmes de communication optique et de détection à haut débit [6–8]. Un processus itératif entre la fabrication des fibres et leur caractérisation au niveau système permettra de s'assurer que leurs propriétés répondent aux exigences opérationnelles en matière de transmission et de détection. Sur le plan méthodologique, le projet combinera modélisation numérique, caractérisation et validation expérimentale dans la bande C. Les méthodes de modélisation et de traitement du signal développées au GTO pour le suivi de la polarisation contribueront à évaluer et à optimiser les performances de transmission des HCPCF conçues et caractérisées au GPPMM.

À propos du projet PLEIADES

Le projet PLEIADES s'inscrit dans le cadre du programme PEPR « Réseaux du futur », financé par l'ANR, et réunit un consortium de 14 partenaires. L'un des axes de travail porte sur les fibres à cœur creux de nouvelle génération et rassemble plusieurs laboratoires académiques, notamment LTCI, XLIM et PHLAM.

Vos principales missions seront de :

  • Assurer des missions de recherche dans le domaine de la photonique

  • Assurer des missions d’encadrement et de tutorat

  • Participer à la notoriété de l’Ecole, de l’Institut Mines-Télécom et de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris


Vous êtes titulaire d’un doctorat ou équivalent en génie électrique, communications, photonique, traitement du signal ou dans un domaine connexe. Vous disposez de solides connaissances en systèmes et réseaux de transmission optique ainsi qu’en traitement numérique du signal (DSP) appliqué aux systèmes de communication ou aux capteurs à fibre optique. La maîtrise de MATLAB et/ou Python pour le développement d’algorithmes DSP sera appréciée. Vous manifestez un intérêt marqué pour la recherche appliquée et êtes à l’aise dans un environnement multiculturel, notamment pour encadrer des stagiaires et/ou des étudiants. Une bonne maîtrise de l’anglais est indispensable. Vous disposez également de bonnes qualités relationnelles et pédagogiques, d’un bon esprit d’équipe et d’une capacité à synthétiser et à communiquer des informations complexes.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

Vous travaillerez dans un environnement en plein développement, agréable, verdoyant et accessible (notamment pour les personnes en situation de handicap) à seulement 20 km de Paris (RER B et C, proximité des grands axes routiers).

Vous bénéficierez de :

  • 49 jours de congés annuels (CA + RTT)

  • flexibilité des horaires de travail (en fonction de l'activité du service)

  • télétravail 1 à 3 jours/semaine possible

  • Remboursement abonnement transports en commun à 75%

  • Proximité de nombreuses infrastructures sportives, conciergerie, parking souterrain, restauration interne...

  • A savoir : nos cotisations sociales sont moins élevées que dans le secteur privé

Informations diverses :
Date limite de candidature : 30 novembre 2026

Type d'emploi : CDD de 18 mois

Rémunération : 36 000 euros brut/an

Nos recrutements sont fondés sur les compétences, sans distinction d’origine, d’âge, d'identité de genre et d’orientation sexuel et tous nos postes sont ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap.

In this role, you will develop multi-modal models that enable robots to autonomously generate actions from demonstrations, real-time sensor data, and natural language commands. jobs.title: Head of AI - NLP Healthtech
jobs.description:
Chez Lifen, nous pensons que les données médicales ont le potentiel de transformer le système de santé. Mais seulement si elles sont accessibles. Plus de données accessibles → moins de charge administrative, une meilleure coordination des soins et des découvertes scientifiques plus rapides.

Depuis 2015, notre mission est de libérer ce potentiel. Nos solutions basées sur l'IA permettent aux professionnels de santé de partager les informations médicales sans effort et aux chercheurs d'accélérer les découvertes cliniques : avec un impact sur des millions de patients en France chaque jour. Alors que nous nous préparons à nous développer en Europe, 2 choses déterminent notre succès : nos équipes et notre mission.

Aujourd'hui, plus de 150 personnes travaillent depuis nos bureaux et à distance pour libérer le potentiel des données de santé. Nous avons connecté 800 hôpitaux et 150 000 professionnels de santé, et nous ne faisons que commencer. Nous recherchons des personnes qui embrassent la complexité, veulent résoudre des problèmes difficiles et sont prêtes à construire le futur de la collaboration en santé.

⚡ Notre équipe AI

La santé est un monde de données complexe, fragmenté et hétérogène. L’IA représente une formidable opportunité de dépasser cette limite structurelle, qui freine l’innovation, l’efficience opérationnelle des hôpitaux et les diagnostics médicaux. Avec les algorithmes d’IA de Lifen, la donnée médicale circule mieux, les soignants consacrent moins de temps aux tâches administratives, les parcours de soins gagnent en fluidité et la recherche clinique peut avancer plus vite.

Notre équipe AI travaille à la fois sur des produits qui facilitent la prise en charge des patients au quotidien et sur des projets qui permettent de structurer des données de santé à grande échelle pour accélérer la recherche. Cela veut dire entraîner et faire évoluer nos propres modèles, notamment autour du traitement du langage et des grands modèles de langage, sur des données complexes, hétérogènes et sensibles.

L’équipe réunit des machine learning engineers autonomes et exigeants. Elle a déjà construit des fondations solides. Le prochain cap est clair : donner une direction commune aux sujets liés aux soins et à la recherche, faire des choix ambitieux et transformer des avancées techniques en produits utiles.

Nous cherchons un·e Head of AI capable de tenir ce rôle de chef d’orchestre : proche des enjeux techniques ; à l’aise avec le produit et le business ; capable de faire grandir une équipe.

Le poste est basé à Paris, avec un fonctionnement hybride et une présence régulière attendue aux côtés de l’équipe.

🎯 Ce que tu feras chez nous

  • Définir une stratégie AI lisible et ambitieuse : clarifier les priorités, construire une roadmap, arbitrer entre développement interne, partenariats et solutions existantes, puis donner un cap cohérent aux initiatives liées aux soins comme à la recherche clinique.

  • Faire émerger des produits utiles à partir de sujets techniques complexes : par exemple, améliorer la structuration de documents médicaux pour réduire la charge des équipes de soins, ou rendre des données cliniques exploitables pour faire progresser la recherche.

  • Orchestrer les priorités d’une équipe très transverse : les besoins viennent de plusieurs produits, avec des horizons et des contraintes différents. Tu apporteras le point de vue AI nécessaire pour choisir où investir, ce qui doit être amélioré et ce qui mérite d’être exploré.

  • Faire grandir l’équipe et ses référents techniques : installer des objectifs clairs, du feedback utile et des espaces de décision réels, afin que chacun puisse prendre de l’ampleur sans perdre la qualité d’exécution qui fait la force de l’équipe.

  • Garder l’équipe connectée aux évolutions du domaine : challenger les approches établies, lancer des POC, faire évoluer les pratiques et décider avec pragmatisme quand une nouvelle technologie mérite d’être adoptée.

  • Porter la vision AI de Lifen auprès des équipes Produit, Tech et de la direction, mais aussi auprès de clients, partenaires et de l’écosystème.

⭐️ Ce que nous recherchons

Must-have

  • Tu as déjà défini et mis en mouvement une stratégie AI, machine learning dans une entreprise technologique, une scale-up ou un environnement comparable.

  • Tu as au moins deux ans d’expérience de management direct d’une équipe Data, AI, Machine Learning ou Engineering.

  • Tu as une expérience sur le traitement automatique du langage, les grands modèles de langage, l’extraction d’information ou la structuration de données homogènes qui te donne une une crédibilité technique solide auprès de l’équipe.

  • Tu relies naturellement les choix technologiques aux usages, aux utilisateurs et aux résultats attendus pour le produit et l’entreprise.

  • Tu sais embarquer des interlocuteurs techniques comme non techniques.

Nice-to-have

  • Tu as déjà travaillé dans la santé, les données cliniques, la medtech, la biotech ou un secteur soumis à de fortes contraintes réglementaires.

  • Tu as collaboré avec des équipes de recherche appliquée, publié, contribué à des conférences ou porté des prises de parole sur des sujets AI.

  • Tu as évolué dans une organisation où les données sont sensibles et où les enjeux de souveraineté, de confidentialité et de conformité font partie des décisions techniques.

Soft skills

Tu aimes les problèmes qui ne se résolvent pas avec une recette toute faite. Tu es à l’aise dans l’ambiguïté, curieux·se par nature et assez exigeant·e pour remettre en question les habitudes quand elles ne servent plus l’objectif. Tu sais manager des personnes senior : leur donner du cadre, de la reconnaissance et de l’autonomie.

Nos valeurs

  • Embrace Complexity : tu sais composer avec des données imparfaites, des contraintes réglementaires fortes et des arbitrages techniques qui changent vite.

  • Bienveillance : tu crées un environnement de confiance, où l’exigence va de pair avec l’écoute, le feedback et le droit de questionner.

  • Real Impact : tu gardes en tête ce que chaque décision peut changer pour les soignants, les chercheurs et, au bout de la chaîne, les patients.

👥 Process de recrutement

  1. Échange de préqualification avec Laura, Talent Acquisition Manager, 30 minutes.
    Nous faisons connaissance, revenons sur ton parcours, tes attentes et les grandes lignes du poste. C’est aussi le moment de répondre à tes premières questions sur Lifen, l’équipe et le contexte.

  2. Entretien avec Alexandre, CTO, environ 45 minutes
    Nous approfondissons ton expérience de management, ta capacité à construire une stratégie AI et ta manière de faire le lien entre technologie, produit et enjeux business.

  3. Étude de cas et échanges avec l’équipe AI, environ 1 h 30
    En amont, nous te partagerons un cadre de réflexion. Tu présenteras ensuite ton approche à plusieurs membres de l’équipe, lors de deux échanges. L’objectif n’est pas de tester ta connaissance d’une stack précise, mais de comprendre comment tu structures une vision, priorises dans un contexte complexe et crées l’adhésion.

  4. Entretien final avec la direction Tech et Research, environ 1 h à 1 h 30
    Nous échangeons sur ta lecture des enjeux de Lifen, ton ambition pour l’AI appliquée à la santé et ta capacité à porter cette vision au-delà de l’équipe.

Nous nous engageons à te faire un retour dans les 72 heures après chaque étape. Des prises de références pourront être demandées en fin de process, avec ton accord.

jobs.title: Principal Software Architect
jobs.description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Product Architecture and Safety Teams

Our Product Architecture and Safety teams connect Wayve’s core AI Driver with the vehicle platforms that bring autonomous driving technology to customers. Working across Engineering, Product, Safety, Validation and customer programs, we define how our software integrates with OEM and Tier 1 systems, supporting safe, reliable deployment while maintaining a consistent core product architecture.

🧠 Your day-to-day

As a Principal Software Architect, you’ll lead the technical architecture for integrating Wayve’s autonomous driving technology with automotive OEM vehicle platforms. You’ll work at the boundary between our core AI Driver and external vehicle systems, translating product ambitions and customer needs into clear interfaces, requirements and technical decisions.

Your work will span high-level architecture and implementation details, from sensors and middleware to ECU constraints, timing, diagnostics, safety assumptions, data logging and validation. You’ll bring structure to ambiguous problems, guide architecture work across teams and own key decisions across customer programs. Along the way, you’ll build alignment with engineering, product, safety, validation, program and commercial leaders.

🧩 What you’ll be working on

  • Defining integration architecture: Shape how Wayve software interfaces with OEM and Tier 1 vehicle systems, balancing customer program needs with the evolution and reusability of our core architecture.

  • Making ownership explicit: Turn customer and partner discussions into clear interface contracts, ownership boundaries, assumptions, dependencies and open technical decisions, including what is Wayve-owned, partner-owned, jointly defined or out of scope.

  • Translating needs into requirements: Partner with Product and Engineering to develop actionable technical specifications. Establish a consistent approach to decomposing customer requirements into system and software requirements, including allocation, traceability and change control.

  • Owning architecture decisions: Lead architecture reviews, maintain decision records and make the final technical call within your scope when consensus cannot be reached.

  • Planning for successful delivery: Assess feasibility, integration complexity, technical gaps and risks. Identify dependencies and required partner deliverables to support customer program planning.

  • Building verifiable solutions: Work with Safety and Validation teams to define safety assumptions, integration test requirements and clear evidence that customer requirements have been met.

  • Representing Wayve with partners: Lead technical discussions with OEMs and Tier 1 suppliers, supported by clear interface specifications, integration guides, architecture diagrams and decision records.

  • Leading across teams: Coordinate architects and engineering teams, negotiate competing priorities, resolve or escalate conflicts early, and mentor architects and senior engineers to build a shared architecture culture.

🙌 You should apply if

  • You bring substantial experience in ADAS, autonomous driving, embedded software or vehicle systems, particularly at the software–vehicle interface. Typically, you’ll have 12+ years of relevant experience, including architecture ownership for a complete product or multiple programs.

  • You can define clear product boundaries, ownership models and interface contracts between internal software and external vehicle systems.

  • You understand vehicle electronics and embedded software constraints, including ECU integration, real-time execution, timing, diagnostics and production vehicle software environments.

  • You’re familiar with automotive communication protocols and electrical/electronic architectures, such as CAN, FlexRay, Automotive Ethernet, SOME/IP or AUTOSAR.

  • You’ve worked with automotive OEMs or Tier 1 suppliers and can navigate their requirements, standards and integration constraints.

  • You’ve established and run requirements processes across multiple teams or programs, translating ambiguous needs into clear, traceable and verifiable system and software specifications.

  • You can move confidently between system-level architecture and implementation details, making sound technical decisions under uncertainty and maintaining consistency as programs evolve.

  • You’ve led architecture work across teams and influenced senior stakeholders without direct authority, building support and handling competing priorities constructively.

  • You communicate complex technical ideas clearly through specifications, diagrams and reviews, and enjoy mentoring others.

 

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

 

More about Wayve:

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

 

How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working:

Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.

 

🔍 The Interview Process:

Our process is clear and respectful of your time:

  • Initial call / recruiter screen

  • Hiring Manager Interview

  • Deep-dive technical interviews

  • Final interview: mission & values alignment

We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability.

What’s in it for you (Location dependant):

💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually
📈 Meaningful equity, sharing in the ownership and long term success of Wayve
✈️ Relocation support and visa sponsorship where applicable
✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs
📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth
🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more

A quick, honest note before you apply.

Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.

If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you.

At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law.

For more information visit Careers at Wayve. To learn more about what drives us, visit Values at Wayve

DISCLAIMER: We will not ask about marriage or pregnancy, care responsibilities or disabilities in any of our job adverts or interviews. However, we do look to capture information about care responsibilities, and disabilities among other diversity information as part of an optional DEI Monitoring form to help us identify areas of improvement in our hiring process and ensure that the process is inclusive and non-discriminatory.

jobs.description:
About Us

We are building Physics AI for hardware design. Our software platform helps hardware designers and physics simulation engineers explore, analyze, and optimize hardware systems, leveraging cutting-edge AI to deliver ultrafast, accurate physics intelligence within the realities of engineering design workflows.

Our first product bridges the gap between the accuracy & determinism of traditional simulation and the speed & scaling of AI, and is redefining how the world’s most advanced semiconductors are designed, verified, built, brought to market and integrated in complex systems.

Role Overview

As a pivotal leader within our European Forward Deployment team, you will drive the adoption of Vinci’s platform among the region's top engineering organizations. In this strategic role, you will build, mentor, and guide a high-performing team of thermal engineers dedicated to engaging prospective customers and demonstrating our software's transformative value.

As trusted technical advisors, you and your team will use deep simulation expertise to help enterprise customers validate and optimize complex, real-world designs. Through these collaborative engagements, you will champion Vinci's value proposition by showing how our platform delivers systemic improvements in thermal performance, product reliability, and time-to-market.

Leveraging strong fundamentals in continuum mechanics, you will guide analyses of complex physical phenomena, including linear, geometric and material nonlinearities, and contact interactions. Your team will evaluate critical factors such as warpage, stress evolution, thermal cycling, and reliability across advanced semiconductor devices, electronics packages, and wafer-scale systems.

You will work closely with customer engineering teams to understand their technical challenges, provide expert guidance, and clearly articulate Vinci’s capabilities in solving real-world problems. You will also serve as a key feedback channel to product and engineering teams, translating customer insights into actionable inputs that shape product direction and drive continuous improvement.

This is a remote role, with close collaboration with Sales, Product, and Engineering in Palo Alto, CA, USA. The role includes moderate travel, primarily within continental Europe. Some infrequent intercontinental travel may be required for discussions and collaboration with the US team.

Responsibilities

  • Build, lead, and scale a high-performing team of thermo-mechanical engineers, setting the technical direction, hiring, mentoring team members, and driving field execution across Europe.

  • Collaborate closely with the sales team to lead technical discussions, scope proof-of-concept (PoC) evaluations, and deliver compelling product demonstrations to prospective enterprise customers.

  • Guide customer engineering teams through the evaluation phase by overseeing simulation setup, running complex test cases, and interpreting results to explicitly prove Vinci’s technical and business value.

  • Own customer enablement through onboarding, deployment pipeline and account expansion, providing senior technical guidance, structured training sessions, and advanced troubleshooting.

  • Provide product guidance and feedback, identify customer pain points and workflow bottlenecks, partnering directly with internal product and engineering teams to transform field feedback into critical new product features.

  • Represent Vinci at major industry conferences and semiconductor events, engaging technically with key prospects and partners through technical presentations and live platform demonstrations.

  • Maintain a strong understanding of competitive technologies, industry trends, and market positioning to communicate Vinci’s differentiators effectively.

Qualifications (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Education: Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a closely related technical field.

  • Technical depth: Expert-level mastery of commercial FEA software (e.g., Ansys Mechanical, Abaqus, or equivalent), with 15+ years of hands-on experience in thermo-mechanical simulations— either as a practitioner running simulations or as a technical account manager for commercial physics simulation software.

  • Industry Domain: Deep familiarity with semiconductor electronics packaging, advanced packaging technologies (e.g., 2.5D/3D IC), or foundry ecosystems.

  • Customer Engagement: Prior experience in dedicated customer-facing roles, with a strong ability to build trust and manage engineering client relationships.

  • Automation & Scripting: Practical programming experience using Python or C++ to automate workflows or parse simulation data.

  • Leadership Impact: Proven track record of prior managerial or technical leadership experience, with the ability to scale, mentor, and drive execution across engineering teams.

  • Communication: Elite interpersonal and communication skills, with a proven ability to distill complex physics and simulation results into clear, high-impact narratives for both deep technical panels and business-oriented executives.

Preferred (Desirable Differentiators)

  • Multiphysics Breadth: Familiarity with thermal management and cooling solutions and/or Electrical Signal Integrity and Power Integrity (SI/PI) workflows.

  • Commercial Track Record: Direct experience commercializing technical software—ideally electronic design automation (EDA) or CAE simulation tools—into major semiconductor and electronics enterprises.

  • Go-To-Market Experience: Prior experience explicitly within technical pre-sales, application engineering (FAE), or strategic technical sales environments.

  • Emerging Tech Adjacency: Ability to rapidly adopt and champion next-generation, physics-based workflows and AI-assisted design or simulation tools.

Why Join Us

  • Not just use AI; be part of a team actively redefining how next-generation silicon and hardware are architected.

  • Work at the absolute convergence of state-of-the-art AI models, fundamental physics, and high-stakes enterprise engineering.

  • Collaborate with world-class engineers and researchers in a fast-moving startup environment.

jobs.description:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

 

How you'll make impact

Lead and develop a team of four Account Managers responsible for retaining, supporting and expanding Airwallex’s French customer base. You’ll own the team’s post-sale operating model across onboarding, adoption, value realisation and expansion, while staying directly involved in strategic accounts, customer escalations, onboarding quality and growth opportunities.

  • Build practical playbooks, portfolio coverage models and operating cadences that improve customer outcomes, retention, adoption and expansion across payments, FX, cards, Spend, payouts and related products.

  • Improve visibility and predictability across onboarding progress, time-to-value, product adoption, customer health, expansion pipeline, GRR, NRR, satisfaction and retention.

  • Drive a repeatable, customer-led expansion motion based on validated customer needs, business triggers and demonstrated value.

  • Orchestrate complex level 2 customer issues with Support, KYC, Risk, Product and Operations, turning recurring friction into process improvements rather than repeated individual escalations.

  • Partner with Sales, Onboarding, Support, KYC, Risk, Product and Operations to improve customer outcomes and make Airwallex easier to adopt and grow in France.

Within the first 90 days, you’ll have mapped the portfolios, priority accounts, risks and expansion opportunities, established the team cadence and created visibility on the main customer and operational issues. Within six to twelve months, priority accounts should have clear plans and stakeholder coverage, the core playbooks should be consistently used, leading indicators should improve against an agreed baseline, and the four Account Managers should show stronger autonomy, commercial judgement and consistency.

You'll work from our Paris office three days a week.

What we're looking for

Essentials

  • 5+ years in Account Management, Customer Success, Sales, Expansion or a related B2B commercial role.

  • 2+ years of direct people management experience, ideally leading a team of 3–8.

  • Proven ownership of retention, renewals, expansion, adoption, customer health or comparable outcomes.

  • Experience working with NRR, GRR, churn, expansion, adoption, time-to-value or customer satisfaction metrics.

  • Experience in B2B SaaS, fintech, payments, banking, FX, spend management, ERP or another complex operational environment.

  • Strong customer-facing experience with Finance, Operations, Treasury, Procurement, E-commerce, founders or senior executives.

  • Evidence of building or improving customer processes, playbooks, account segmentation, health reviews, handovers or escalation routines.

  • Ability to influence Support, KYC, Risk, Product and Operations without direct authority.

  • Fluent French and professional English.

  • Strong commercial judgement, ownership and comfort working in ambiguity.

Preferred

  • Experience in payments, fintech, banking, FX, cards, spend management or financial infrastructure.

  • Experience with KYC, AML, Risk, Compliance or regulated customer operations.

  • Experience managing strategic or multi-entity customers across France and international markets.

  • Experience in pre-sales, onboarding design or solution development.

  • Experience in Travel, E-commerce, SaaS, Technology or Professional Services.

You'll thrive here if

  • You own the outcome and you don't wait for permission to fix what's broken.

  • You're comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and moving quickly anyway.

  • You enjoy working closely with people across multiple countries and time zones as part of one connected, global team, including flexing your hours occasionally to make that connection work.

  • You say what you mean. You're direct, but you lead with respect.

  • You connect dots across functions and hold the big picture without losing grip on the details.

Learn more about your team

SME & Growth at Airwallex is about more than closing deals. We help small and mid-market businesses solve real financial challenges across borders: getting paid globally, managing multi-currency accounts, paying suppliers, and running spend across markets from a single platform. You're not selling a feature. You're helping founders and finance leaders replace fragmented financial operations with one global system that actually scales.

It's a function for sellers who like to build, not follow a script: curious, resourceful, and comfortable figuring things out in markets that are still wide open. You get real autonomy to create value, build relationships, and move opportunities forward.

If you want to sell a serious product, solve real problems for ambitious businesses, and build your career fast, this is a place to do it.

Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

 

How you'll make impact

You’ll help Airwallex manage and improve the economics of card payments, with a focus on scheme fees and interchange across Visa and Mastercard. You’ll turn complex network rules and payment data into accurate configurations, actionable analysis and decisions that improve cost visibility and margin performance.

  • Own payment-cost analysis across scheme fees, interchange and network rules, identifying changes and translating them into clear financial, product and operational requirements.

  • Maintain accurate fee tables, eligibility criteria and transaction-level logic with Product and Engineering, ensuring payment-cost calculations and customer billing reflect current network rules.

  • Build models and reporting across markets, products, payment methods and transaction types to identify margin drivers, anomalies, leakage and opportunities to improve payment economics.

  • Support cost and margin optimisation through transaction qualification, BIN routing, cost configuration and related levers, contributing to pricing, product design, market launches and commercial decisions.

  • Strengthen governance, testing, reconciliation and controls by comparing expected costs with actual network charges and helping drive root-cause resolution.

  • Partner with Finance, Product, Engineering, Data, Operations and external payment partners to resolve scheme pricing, interchange and rule-related questions.

You’ll work from our Amsterdam office three days a week.

Essentials

  • Experience in payments, acquiring, issuing, card networks, payment infrastructure or a related role, ideally within a global PSP, acquirer, scheme, issuer or fintech.

  • Experience translating complex payment rules, fee schedules or network requirements into system logic, configurations and controls.

  • Experience working with payment-cost systems or controls, including interchange tables, scheme fee logic, BIN-based rules, transaction attributes or similar payment configurations.

  • Strong analytical and quantitative capabilities, including experience working with transaction-level data, economic modelling and reconciliation of expected versus actual payment costs.

  • Commercial judgment and the ability to connect payment mechanics to pricing, product decisions and margin optimisation.

The opportunity

jobs.description:
About RA

Resident Advisor has been a home for electronic music culture since 2001. Event discovery, ticketing, news and long-form editorial, artist profiles, original films, and a weekly mix series two decades deep. Around 7 million people use the web platform every month, with a wider audience across our apps and other channels. Underneath the platform sits a network of contributors and city managers across dozens of cities, which is how we stay connected to the scenes we cover rather than reporting on them from a distance. RA is 25 years old, independent, B.Corp certified and intent on being indispensable to the artists, promoters and audiences who make this culture.

Resident Advisor helps users explore the world of electronic music, from finding their next night out and buying tickets to discovering the artists, clubs and scenes behind it.

The mandate

We're looking for a senior product designer to join our design team and set the design direction for our consumer products: ra.co and the RA Guide app, used by millions of ticket buyers, readers and electronic music fans annually. The role also encompasses RA PRO, our B2B offering for promoters listing events and tickets on RA.

You'll work closely with Product Managers, Engineers, Data, Commercial and Growth teams to design experiences that help users stay engaged with the electronic music community via RA while contributing to the future development of the platform.

This is a senior role for a designer who combines strong product thinking and exceptional craft with hands-on experience of AI-assisted design. You'll lead projects from discovery through delivery, set the standard for design quality across the team, and own the evolution of the RA Design System so it works as well for AI tools and agents as it does for designers and engineers.

Responsibilities

Product design and leadership

  • Lead design for Resident Advisor's consumer products end to end, across web and native app touchpoints.
  • Set design direction and quality standards, and partner with Product, Engineering and Data leads to shape strategy, roadmaps and prioritisation.
  • Mentor and coach other designers through critique, pairing and feedback, raising the bar for craft across the team.
  • Lead discovery activities including user research, workshops and analysis of customer feedback and data.
  • Work closely with engineers throughout implementation to ensure quality execution and close the gap between design and code.

Design systems and AI

  • Own the RA Design System: maintain, evolve and govern tokens, components and patterns so they stay consistent across Figma and code.
  • Structure and document the design system so developers and AI can use it reliably and efficiently.
  • Bring AI into the design workflow, using it for research synthesis, ideation, prototyping and production, and helping the wider team adopt it thoughtfully.
  • Document design decisions, patterns and best practices in a way both people and AI tools can use.

Who we are looking for

  • A portfolio demonstrating strong product design thinking, visual craft and impact on products shipped at scale.
  • 4+ years of Product Design experience, including time in a senior or lead role setting design direction for a product area.
  • Experience mentoring designers and influencing product and engineering stakeholders.
  • Hands-on experience using AI in your design practice, from ideation and prototyping to working with AI coding tools, and a considered point of view on where it helps and where it doesn't.
  • Deep experience building and maintaining design systems, including design tokens, component libraries and documentation, and keeping Figma and code in sync.
  • An understanding of what makes a design system usable by AI: structured tokens, consistent naming, well-defined component properties and clear usage guidance.
  • Expert UI and interaction design skills with a keen eye for detail.
  • A strong grasp of user-centred design and balancing user and business needs.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, and experience working in Agile product teams.
  • Experience designing AI-powered or personalised product experiences is a plus.

What we offer you

  • Generous annual leave policies aimed at promoting work-life balance.
  • Flexibility in working arrangements, offering hybrid or remote work options based on role requirements and location.
  • Matching pension schemes and/or 401k.
  • Comprehensive staff wellbeing initiatives, featuring regular activities and workplace programmes to support mental and physical health. This includes discounted ClassPass memberships and custom-fitted earplugs.
  • Company-led social events, team lunches, and discounts on RA merch.
  • Paid annual volunteering allowance, encouraging contributions to community projects and charities you care about.
  • Regular company-wide Q&As with senior leadership, along with ongoing virtual educational training sessions for all staff.
  • A transparent internal company culture committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion (see: https://ra.co/about/diversity).
  • Active involvement in community projects within the electronic music community (see: https://ra.co/about/community).

More about RA

We are independent and we intend to stay that way. 25 years in, RA answers to the culture it came from rather than to outside stakeholders. That is what enables us to make decisions on a long-term basis.

Our staff, contributors and international teams are not observers. They are part of the scenes we cover, and that is what we hire for. Craft first, and then a genuine stake in this music rather than just a job in it.

RA has been B Corp certified since 2024, which holds us to standards on social and environmental impact we would want to meet regardless of the badge.

We especially welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds, abilities, ethnicities, experiences, gender identities, and sexual orientations.

Our values

  • Electronic music is art.
  • We celebrate the progressive values that underpin electronic music.
  • We advocate for a more inclusive and equitable electronic music community.
  • We honour the past, present and future of electronic music.
  • We use innovation to empower the community.
  • We choose honesty over gain and purpose over profit.
  • We're always front left.

This role is a permanent position based in Berlin. Please note: This position requires applicants to be based in Berlin and to work from the office three days per week. The annual salary for this role is €50k–€60k. If you have questions about the role, please contact

Product strategy and vision

  • Track agreed product goals and KPIs, and recommend actions to improve performance.

Product management

  • Prioritise maintenance and improvement activities for your in-market products, to ensure continued relevance and positive customer experience.

New product development

  • Work proactively and collaboratively with teams across the business to ensure all aspects of product development, launch and in-market support are considered early in the business case and product design phase
  • Support the successful development and launch of new or updated products
  • Participate in all aspects of Product design, including: persona development; full end-to-end user journeys; service blueprints; key content and technical specifications
  • Design and manage the testing strategy for all products in development, to ensure they are consistently meeting the needs of our target audiences

Stakeholder collaboration

  • Contribute to pricing proposals for your product set by providing market, competitor and partner insight, and supporting the relevant internal teams in pricing decisions.
  • Engage with internal and external stakeholders to secure buy-in and understanding of the product vision.

What we look for:

  • Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, or related field.
  • Minimum of 3 years’ experience in a Product Manager or Product Owner role in one of the following sectors: education, training, professional qualifications (e.g. ACA / CIPD etc.)
  • Knowledge of PeopleCert best practices and ideally familiar with PRINCE2 or other similar PPM (project, programme and portfolio) certification products.
  • Proven track record of managing multiple products and delivering successful outcomes.
  • Demonstrable experience of managing products through their whole lifecycle
  • Familiarity with all elements of product development, from discovery to delivery
  • Proven ability to evaluate product feedback objectively, and propose solutions to address business needs
  • Strong business/commercial acumen
  • Excellent people and management skills to interact with colleagues, cross-functional teams, and third parties around the world
  • Problem-solving and analytical capabilities.
  • Prior exposure in Education, Consulting, Examination/Certification, or Technology sectors will be considered an asset.
  • Excellent command of the English language (C2 level certification desired; LanguageCert C2 LTE or C2 IESOL a plus).
  • Advanced computer literacy required; ECDL Advanced certification desirable. Familiarity with Microsoft Dynamics CRM or equivalent software will be considered an added advantage.

What we offer:

  • The opportunity to shape globally recognized frameworks used by professionals around the world.
  • A collaborative, high-impact international team and a purpose-driven working culture.
  • Flexible working conditions (location and hours).
  • Two free vouchers for all certifications from PeopleCert's Portfolio per year for all employees
  • Competitive compensation and personal development opportunities.
  • A global network of professionals and subject matter experts.

If you want to become a member of our international, dynamic and agile team that creates world leading software products, then we should certainly like to hear from you!

About PeopleCert

PeopleCert is a global leader in assessment and certification of professional skills, partnering with multi-national organizations and government bodies for the development & delivery of standardized exams. Delivering exams across 200 countries and in 25 languages over its state-of-the-art assessment technology, PeopleCert enables professionals to boost their careers and realize their life ambitions.

Quality, Innovation, Passion, Integrity, Clarity, and Velocity are the core values which guide everything we do.

Our offices in UK, Greece, and Cyprus boast a culture of diversity, where everyone is different, yet everyone fits in. All of us at PeopleCert are committed to the reflection of the diversity and inclusion of our customers and the communities in which we do business.

Working on Home Office (HO) Secure English Language Tests (SELTs)

Any person who is engaged by PeopleCert to work on the SELT service must undergo a Background Check (the results of which must be acceptable to PeopleCert and the HO) prior to commencing their SELT duties. All SELT personnel will be required to complete a declaration (provided by PeopleCert) where the existence of any criminal record and/or bankruptcy must be declared.

If working on the SELT service in the UK, background checks will include:

  • A basic or enhanced Disclosure Barring Service (DBS) check
  • Right to Work in the UK check (including nationality, identity and place of residence)
  • HO security check (Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS) or Counter Terrorist Check (CTC)
  • Financial background check
  • Employment reference check.
  • If working on the SELT service anywhere in the world (outside of the UK) personnel will undergo background checks that are equivalent to those stated for the UK.

In addition, if personnel are required to speak to SELT candidates they must be appropriately skilled in English language and, where SELT services are provided anywhere in the world (outside of the UK), the official language of the relevant country.

All applications will be treated with strict confidentiality.

wie zijn wij?

Cefetra Group bestaat uit verschillende handelsbedrijven die actief zijn binnen de agrarische sector en de voedingsingrediëntenindustrie, waaronder toonaangevende merken binnen de ingrediëntenmarkt. Samen hebben we ongeveer 800 medewerkers, verspreid over 39 kantoren in 17 landen wereldwijd.

We werken nauw met elkaar samen om onze klanten de best mogelijke service te bieden. Samen met onze leveranciers bouwen we sterke supply chains en creëren we waarde door grondstoffen in te kopen en te leveren aan de internationale voedingsmiddelen-, diervoedings- en energiesector.

Bekijk hier onze corporate video.

De stage

Als IT Support Stagiair(e) word je onderdeel van het IT-team en ondersteun je collega’s bij hun dagelijkse IT-vragen. Je bent het eerste aanspreekpunt voor gebruikers en helpt bij het oplossen van technische problemen, zowel op afstand als op kantoor. Hierdoor krijg je een goed beeld van hoe IT-support binnen een internationale organisatie werkt.

Tijdens je stage houd je je onder andere bezig met:

  • Het bieden van eerstelijns IT-support en oplossen van hardware-, software- en netwerkproblemen;

  • Het beheren van gebruikersaccounts, wachtwoorden, licenties en apparaten;

  • Het installeren, configureren en uitgeven van laptops en mobiele telefoons;

  • Het registreren en opvolgen van incidenten en aanvragen via het ticketsysteem.

Daarnaast werk je samen met ervaren IT-specialisten aan projecten op het gebied van infrastructuur, werkplekbeheer en procesverbetering. Hierdoor ontwikkel je niet alleen je technische vaardigheden, maar leer je ook hoe IT een belangrijke bijdrage levert aan de dagelijkse werkzaamheden binnen een internationale handelsorganisatie.

Tijdens je stage maak je ook kennis met de technologieën en systemen die binnen onze IT-omgeving worden gebruikt. Je werkt met Microsoft 365, Azure, Active Directory, Intune en Windows Server voor het beheren van gebruikers, apparaten en applicaties. Daarnaast doe je ervaring op met Cisco Meraki voor netwerkbeheer, Citrix voor virtuele werkplekken en applicaties, VMware voor gevirtualiseerde serveromgevingen en TeamViewer voor ondersteuning op afstand.

Zo krijg je een brede kijk op zowel moderne cloudoplossingen als traditionele IT-infrastructuur.

Wie ben jij?

jobs.title: Junior Gis/GEO Tester
jobs.description:
Je bent nieuwsgierig, werkt nauwkeurig en vindt het interessant om uit te zoeken hoe systemen en data werken. Je hebt oog voor detail en krijgt er energie van om te ontdekken waar iets beter of slimmer kan. Een combinatie van IT, testen en geografische informatie spreekt je aan. Dan is deze functie als Junior GIS/GEO Tester iets voor jou.

Wat ga je doen als Junior GIS/GEO Tester?

Als Junior GIS/GEO Tester ga je aan de slag binnen een professioneel IT-team dat werkt met geografische informatie en GEO-applicaties. Je helpt mee om te zorgen dat applicaties, functionaliteiten en data goed werken voordat deze in gebruik worden genomen.

Je leert hoe je testgevallen opstelt, functionaliteiten controleert en resultaten analyseert. Je werkt daarbij met GIS/GEO-systemen en leert steeds meer over geografische data, applicaties en de technische omgeving daarachter.

Concreet zijn jouw werkzaamheden

  • Opstellen en uitvoeren van testgevallen voor GIS/GEO-applicaties

  • Controleren of nieuwe functionaliteiten werken zoals bedoeld

  • Testen van geografische data en controleren op juistheid en volledigheid

  • Analyseren en documenteren van testresultaten

  • Signaleren, reproduceren en vastleggen van fouten en afwijkingen

  • Meedenken over hoe applicaties en processen verbeterd kunnen worden

  • Samenwerken met ontwikkelaars, functioneel beheerders en andere IT-specialisten

  • Ondersteunen bij regressietesten en het testen van nieuwe releases

  • Werken met GIS/GEO-tools en je verder ontwikkelen in het vakgebied

Je hoeft nog niet alles te kunnen. Juist tijdens het traineeship leer je hoe je gestructureerd test, hoe je fouten onderzoekt en hoe je steeds zelfstandiger wordt in het werken met GIS/GEO-systemen. Heb je al kennis van GIS, geografische data, softwaretesten of bijvoorbeeld SQL? Dan is dat mooi meegenomen.

Ook als je vooral een sterke interesse hebt in IT en GEO en graag wilt leren, komen we graag met je in contact.


Wat kun je verwachten van het traineeship?

Je start met een onboarding in Bunnik. Hier leer je samen met andere trainees de basis van IT en ontwikkel je vaardigheden die je direct kunt toepassen in je opdracht. Tijdens het tweejarige traineeship krijg je volop ruimte om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen en je te verdiepen in GIS/GEO, testen en andere IT-onderwerpen die bij jou passen.

Je krijgt begeleiding van een People Manager die regelmatig met je meekijkt naar je ontwikkeling, leerdoelen en carrière. Daarnaast behaal je verschillende trainingen en erkende certificaten, zodat je niet alleen ervaring opdoet in de praktijk, maar ook werkt aan een stevig fundament voor je verdere IT-carrière.

Dit bieden wij jou

  • Een tweejarig IT-traineeship met veel ruimte voor persoonlijke en professionele ontwikkeling

  • Een startsalaris van €2.600 tot €2.800

  • Direct een vast contract

  • Jaarlijks een evaluatiemoment met de mogelijkheid om je salaris met maximaal €500 te verhogen

  • 25 vakantiedagen en vakantiegeld

  • Een passende reiskostenvergoeding

  • Verschillende trainingen en erkende IT-certificaten

  • Persoonlijke begeleiding van een People Manager

  • Een jong en energiek team met regelmatig leuke activiteiten en borrels

Dit vragen wij van jou

  • Je hebt een afgeronde HBO- of WO-opleiding, bijvoorbeeld in de richting van IT, Geo-informatie, Geografie, GIS, Data, Informatica of een vergelijkbare richting

  • Je hebt interesse in softwaretesten, GIS/GEO en IT

Je beweegt je op het snijvlak van AI, data, architectuur en strategie. Daarbij werk je samen met verschillende teams en stakeholders en vertaal je organisatiedoelen naar technische mogelijkheden. Je krijgt te maken met onderwerpen als generative AI, machine learning, data governance, security en integratie.

Concreet zijn jouw werkzaamheden:

  • Het ontwikkelen en verder uitwerken van een visie op AI binnen de organisatie

  • Het ontwerpen en beheren van AI-architecturen, referentiearchitecturen en roadmaps

  • Het vertalen van businessdoelen naar AI-capabilities, technische ontwerpen en architectuurkaders

  • Het adviseren over de toepassing van generative AI, machine learning en data-oplossingen

  • Het beoordelen van solution designs en toetsen of deze aansluiten op de gewenste architectuur

  • Het verbinden van AI met bestaande data-, bedrijfs- en IT-architecturen

  • Het volgen van ontwikkelingen op het gebied van AI, LLM's, MLOps en nieuwe AI-technologie

Je hoeft niet op ieder onderdeel specialist te zijn. We zoeken iemand die al een stevige basis heeft binnen architectuur, data en/of AI en zich verder wil ontwikkelen richting een brede AI-architectuurrol. Je volgt trainingen en behaalt relevante certificaten die aansluiten bij jouw ontwikkelrichting. Daarnaast krijg je persoonlijke begeleiding van een people manager waarmee je werkt aan je professionele en persoonlijke ontwikkeling.

Omdat je al relevante werkervaring hebt, ligt de nadruk binnen dit traject op verdere verdieping en specialisatie. Samen kijken we welke richting binnen AI, data en architectuur het beste aansluit bij jouw ambities.

jobs.title: Senior Legal Counsel - Product & AI (Part-time)
jobs.description:
Amsterdam (hybrid) | Part-time (freelance) 8 hours a week | €2,000 to €2,500 per month


Foleon is a leading content creation platform providing business teams with a fast and scalable way to produce highly-engaging content experiences that bring a new level of intelligence to their customer journeys.

Foleon is based in Amsterdam and New York and serves more than 1,200 global B2B brands. We value people who are bold, ambitious, collaborative, and customer-centric. Even better, the ones who know how to work hard and have fun at the same time. We’re a team of highly driven people, with a great sense of human connection and a clear focus.

Your Mission

As our Senior Product & AI Counsel, you’ll own the legal side of our product and AI proposition, working with us about one day a week on a retainer basis. It’s a new role. You’ll work closely with Product, Engineering and leadership to make sure what we build and ship holds up under the EU AI Act, cybersecurity law, digital accessibility rules and GDPR.

Your Job

  • Act as our product counsel: join product syncs, review features before they’re built, and flag legal and compliance questions early.

  • Lead compliance for our AI proposition: classify our AI use cases, map our obligations as a provider or deployer under the EU AI Act, and set up the documentation, transparency and governance it requires.

  • Make sure our platform, and the content our customers publish with it, meets the European Accessibility Act and related standards.

  • Build privacy into the product by advising on GDPR questions tied to new features and data.

  • Advise on cybersecurity law, including NIS2, the Cyber Resilience Act and incident reporting duties, working closely with our security team.

  • Track changes in AI, cybersecurity, accessibility and privacy regulation, and turn them into practical guidance for the team.


Your Competencies & Skills

  • Senior and independent: you make calls and own them, without someone steering you.

  • A practical communicator who explains complex regulation to product teams in plain language, with answers instead of memos full of caveats.

  • Proactive and curious: you spot gaps before they become problems and want to understand how the product actually works.

  • Comfortable working part-time and flexibly, and available when something urgent comes up.

Your Qualifications

  • A Master’s in Law (or equivalent) and 6+ years of experience, ideally a mix of law firm and in-house at a tech or SaaS company.

  • Hands-on experience as product counsel for software, ideally including AI products.

  • Deep working knowledge of the EU AI Act and how it applies to AI propositions in practice.

  • Experience with cybersecurity law (NIS2, Cyber Resilience Act) and digital accessibility rules (European Accessibility Act).

  • A solid grounding in commercial and corporate law, with working knowledge of employment law.

  • GDPR and privacy expertise is a plus, ideally at DPO level or with a certification such as CIPP/E.

  • Experience working with scale-ups on a retainer or fractional basis is a plus.

  • Fluent English. Dutch is a plus.

Note: All our hiring is done in-house, so we’re not looking for agency support for this role. Thanks for understanding!

Je verdiept je altijd eerst in ‘de bedoeling’. Wat willen we bij wie bereiken en wat is daarvoor nodig? Je adviseert over de communicatieaanpak bij projecten, veranderingen en andere organisatieontwikkelingen. En ook mooi: je krijgt de ruimte om zelf verdere vorm te geven aan je functie. Deze is namelijk nieuw en daarmee nog in beweging.

Waar kom je te werken?

Jouw werkplek vind je in ons splinternieuw en moderne hoofdkantoor in ’s-Hertogenbosch, dicht bij het Provinciehuis. Maar thuiswerken is ook helemaal onderdeel van onze cultuur. De sfeer is informeel. Werken in jeans en op sneakers vinden we de normaalste zaak van de wereld. We geven je ruimte om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen vanuit je eigen expertise en werken vanuit vertrouwen en samenwerking. Zo maken we samen communicatie die helder, relevant en effectief is.

Je draagt zorg voor een levendig en informatief intranet, organiseert inspirerende interne bijeenkomsten en zorgt voor een consistente stroom van boeiende updates en nieuws.

Wat willen we sowieso terugzien op je cv?

Wie zijn wij?

jobs.title: Global Mobility Manager
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Imagine being the person who makes a move across the world feel easy. A candidate in Sydney gets a visa on a timeline they can plan around. A teammate relocating to Tokyo has a clear playbook, a human to talk to, and nothing to chase. A leader opening a brand-new market has a partner who can map the laws, entities, and employment models.



That's the job. At Notion, we build tools that change how people work together, no matter where they are. As our Global Mobility Manager, you'll build the bridges that make that true for our own team: immigration, relocation, and global expansion, all in one program that you shape, own, and scale.



This is a rare chance to take a working foundation, with playbooks, policies, and vendors already in place, and elevate it. You'll shape the policies and run the cases. You'll partner with People, Talent Acquisition, Legal, Finance, Accounting, and Tax, with dotted-line support from our shared services model in People Operations, so you're building alongside a team, not on an island. And you'll use AI and automation to turn a historically manual, paper-heavy function into something elegant. If you love fast-moving environments and turning solid foundations into great systems, you'll feel at home here.



This role is based in San Francisco or New York. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Own mobility, end to end
   
   - Own immigration and relocation across hiring, transfers, rotations, and assignments, backed by clear policies and playbooks
   
   - Shorten time-to-visa and time-to-move through streamlined intake, approvals, SLAs, and vendor management
   
   - Guide candidates, employees, and managers with empathetic, concise communication and self-serve resources
   
   Power global expansion
   
   - Support our expansion into new markets by:
     
     - Researching and ensuring compliance with local employment laws and regulations
     
     - Partnering with Legal and Finance to establish new state registrations, entity structures, and employment models
     
     - Helping general managers and People Partners design the strategy and program for talent mobility into new markets
   
   Build the partnerships and the program
   
   - Build deep partnerships with People, Talent Acquisition, Legal, Finance, Accounting, and Tax to ship complex immigration and relocation cases quickly and compliantly
   
   - Be a mobility thought partner and help shape our internal mobility strategy
   
   - Benchmark our policies against internal feedback and external market standards, and spot opportunities to improve
   
   Make it visible and make it automatic
   
   - Build dashboards that show volume, cycle time, cost per move, tax exposure, and compliance posture
   
   - Use technology, AI, and system integrations to eliminate manual work and automate routine tasks




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - You have 6–8+ years in global mobility, immigration, or international HR, across multiple regions

 - You've built and scaled a global mobility strategy that supports cross-border talent

 - You've owned a program end to end: policy design, vendor selection, and measurable outcomes in fast-paced environments

 - You know mobility tax well: shadow payroll, equity implications, and permanent establishment risk

 - You have a systems mindset and are comfortable using AI and automation to remove manual work safely

 - You're comfortable with the compliance side of expansion: local employment law, entity setup, and employment models

 - You have excellent judgment and discretion, and your writing is concise enough to help partners move fast

 - You take ownership and run with it. You have real agency: you spot what needs to happen, act with urgency, and drive it to done without waiting to be asked

 - You know how to influence leaders. You bring data, a clear point of view, and a recommendation to senior stakeholders and help them make fast, confident decisions on mobility and expansion

 - You're direct and kind. You have strong opinions, loosely held, and you like to collaborate

 - Bonus: you've supported a company through its first international expansions or entities



Don't tick every box? Apply anyway. If you're a builder at heart, share our values, and get excited about making software toolmaking ubiquitous, we want to hear from you.






Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $174,000 - $200,000.

A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Knowledge Engine  – Data Infrastructure
jobs.description:
The Knowledge Platform team builds Exa's knowledge engine. We continuously synthesize information from across the web and beyond into one of the world's largest open-domain knowledge graphs, with hundreds of billions of evidence-backed claims. The work has two halves: construction pipelines that decide what to trust, and retrieval engines that decide how best to search it. Our goal is to give agents answers to any factual question about the world with unprecedented precision and completeness.

In this role, you'll build the knowledge construction pipelines: turning everything from a 100k docs/s web crawl to vendor datasets into a graph of what is true about the world, and keeping it correct as data changes.

This is greenfield work with a massive scope. There is no off-the-shelf system for building a model of the world from the open web, so you'll make foundational decisions, from how claims are represented and resolved to how trust is assigned and how the graph evolves over time, that everything built on top of it depends on.

What you'll do

  • Continuously synthesize the live web crawl, vendor deliveries and APIs, and other off-the-web sources into one typed graph: extraction that turns pages and records into ontology-shaped claims, each carrying its provenance, timestamp and confidence.

  • Bring every new source in cleanly: versioned, append-only history with schema evolution, late-arriving and corrected records, and replayable cursors, so every claim traces back to the exact delivery that produced it.

  • Decide what to trust: entity resolution across billions of records (blocking, pairwise scoring, clustering) into canonical people, companies, places and publications, then truth discovery that weighs source reliability, recency and corroboration to reconcile conflicting claims.

  • Keep that picture current and convergent: streams arrive continuously, out of order and at very different rates, so the graph is eventually consistent by design. You'll build incremental computation over change data feeds, where each update is a diff of what changed and every job is idempotent and resumable, so the graph converges to the same state however runs interleave, fail or replay, and readers only ever see committed, consistent versions.

  • Measure precision and completeness: labeled evals for extraction and resolution, per-source coverage and correctness metrics, and lineage that pinpoints which source or stage broke and why.

What we're looking for

  • You've built and operated large-scale distributed data pipelines in production over petabytes of structured and unstructured data, with Spark over a lakehouse format (Delta Lake, Iceberg, Hudi).

  • You understand incremental processing deeply: change data capture, idempotent writes, backfills and reprocessing.

  • Strong in Python and at least one systems language; you can read and tune Spark query plans.

  • You obsess over correctness, reliability and data quality as much as scale.

Bonus

  • Entity resolution, record linkage, knowledge graphs or ontologies

  • Information extraction or truth discovery at scale

  • Lance or other columnar/vector-native formats

Example projects

  • Take a new billion-row dataset from first delivery to queryable entities in days, not months.

  • Keep a graph of hundreds of billions of claims current with incremental updates, so a fact that changes on the web reaches it in minutes.

  • Build a system that knows every company and person in the world, with one evidence-backed record each, resolved across the web and every source we ingest.

 - A real point of view on pricing and packaging, or the appetite to build one fast. You can reason about plans, tiers, and value, not just features and launches.

 - Strong cross-functional skills, comfortable coordinating Product, Design, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing toward one outcome.

 - Genuine passion for shaping the future of work with AI, a growth mindset, and a scrappy, high-ownership approach to getting things done.
