jobs.title: Field Marketing Manager, Europe
jobs.description:
At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires.

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 50,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.

Field marketing at Linear is just getting started. Its job is to put us in front of the right people in the right room: executive dinners, conferences, partner events, and programs built with our Customer team around named accounts.

We're hiring our first Field Marketing Manager in Europe to take that motion from strategy to execution. You'll own the executive dinner calendar across cities, decide which third-party events and partner programs are worth our time, and build the invitations and follow-up that help our sellers turn a good evening into a real conversation. This is a hands-on role. You'll tap your venue and vendor network, build the run of show for each program, and be on site to run it.

Location & work mode

Linear is a remote-first company, with optional co-working offices in San Francisco, New York, and London. This role is open to candidates based in Europe, with London preferred. You can work from anywhere within this region. We value deep focus and async collaboration, with intentional moments to connect in person through team off-sites, optional co-working, and occasional travel. This role involves frequent travel for events, including evenings.

What you’ll do

 - Own the executive dinner calendar across cities: pick the city, the venue, the date, and the theme for each dinner

 - Build each guest list with our Customer team, equip sellers with invitation sequences, and track RSVPs so every seat goes to someone worth having there

 - Manage venues and vendors, negotiate menus and minimums, and keep per-dinner spend, contracts, and travel logistics within budget

 - Brief our hosts and executives on who's attending and what we want to learn, be on site to run the night, and hand follow-ups to Sales afterward

 - Evaluate conferences and sponsorship offers by audience quality, account coverage, and expected return, then plan how we show up: booth or no booth, side dinners, customer meetings, and speaking slots

 - Co-host dinners, workshops, and meetups with partners, and agree up front on guest lists, costs, and who follows up

 - Sit with Sales each quarter to pick target accounts, build lightweight formats an AE can request for a key account, and report on attendance, meetings held, pipeline influenced, and feedback from attendees and account owners

What we’re looking for

 - 3+ years in field marketing, event marketing, or B2B events, ideally at a software company. Experience in developer tools, SaaS, or another technical product is a plus

 - A track record of running dinners, roundtables, or other small-format events end to end, plus experience planning around conferences: sponsorships, side events, and customer meetings

 - Experience working next to Sales. You know how to build a target account list, get an AE to care about an event, and tell them afterward what happened

 - Strong project management. You can run several cities and events at once without dropping details

 - Comfort with budgets, vendor contracts, and a spreadsheet. Hands-on time with HubSpot and event attribution is a plus

 - Clear writing and an easy way with senior guests, hosts, and partners. Experience marketing to engineering and product leaders is a bonus

 - Experience building an event series from the ground up, including a playbook someone else could run

 - Willingness to travel often, including evenings

What we offer

We're a small, focused team that cares deeply about the quality of our work and the people we do it with. Here's what you can expect:

 - Competitive salary and equity

 - Employee-friendly equity terms

 - Daily meal and coffee stipend on every workday

 - Paid co-working space or desk

 - Health coverage (based on country requirements)

 - 5 weeks paid vacation, plus local statutory holidays

 - 4 months paid parental leave

 - Paid month off after 4 years & every 2 years thereafter

 - Regular team events and off-sites

jobs.title: Principal Strategic Sourcing Lead - Technology
Engineering Manager, Security (Cloud, Infrastructure & Application Security)
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.

About the role:

We are looking for an Engineering Manager, Security to lead the teams that secure our cloud, our infrastructure, and the code we ship. You will manage two closely linked groups:

 - Cloud & Infrastructure Security: engineers who own cloud security posture, configuration hardening, and infrastructure vulnerability management across GCP, AWS, and Azure, plus containers, Kubernetes, and SaaS platforms.

 - Application Security & Secure SDLC: engineers who run our SCA, SAST, and IaC scanning programs, drive remediation with engineering teams, and deliver secure development training.

The core responsibility of this role is getting vulnerabilities fixed on time. You will partner with engineering teams across the company to drive remediation of cloud, infrastructure, and code findings within SLA, so that we consistently meet our compliance commitments (SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, FedRAMP, and customer contracts). You will hire and grow a high-performing team, set the strategy and roadmap for vulnerability management from code to cloud, and make secure-by-default the easiest path for every developer. You will not run incident response yourself, but you need to understand it well enough to support the incident response team with context, prioritization, and follow-up fixes.

 

What You'll Do:


TEAM LEADERSHIP & STRATEGY

 - Build, lead, and mentor a team of cloud security, infrastructure vulnerability management, and application security engineers; own hiring, career development, and performance management.

 - Define the multi-year roadmap and quarterly OKRs for cloud security, vulnerability management, and Secure SDLC, balancing risk reduction against developer velocity.

 - Set clear ownership, operating rhythms, and on-call/escalation processes across the team.

 - Report on security posture, risk trends, and program metrics to engineering and executive leadership.


REMEDIATION & COMPLIANCE DELIVERY

 - Own remediation SLAs by severity across cloud, infrastructure, container, and code findings, and make sure they map to our compliance obligations (SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, FedRAMP, customer contracts).

 - Partner with engineering managers and tech leads to plan, prioritize, and land fixes within SLA without stalling roadmaps.

 - Run a regular remediation review with engineering leadership: open findings, SLA burn-down, upcoming SLA breaches, and owners.

 - Manage the exception and risk-acceptance process: documented justification, compensating controls, expiry dates, and approvals.

 - Build automated workflows that route findings to the right owning team, track them to closure, and escalate before SLAs are breached.

 - Work with Compliance/GRC to produce audit-ready evidence of remediation timeliness, and lead the security side of external audits for vulnerability management controls.

 - Track and report metrics such as SLA attainment, mean time to remediate, backlog age, and exceptions, by team and severity.


CLOUD & INFRASTRUCTURE SECURITY

 - Lead infrastructure vulnerability management across cloud workloads, containers, registries, data stores, and platform services, from scanning and contextual risk triage to remediation workflows.

 - Oversee configuration hardening and secure baselines across GCP (primary) and supporting AWS and Azure environments.

 - Own the strategy for Cloud, Kubernetes, and Data Security Posture Management (CSPM, KSPM, DSPM) tooling; make sure findings are accurate, prioritized, and actionable.

 - Secure critical SaaS platforms with sound configurations, access controls, and integrations.

 - Partner with Platform and ML Infrastructure teams to secure multi-tenant and AI infrastructure.


APPLICATION SECURITY & CODE SCANNING

 - Own the SCA, SAST, and IaC scanning programs end to end: tool selection, CI/CD integration, rule tuning, noise reduction, and developer experience.

 - Drive software supply chain security, including dependency management, SBOMs, artifact signing, and progress through SLSA levels.

 - Feed code-scanning findings into the central remediation workflow so they reach the owning team automatically and are tracked against SLA.

 - Shift IaC security left so misconfigurations are caught in pull requests, before they reach production.


SECURE SDLC & DEVELOPER ENABLEMENT

 - Define and run the Secure SDLC program: security requirements, threat modeling, secure design reviews, and release gates proportionate to risk.

 - Build and deliver security training, including onboarding, role-based secure coding training, and targeted sessions driven by real vulnerability trends.

 - Develop paved roads, secure defaults, and guardrails that make the secure path the easiest path for engineers.

 - Grow a Security Champions network across engineering teams.


INCIDENT RESPONSE PARTNERSHIP & COLLABORATION

 - Understand the incident response lifecycle well enough to support the IR team: supply asset, exposure, and vulnerability context, and help assess blast radius.

 - Own follow-up remediation from incidents and postmortems that touch cloud, infrastructure, or code, and track it to closure.

 - Feed incident learnings back into scanning rules, secure baselines, and developer training.

 - Collaborate with Security Monitoring/Detection, Incident Response, Offensive Security, PSIRT, Architecture, DevOps, and Platform Engineering.

 - Help communicate security advisories, best practices, and updates to customers.

 - Tune into threat intelligence alerts to promptly manage patching of critical, exploitable vulnerabilities.

 

Required Skills & Experience:

 - 8+ years in security engineering, cloud security, or DevSecOps, including 2+ years managing security engineers (or 3+ years as a tech lead with formal people-leadership responsibility).

 - Deep, hands-on knowledge of cloud security in GCP plus working knowledge of AWS and/or Azure: IAM, networking, logging, org policies, and security services.

 - Proven track record running vulnerability management programs at scale and driving remediation across many engineering teams to meet SLAs, across cloud infrastructure, containers, and application code.

 - Hands-on experience with CSPM/CNAPP platforms (e.g., Wiz, Orca, Prisma Cloud, Lacework, GCP Security Command Center).

 - Hands-on experience with SCA, SAST, and IaC scanning tools (e.g., Snyk, Semgrep, CodeQL, Checkmarx, Socket, Dependabot, Checkov, tfsec) and integrating them into CI/CD.

 - Strong understanding of Kubernetes and container security, and Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform or similar).

 - Proven track record of building or maturing a Secure SDLC program, including developer security training.

 - Ability to write and review code or automation (Python, Go, TypeScript, or similar).

 - Strong understanding of how remediation SLAs and security controls map to compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, FedRAMP, CIS, NIST), and experience producing audit evidence.

 - Working understanding of security incident response in cloud-native environments, enough to partner effectively with IR and detection teams.

 - Excellent communication skills, with the ability to influence engineering leaders and explain risk in business terms.



Bonus Qualifications:

 - Experience securing developer platforms, multi-tenant SaaS, or AI/ML infrastructure.

 - Experience with software supply chain frameworks (SLSA, Sigstore, SBOM standards).

 - Experience building a Security Champions program or developer-facing security tooling.

 - Experience leading the security side of external audits (SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, or FedRAMP).

 - Relevant certifications (e.g., CCSP, GCP Professional Cloud Security Engineer, OSCP, CSSLP), though not required.



Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


About the role:

Make Replit the single place where businesses can buy everything they need through their agents. As a Staff Software Engineer on Replit’s Money team, you’ll set technical direction and build the commerce platform that lets users discover, evaluate, purchase, and manage the products and services they need to build and run their businesses—without leaving Replit.

 

Replit already enables businesses to accept payments through integrations such as Stripe. This role builds on that foundation to expand what businesses can buy and accomplish through Replit Agent. You’ll design commerce experiences that combine the simplicity consumers expect with the controls enterprises need, making agent-assisted purchasing useful, trustworthy, and reliable.

 

You’ll own architecture and lead cross-team delivery across merchant and service-provider integrations, agent tools, purchasing workflows, and the lifecycle after a transaction. The challenge goes beyond executing a payment: agents need to understand what a user wants, present clear choices and costs, act within delegated authority, and verify that the purchase delivered the intended outcome. You’ll stay hands-on with design and code while aligning partners, mentoring engineers, and turning an ambitious product vision into incremental customer value.


You will:

 - Set technical direction for Replit’s financial infrastructure, with an immediate focus on enterprise billing, spend controls, and financial correctness.

 - Build shared services for usage-based billing, pricing, credits, subscriptions, and entitlements so product teams can launch without rebuilding billing.

 - Automate enterprise contract lifecycles—from onboarding through amendments and renewals—keeping commercial terms, provisioned credits, and invoices in sync.

 - Build timely budget enforcement, alerts, and overrides that give customers control over spend without disrupting their hosted apps.

 - Make AI usage understandable: attribute costs to the right customer, workspace, user, or agent, including delegated work without double-counting.

 - Build reconciliation and audit trails that make balances and invoices explainable and help Finance catch discrepancies before customers do.

 - Simplify the billing stack through safe migrations that preserve balances, transaction history, and customer access.

 - Own production reliability through testing, observability, incident response, and safe recovery from duplicate events, delayed usage, and partial failures.

 - Stay hands-on while leading cross-team delivery, mentoring engineers, and partnering with Product, Finance, Sales, and Support.


Required skills and experience:

 - A track record of Staff-level technical ownership: setting architecture and delivering complex initiatives across teams.

 - Deep experience building and operating production backend or distributed systems.

 - Strong fundamentals in API design, data modeling, databases, and event-driven architecture.

 - Sound judgment around transactions, consistency, concurrency, idempotency, and failure recovery.

 - Experience evolving live systems and migrating data without compromising correctness or availability.

 - Product judgment that balances customer needs, delivery speed, and long-term system quality.

 - Clear communication with technical and non-technical partners, including translating business requirements into system behavior.

 - Hands-on leadership through implementation, design reviews, mentoring, and production ownership.


Preferred Qualifications

 - Experience with billing, payments, subscriptions, credits, entitlements, or other financial systems.

 - Experience with enterprise contracts, negotiated pricing, invoicing, or quote-to-cash automation.

 - Experience with high-volume usage metering, pricing calculations, or low-latency spend controls.

 - Experience building reconciliation, financial reporting, or auditable transaction histories with Finance and Accounting.

 - Experience integrating billing, payment, or CRM platforms, with judgment about what to build versus buy.

 

Bonus Points:

 - Experience with AI or cloud infrastructure billing, including variable costs and attribution across distributed workloads.

 - Experience building customer-facing spend visibility, budgets, or internal tools that reduce manual billing work.

 - Experience with cloud marketplace billing, payment recovery, or fraud and dispute workflows.

 - Familiarity with agentic commerce or delegated spending. These are additional strengths, not requirements.



What we value:

 - Customer outcomes: success means a business can get what it needs through its agent, with clear costs and a verified result—not merely a completed API call.

 - User control and trust: agents act within explicit authority, surface consequential choices, and make purchases and ongoing commitments understandable.

 - Consumer simplicity and enterprise readiness: straightforward experiences should coexist with the controls organizations need.

 - End-to-end ownership: we own the experience from intent through purchase, fulfillment, and ongoing management.

 - Pragmatic technical leadership: we build on what exists, deliver incremental value, and invest in correctness and extensibility where they matter.

 - Clear collaboration: we document decisions, surface risks early, and help other teams and partners succeed.



Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

💰 Competitive Salary & Equity

💹 401(k) Program with a 4% match (US Only)

⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance

🩼 Short Term and Long Term Disability

🚼 Paid Parental, Medical, Caregiver Leave

🏝 Flexible Time Off (FTO) + Holidays

🚗 Commuter Benefits  (In-Office & US Only)

📱 Monthly Wellness Stipend

🧑‍💻 Autonomous Work Environment

🖥 In Office Set-Up Reimbursement (In-Office Only)

🚀 Quarterly Team Gatherings

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Web Infrastructure
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Web Infrastructure builds the foundations behind Notion’s web clients so product engineers can ship fast, reliable, accessible experiences. As a junior engineer on the team, you’ll help make those experiences measurably faster and more resilient. You’ll investigate performance bottlenecks, improve how the client loads and responds, and help build tools that catch regressions earlier. You don’t need to arrive as a performance expert; we’re looking for strong fundamentals, curiosity, and a desire to learn by shipping useful work.

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Use browser tools and real-world data to investigate page-load and interaction bottlenecks, then turn findings into focused improvements.

 - Help build or improve performance tests, dashboards, and guardrails that make regressions easier to catch during development and rollout.

 - Ship scoped improvements to client loading, rendering, asset delivery, or caching, measuring their impact and checking for regressions.

 - Partner with Web Infrastructure and product engineers to land changes safely across Notion’s web clients.

 - Document what you learn and share clear recommendations so teams can make better performance tradeoffs.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Solid programming fundamentals and some experience building software with JavaScript or TypeScript; familiarity with React or another component-based UI framework is helpful.

 - Curiosity about how browsers work and how code affects page load, rendering, and interaction responsiveness.

 - A thoughtful debugging approach: you can break a problem down, gather evidence, and ask for help when you’re stuck.

 - Clear, kind communication and an interest in collaborating across teams.

 - Intellectual curiosity about AI-enabled engineering tools; you use them thoughtfully and review their output critically.

Experience with performance profiling, browser developer tools, React profiling, bundlers, code splitting, service workers, asset caching, or performance testing is a plus—not a prerequisite. We welcome candidates who are excited about the work even if they don’t match every bullet.



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $150,000 - $168,000 per year.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550?pvs=74 and NYLL 144 https://notion.notion.site/Ashby-AI-Bias-Audit-2b0efdeead05803bbbfae159ec86c528.



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. About the Client

Our client is a leading global management consultancy known for tackling some of the worldâs most complex business challenges. With a focus on strategy, transformation, and performance improvement, the firm partners with major organizations across industries to drive lasting impact.

Â 

About the Project & Role

We are looking for a Senior AI Engineer to help design, build, and evolve an AI-powered conversational analytics platform that enables businesses to explore their data, generate insights and visualizations, and make data-driven decisions.

The product helps users analyze promotional performance, answer complex analytical questions, build charts and tables, and generate evidence-based recommendations using LLMs, agentic workflows, and governed client data.

The team is developing a scalable, secure, and extensible agentic AI framework that can be customized for different clients and integrated with other products through standards such as Model Context Protocol (MCP). The existing solution is built on LangChain, with plans to evolve and migrate the framework.

This is a hands-on engineering role with a significant architecture and system design component. You will work across the entire agentic AI lifecycle, from designing agent workflows, tools, and integrations to implementing evaluation frameworks, improving reliability, and delivering production-ready AI features.

Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and evolve agentic AI workflows for data exploration, analysis, and conversational insights.

  • Develop and improve an extensible agentic framework, including orchestration, reusable tools, skills, and conversation management.

  • Build secure integrations with application services and governed data sources, including sandboxed code execution and AI-powered data visualizations.

  • Design configurable solutions supporting client-specific prompts, tools, skills, and data definitions without duplicating the core architecture.

  • Develop MCP servers and clients to enable communication and data exchange between agents and applications.

  • Contribute to architectural decisions and the evolution and migration of the existing LangChain-based solution.

  • Implement LLM evaluation, testing, observability, and security controls to ensure accurate, reliable, and data-grounded AI outputs.

  • Own features end to end, from technical design and implementation to production release and continuous improvement, collaborating with cross-functional teams.

Essential Knowledge, Skills & Experience

Core Requirements

  • 6+ years of experience in software engineering, data analytics, or related fields, including 2+ years in agentic AI engineering.

  • Strong Python development skills, with experience building, testing, and maintaining production-grade applications.

  • Hands-on experience building agentic AI systems using frameworks such as Pydantic AI, LangGraph, LangChain, or OpenAI Agents SDK.

  • Strong understanding of agentic patterns, including tool calling, multi-step orchestration, context management, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop workflows.

  • Experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) and multi-agent or cross-application integrations.

  • Experience developing AI agents for data analysis, including dataset exploration, code generation and execution, and result interpretation.

  • Strong system design and architecture skills, including building configurable, extensible solutions and evaluating technical trade-offs.

  • Understanding of AI security, evaluation, and observability, including secure data access, LLM testing, tracing, and performance monitoring.

  • Strong ownership, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills, with practical experience using AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Codex, or similar).

Strongly Preferred

  • Experience with Pydantic AI / Pydantic AI Harness and LangChain, particularly migration between frameworks.

  • Familiarity with SQL, pandas, DuckDB, or Ibis for data analysis.

  • Experience with Azure OpenAI, Docker, and analytical visualization tools such as Plotly or Dash.

Nice-to-Have

  • Experience with retail, pricing, promotions analytics, or similar domains.

  • Experience delivering client-facing AI products from prototype to production.

  • Familiarity with React and FastAPI.

Interview Process

  1. Interview with GT Recruiter

  2. Cultural Fit Interview

  3. Technical Interview

  4. Final Interview

  5. Offer

Why Join Our Client?

  • Join a globally recognized consulting firm building innovative AI-powered products that solve real business problems.

  • Help shape the architecture and technical direction of an evolving agentic AI platform.

  • Build production AI solutions where accuracy, data security, and reliability are essential.

  • Work with modern AI technologies and development tools, including Pydantic AI, MCP, Claude Code, Cursor, and OpenAI Codex.

  • Collaborate with experienced engineers and product teams in an environment that encourages experimentation, continuous improvement, and technical ownership.

jobs.title: Revenue Cycle Manager
jobs.description:
About Us

We are fixing US healthcare by building an AI-native physical care platform, starting with home health.

Home health is a $140B industry with less than $10B in EBITDA â 40% of revenue is spent on pure administrative waste. We automate this work with AI, creating a fundamentally different cost structure compared to incumbents. This lets us rapidly take market share by serving the 30% of patients who go untreated today.

By reshaping the cost structure of this industry, we unlock its growth.

We've built one of the best AI teams in the world (from Character AI, Scale, Palantir, Citadel, Jane Street) and paired them with a team of healthcare veterans to build a new type of healthcare company: one that delivers care at the speed of an AI company.

Our physical care platform already operates with 30pp higher gross margins than traditional home health providers. With our AI advantage, we pay nurses more, remove their admin burden, and unlock the scale economics that have been missing from this fragmented industry. If we served this entire $140B market, instead of $10B in EBITDA, we'd drive $60B.

We're starting with home health, then expanding to all delivered care. Our mission is "any care, any where".

Fundamentally, our incentives are aligned with America. Every dollar in revenue we make is two dollars taken out of the healthcare system. If we succeed, so does US healthcare.

Role overview

Weâre seeking a hands-on Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) Manager to lead and support a team of specialists in a home health environment. This manager will stay close to daily operations, monitor team performance, and respond quickly to questions and emerging issues to help the team meet its goals. The role focuses on accounts receivable (AR), helping the team move outstanding claims from follow-up to verified resolution.

What Youâll Do

  • Manage and support RCM specialists working across home health revenue cycle workflows.

  • Track attendance and monitor individual and team performance against established KPIs and daily quotas.

  • Review workflow boards throughout the day to spot backlogs, red flags, and specialists at risk of missing their end-of-day quotas.

  • Respond promptly to specialist questions while balancing real-time workflow monitoring and other team needs.

  • Identify process gaps and work with the team to resolve issues affecting daily performance.

  • Apply your home health and Homecare Homebase (HCHB) knowledge to help specialists navigate workflows and resolve operational questions.

Accounts receivable and collections

  • Guide specialists and team leads in prioritizing assigned commercial, Medicare, and Medicare Advantage receivables, including aged balances, payer responses, rejections, denials, and upcoming filing or appeal deadlines.

  • Oversee claim follow-up through resolution: verify claim status and payment, investigate collection barriers and underpayments, and guide appropriate corrections, reprocessing, reconsiderations, or appeals under payer-specific requirements.

  • Review and respond to escalations when a specialist cannot determine the next action; surface recurring payer, workflow, or system issues to leadership and coordinate their resolution.

  • Ensure claim activity, supporting evidence, next actions, and follow-up dates are documented accurately in the applicable AR workflow and HCHB.

  • Partner with billing, payment posting, prior authorization, clinical, and other teams to resolve discrepancies, obtain documentation, and follow paid-but-not-posted claims through resolution.

  • Review proposed write-offs for documented collection efforts and supporting evidence, and route them through the required approval and posting process.

Quality and team development

  • Review claim work for accurate denial interpretation, appropriate action, complete documentation, timely follow-up, and correct escalation; use findings to coach specialists and strengthen performance.

  • Support onboarding, payer and system cross-training, and regular knowledge sharing. Identify patterns behind collection challenges and update SOPs or workflows to prevent repeat issues.

  • Share frontline feedback on AR dashboards and automation with relevant teams to improve prioritization, visibility, and specialist workflows.

Basic Qualifications

  • Strong experience in home health revenue cycle operations.

  • Familiarity with Homecare Homebase (HCHB).

  • Experience managing RCM specialists, including tracking attendance and performance KPIs.

  • Experience monitoring workflows throughout the day and identifying risks to daily productivity targets.

  • Experience identifying collection challenges and implementing processes to resolve.

  • Working knowledge of AR follow-up, denial investigation, appeals or reprocessing, and payer-specific filing requirements.

  • Experience reviewing claim documentation and quality, escalating unresolved issues, and coordinating with billing or posting teams.

  • Ability to respond promptly to team questions while managing multiple priorities.

  • Ability to identify workflow or process gaps and help the team address them.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience managing distributed or offshore revenue cycle teams.

  • Familiarity with commercial fee-for-service and Medicare or Medicare Advantage home health claims, including episodic/PDGM workflows.

  • Experience with AR dashboards, clearinghouses, and payer portals such as Waystar and Availity.

  • Experience using denial trends, quality reviews, or operational data to improve collections workflows and team training.

What We Offer

  • Opportunity for growth in a fast-growing company

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description:
About us

At Pencil, we are driving innovation in advertising technology through our state-of-the-art SaaS product, which harnesses Agentic AI to redefine content creation. Our mission is to make AI the default in advertising without replacing creative people. To achieve this, we need to make sure that our technology isn't just in the hands of big brands - we need to try to help small businesses and creative individuals too.

The role

Workflows are how most of the creative on Pencil gets made. A workflow is a visual sequence of steps, covering inputs, generation, brand assets, scoring, branching logic and delivery, that a person builds once and runs again whenever the job repeats, on demand or on a schedule. This role owns that product and the connections that feed it, with one goal: more workflows built and run, by more people, across every customer.

You will own Workflows and Integrations. That covers the workflow builder, templates, scheduling and run management, and the steps that workflows are built from. It also covers the platform's third-party connections outside media: digital asset management systems, file storage such as Google Drive, translation services, data services such as Foreplay, and more than a hundred other business tools. You will make those connections part of the workflow itself, so that a run can start from a client's systems and deliver back into them. You will build them on a common framework, so that each new connection is quicker to ship than the last and client teams can build on it for individual clients.

You will also own how workflows show up inside Scribble, our creative agent. Agents can already run as steps inside a workflow. The next step is for Scribble to find, build, change and run workflows on a person's behalf and report back as they run, and for a workflow to pause for a person's decision and act on it. You will work closely with the team that builds Scribble, and you will own the workflow experience it works through, so that a workflow behaves the same whether a person or an agent is driving it. When that works, building a workflow stops being a specialist job.

Key responsibilities

  • Own the charter for Workflows and Integrations: the durable problem, success metrics, and an explicit in and out scope list.

  • Grow adoption across every customer, measured by the number of workflows built and run and the number of people building them.

  • Make building a workflow simple enough for a marketer or creative to do without help, through templates, guided set-up and defaults that cover the common jobs.

  • Own the workflow experience that Scribble works through, so that an agent can find, build, change and run a workflow with the same tools a person uses.

  • Make human review part of the run: a workflow should pause for a person's decision, record it, and continue down the right path.

  • Make runs dependable at volume, with scheduling, run management, failure handling and clear status, so that a team trusts a workflow to run unattended.

  • Own third-party integrations outside media, from digital asset management and file storage to translation and data services, and make them built-in steps in a workflow, so that a run can start from a client's systems and deliver back into them.

  • Set the integration framework and standards that client teams build on when they connect a system for a single client.

  • Work with customers to find the jobs they repeat every week and turn them into workflows and templates that others can reuse.

  • Run the full lifecycle from discovery to post-launch review, with a written hypothesis before every ship and a review against it afterwards.

  • Use product data and structured customer feedback to set priorities, working backwards from evidenced customer need.

  • Partner closely with design on the builder experience, and with engineering on run reliability and the integration framework. Partner with the PMs who own Scribble, agents and the editor, and with the client teams who build on your framework.

Your background

You will have three to five years of product management experience, and you want to own a key product and take it to the next level. You might be a great fit if you can walk us through:

  • A product you grew from a small group of power users to broad adoption, and what you changed to get there.

  • Shipping a builder, automation or workflow tool, and what you learned about making something powerful easy to start with.

  • Building integrations with third-party platforms or APIs: how you chose which to build, and how you kept them working.

  • A time you built from validated customer need in a domain you had to go and learn. If your instinct is to start with a demo, this is not the role.

  • A decision you changed because the data told you to. Fluent in qual and quant.

  • Experience with AI agents or AI-assisted products is a plus.

You'll Thrive Here If Youâ¦

  • Move Fast. You're comfortable making decisions with imperfect information, iterating quickly, and fixing things before they become fires;

  • Stay Human. You care deeply about users and teammates, and design with empathy for real workflows;

  • Act Like an Owner. You take responsibility for outcomes, not just outputs. You spot problems early and take initiative to fix them.

  • Keep It Simple. You fight unnecessary complexity, design reusable patterns, and make hard things feel intuitive.

  • Love to Surprise. You enjoy finding unexpected ways to delight users, especially in the last mile of polish and usability.

KPIs & Success Measures

We will measure success through outcomes and quality, not just output:

  • Builder share (lead): percentage of monthly active users who build or edit a workflow. Target [TBD]%.

  • Workflow adoption (lead): percentage of monthly active users who run a workflow. Target [TBD]%.

  • Workflow run growth: month-on-month percentage growth in workflow runs. Target [TBD]%.

  • First workflow conversion: percentage of new users who complete a successful run within their first [TBD] days.

  • Share of generations through workflows: percentage of all generations produced by workflow runs.

  • Agent and human collaboration: percentage of workflow runs built or started by Scribble.

  • Connector adoption: percentage of active workspaces that use at least one third-party connection in a workflow each month. Target [TBD]%.

  • Integration usage: percentage of workflow runs that start from, or deliver to, a third-party connection. Target [TBD]%.

  • Reliability (hygiene bar): percentage of runs that complete without manual intervention, held at or above [TBD]%.

  • Learning velocity (supporting): percentage of launches reviewed after release against their stated hypothesis. Target 100%.

Benefits

  • 25 days PTO plus public holidays, although we operate a Flexible Time Off scheme

  • Health insurance / private medical cover

  • Monthly stipend towards wellness, fitness, and learning and development

  • Remote - work from anywhere in your home country

  • Enhanced parental leave policies, whether you become a parent through birth, adoption or surrogacy

  • Access to our Pencil office in The Shard, London for our UK employees

  • Flexible working hours

Deep Dive About Pencil

Pencil uses AI to make ads. Our mission is to make marketing effective and effortless. We want to become the default way ads get made - because AI ads are 10x faster and cheaper to make, and 2x better performing, than making them without AI.

We're called Pencil because we believe AI will be a tool for creative people, not a replacement - it may even be as fundamental a tool in the future as the pencil was in the past.

Pencil was founded in 2018 with a team from Google, Facebook and Uber with backing from Sequoia and Entrepreneur First. We were acquired by The Brandtech Group in 2023 to pursue a shared vision of bringing GenAI to the Fortune 500.

About The Brandtech Group

The Brandtech Group's mission is to be the best company in the world at helping leading global brands drive growth by connecting content, data and media using technology.

It was founded in June 2015 (as You & Mr Jones) by former Havas Global CEO David Jones, with a simple mission to help brands do their marketing better, faster and cheaper using technology. It was renamed The Brandtech Group in January 2022.

Today it generates more than $1BN in revenue and is the largest global digital content partner for many of the world's biggest brands and companies, often using its unique in-housing model. It works with eight of the world's top 10 global advertisers and 49 of the world's top 100. Clients include Banco ItaÃº, Danone, Google, Intuit, LVMH, Microsoft, Morgan-Stanley, Netflix, Reckitt, Renault-Nissan, PayPal, TikTok, Uber and Unilever.

jobs.description:
RainFocus, one of the most innovative software companies, is in search of an exceptional Jr. UI Developer.

 

About RainFocus

RainFocus cares about its employees, customers, and the world in which we live. Our rapidly growing team serves Fortune 500 companies like Adobe, Cisco, IBM, Oracle, VMware, and others to prepare and execute in-person, virtual, and hybrid events, across the world. Those events are delivered through our industry-disrupting software platform, with groundbreaking business intelligence, to elevate the attendee experience, streamline event operations, and accelerate marketing results. We are well-funded, growing fast, and building a company that is changing the market â it will be challenging, fun and exciting. 

 

About the Role

As a Jr. UI Developer, you will be an essential part of our team, assisting in the implementation of stunning, user-friendly web applications. Working alongside experienced developers, you will use HTML, CSS, and modern JavaScript to help translate designs into high-quality web experiences for our events and platforms. This position is ideal for an early-career developer who is passionate about visually-focused development, eager to learn best practices in CSS and JavaScript, and excited to collaborate within a supportive team environment. You will gain hands-on experience with branding, workflows, and enterprise-grade software development.

\n


How you will contribute:

  • Assist in developing, updating, and maintaining UI components and branding with a strong focus on design and responsiveness.

  • Collaborate closely with senior developers, designers, and Product Management to learn processes and deliver quality work.

  • Write clean, maintainable HTML, CSS (using SASS and utility classes), and basic JavaScript (including exposure to React and Svelte).

  • Help troubleshoot, debug, and fix styling issues or UI-related bugs across different browsers and devices.

  • Participate in code reviews to receive feedback, learn RainFocus coding standards, and improve your skills.

  • Support the team in configuring client white-labeling, templates, and basic event workflows.


Required Experience/ Skills:

  • 1â2 years of professional web development experience, or equivalent experience through bootcamps, internships, or robust portfolio projects.

  • Solid fundamental knowledge of HTML, CSS, and CSS preprocessors like SASS.

  • Basic understanding of vanilla JavaScript and an eagerness to learn modern frameworks like React and Svelte.

  • Understanding of responsive design principles and cross-browser compatibility.

  • Familiarity with version control systems, such as Git.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

  • A proactive mindset, self-motivated to ask questions, learn, and grow as a developer.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Works well in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

  • Exposure to design tools such as Figma, Adobe XD, or Photoshop.

  • Basic awareness of web accessibility (WCAG) standards.

  • Familiarity with Agile software development methodologies.

  • General understanding of how APIs or backend systems (like Java) interact with front-end code.


\n

Why work at RainFocus?

At RainFocus we delight millions of attendees at large-scale events by delivering better insights, experiences, and marketing. We were able to pivot our product and services offering in 2020 to continue growing and serving new clients and events.

 

As a member of the RainFocus team, you will have the opportunity to experience first-hand the impact of our platform at events around the world. Additionally, RainFocus offers competitive salaries, competitive benefits, 401k, generous PTO, and countless other team building activities. 

 

What are you waiting for? Apply today! We need more talented, hard-working, fun-loving team members just like yourself!

jobs.title: Tier III Service Desk Engineer
jobs.description:
Unió Digital is an Arizona-based managed service provider (MSP) delivering Managed IT Services, Low Voltage Cabling, Access Control, Video Surveillance, and Intrusion Services. We believe technology should be intuitive, not intimidating.

 

We are looking for an experienced Tier 3 Service Desk Technician with exceptional problem-solving skills. You will serve as the escalation point within the team, resolving complex technical issues while also leading client onboarding and project initiatives. You are expected to be involved in direct end-user support when required. If you have a passion for ensuring top-quality user support and thrive in a collaborative environment, this role is for you.

 

Duties

 

·       Lead and support our helpdesk environment for managed service clients

 

·       Coordinate and manage client projects, acting as a bridge between the technical team and the client to ensure project success

 

·       Provide above and beyond support to our clients and respond to queries for technical assistance in person, via phone, or electronically as required

 

·       Provide training and support to clients during the onboarding process to ensure they understand how to effectively use their new IT systems and services.

 

·       Develop project plans for client onboarding and standardization projects, outlining tasks, resources required, and estimated timelines

 

·       Install, configure, diagnose, test and resolve technical hardware and software issues

 

·       Maintain and update written client and process documentation to ensure effective knowledge management

 

·       Provide mentorship and guidance to Tier I and Tier II service desk technicians, fostering a collaborative and knowledgeable team environment

 

·       Contribute to the development and improvement of IT service management processes and practices

 

·       Evaluate and anticipate IT trends and recommend strategies and implement improvement initiatives

 

Our Technology Stack

 

·       Helpdesk / Ticketing – HaloPSA

 

·       Documentation – Hudu

 

·       RMM – Intune / Immybot

 

·       Networking – Meraki

 

·       Email/Calendar/Voice/AD – Microsoft 365

 

·       Security Cameras – Rhombus / Avigilon

 

·       Door Access – Avigilon

 

Qualification

 

·       6+ years of experience providing IT services and end-user support

 

·       Prior experience at a managed service provider is critical to understand the fast-paced nature of the industry

 

·       Client-oriented approach with a passion for delivering high-quality customer service

 

·       Proven experience leading IT projects

 

·       A self-starter who is eager to expand their qualifications

 

·       Background in providing direct end-user support

 

·       High level of attention to detail

 

·       Excellent verbal and written communication skills

 

·       IT-related degree and/or certifications (Cisco, A+, Network+, Microsoft, or equivalent)

 

·       Advanced technical knowledge, including experience with Azure AD, Active Directory, Intune, or other RMM agents

 

Our Core Values

 

Dream Big, Then Make it Real

 

We flex our imagination and challenge ourselves to a higher standard.  Do, rather than talk and tell.

 

Client Driven Results

 

Clients trust us to find solutions that deliver exceptional results.  When they succeed, we succeed.

 

Own Your Progress

 

We continuously improve through rapid innovation and embracing our mistakes.  Own it means a relentless pursuit of the solution.

 

We Do It Right…even when no one’s watching. Period.

jobs.title: Senior Strategic Finance Manager (Corporate Finance)
AI Developer
jobs.description:
Salvo Software is a global technology company specializing in custom software development and advanced engineering solutions. With distributed teams across the US, LATAM, and India, we partner with clients to build high-performance, scalable systems that solve complex technical challenges. Our culture values innovation, ownership, and engineering excellence. We're growing our AI department and are looking for a hands-on AI Developer to help build it.

Role Overview

We are looking for an AI Developer to join and strengthen our AI department. Your core work will be building and operating LLM-powered systems: serving open-source models with Ollama and llama.cpp, building RAG pipelines, and developing MCP integrations that connect large language models to real tools and data. Solid DevOps fundamentals - Docker, CI/CD, Azure - support this work, but AI engineering is the heart of the role.

You don't need to be a deep ML researcher. What matters is production-grade Python, strong fundamentals, and the aptitude to learn fast. You'll work closely with our engineering and product teams to take LLM-powered features from prototype to reliably deployed systems, with mentorship available as you ramp up in areas like RAG architecture, Kafka, and advanced MCP work.

Key Responsibilities

AI / LLM Engineering (core focus)

  • Serve and operate open-source LLMs using Ollama and llama.cpp, locally and in on-prem environments.
  • Build and maintain RAG pipelines: embeddings, vector databases, chunking strategies, and retrieval quality.
  • Develop MCP (Model Context Protocol) integrations connecting LLMs to internal tools and data sources.
  • Build backend services in Python that power ML inference and AI-driven product features.
  • Parse and process structured and semi-structured data (XML/XSD, Office document formats) as pipeline inputs.
  • Grow into model optimization over time: quantization (GGUF), GPU/CUDA tuning, and offline/air-gapped deployments.

DevOps & Infrastructure (supporting)

  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for AI services (Azure DevOps preferred; GitHub Actions / GitLab CI also used).
  • Deploy AI workloads to Microsoft Azure,AWS and containerize services with Docker.
  • Automate operational tasks with Python, Bash and/or PowerShell scripting.
  • Troubleshoot across the stack - dig into root causes rather than patching symptoms.
  • Support event-driven architectures using Apache Kafka (producers/consumers).
  • 3â5+ years engineering experience with production-level Python for building real services, LLM inference, RAG pipelines, and automated tooling.
  • Hands-on LLM & AI integration serving models via Ollama/llama.cpp, implementing vector retrieval/RAG, and developing MCP integrations (GPU/CUDA tuning & model quantization nice to have).
  • Cloud & Infrastructure expertise covering Azure/AWS deployments, Docker containerization, Linux/Windows admin, and CI/CD automation (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI), with Terraform, Kubernetes, Kafka, or systems languages (Go, Rust, C++) as a plus.
  • DevOps, Security & Operations awareness, including Git workflows, scripting (Python, Bash, PowerShell), observability tools (Prometheus/Grafana), DevSecOps, and compliance frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, Zero Trust).
  • Strong problem-solving & communication with a root-cause troubleshooting mindset, self-directed learning, strong ownership, and seamless remote/distributed team collaboration.

Customer Success LATAM
Senior Field Marketer
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion has a very successful "land and expand" business model; our customers start using Notion for free, upgrade over time as they expand their teams, and embrace increasingly sophisticated use cases. Often, these users and champions are different than the person who has enterprise purchasing authority.



The Demand Generation team serves as a dot-connecter across sales, marketing, and operation teams to identify, engage, and convert decision makers at our target mid market and enterprise companies.



In this role, you will partner with demand generation teammates and sales stakeholders to ideate and execute in-person events, designed to help open, accelerate, and close business.



As a Field Marketing Manager, you will own and execute field events that are Notion-hosted, third party, co-partnered, and ancillary to third party events. This strategic position focuses on driving pipeline that meaningfully contribute to Notion's bottom line.

 

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Delight Notion customers and prospects, with a guest-first approach to creating field events and experiences that bring the Notion brand and product to life.

 - Own end-to-end planning, execution, and measurement of field programs to support our AMER Sales team - encompassing executive experiences, large-format educational events, trade shows, and co-sponsored activations with partners.

 - Manage all event logistics, production, venue sourcing, budget tracking, marketing campaigns, sales enablement, content development, and audience acquisition.

 - Leverage quantitative and qualitative insights to make recommendations on how we invest in field events to drive incremental business impact.

 - Partner closely with Sales and broader Marketing team to align events and audiences to objectives for top accounts and craft tailored programs that nurture those accounts

 - Partner with our Operation and BizTech teams to manage and better utilize our go-to-market systems




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 8-12+ years of related marketing experience.

 - You don’t need to be an AI expert, but you’re curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results.

 - You're a creative problem-solver who doesn't wait for a perfect playbook. You've built field events from scratch, and you're energized by figuring out what works in new territory.

 - You have a bias for action and experimentation. You'd rather test and learn than wait for consensus, and you know how to balance scrappiness with strategic thinking.

 - You're a strong cross-functional collaborator. You know how to work with sales, ops, and creative teams — and you can align people around a shared goal without needing authority to do it.

 - You're pipeline-obsessed. You understand how your programs connect to revenue and can speak credibly about pipeline contribution, not just top-of-funnel metrics.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience in a fast-paced, B2B tech environment

 - You're a Notion user and understand our value to businesses

 - Salesforce, Marketo experience



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $175,000-$200,000 per year.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550?pvs=74 and NYLL 144 https://notion.notion.site/Ashby-AI-Bias-Audit-2b0efdeead05803bbbfae159ec86c528.



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: Account Executive, Growth (EMEA)
jobs.description:
At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires.

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 50,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.

Over the past few years, Linear has experienced incredible organic growth and has become the default tool of choice for many of the world’s best product teams. We are now layering a product-led sales motion on top of our existing self-serve business to further accelerate our ambitions and bring the magic of Linear to even more and larger companies. As an Account Executive at Linear, you’ll contribute to the future of our product and help high-impact companies build better software.

Location & work mode

While Linear is a remote-first company across the US and Europe, this role is specifically based in London. We’re looking for someone who can work from our London office in Shoreditch 3 days per week (Mondays, Tuesdays, Thursdays), as this role will be closely connected to in-person collaboration with our growing sales presence in the region. 

What you'll do

 - Become a product expert and help customers use Linear effectively; assist prospects through the trial and evaluation phase

 - Generate a strong pipeline and exceed quarterly and annual targets

 - Build relationships with key stakeholders within accounts

 - Stay up to date with our product offering, industry trends, competitive landscape, and market trends to continuously adapt sales strategies and approaches for maximum impact

 - Be the voice of the customer; advocate for customers by surfacing product or adoption blockers to our product team

What we're looking for

 - 5+ years in a quota-carrying sales role

 - Experience selling to a technical audience; bonus if you have previous experience working with a collaboration or developer tool

 - SaaS and startup experience; comfortable working and adapting in a fast-paced and flexible environment

 - Strong written and verbal communication, presentation, and product demonstration skills

 - Highly autonomous with a bias for action. Owner’s mindset to quickly come up to speed on product, market, ICP, and unique differentiators

What we offer

We're a small, focused team that cares deeply about the quality of our work and the people we do it with. Here's what you can expect:

 - Competitive salary and equity

 - Employee-friendly equity terms 

 - Daily meal and coffee stipend on every workday

 - Health coverage (based on country requirements)

 - 5 weeks paid vacation, plus local statutory holidays

 - 4 months paid parental leave

 - Paid month off after 4 years & every 2 years thereafter

 - Regular team events and off-sites

jobs.title: US Remote Patient Care Advocate (Customer Service)
jobs.description:
Job Title: Patient Care Advocate 

Job Location: Remote


About Us: 

We are a dedicated team focused on improving access to affordable prescription medications for patients. By partnering with insurance companies, healthcare providers, and pharmacies, we work to reduce the financial burden of medications, ensuring that patients can access the treatments they need without excessive costs. 


Role Overview: 

As a key member of our team, you will help patients navigate our Prescription Payment Plan. This involves working closely with patients, insurance providers, healthcare professionals, and pharmacies to ensure seamless enrollment, eligibility verification, cost-sharing, and prescription fulfillment. 


What You’ll Do: 

  • Patient Enrollment & Eligibility: Assist patients with enrolling in the program, ensuring all necessary personal and insurance information is provided and verifying eligibility. 
  • Prescription Coverage: Help patients confirm that their prescribed medications are covered under the program, and manage the approval process for eligible medications. 
  • Cost-Sharing & Payment: Reduce patients' out-of-pocket costs by applying the program benefits. Manage copayments, coinsurance, and assist with additional copay assistance when applicable. 
  • Prescription Fulfillment: Coordinate with participating pharmacies to ensure the correct application of benefits during prescription filling, ensuring patients pay the reduced amount. 
  • Refills & Continued Use: Support patients by ensuring they continue receiving medications at reduced costs, monitoring adherence to medication regimens, and ensuring continued eligibility. 
  • Program Renewal & Updates: Guide patients through annual renewals and inform them about any updates to the program or medication formulary. 


What We’re Looking For: 

  • High school diploma or GED required
  • Experience in healthcare, insurance or customer service required (experience with prescription assistance programs is a plus)
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to navigate complex processes
  • Excellent communication skills for working with patients, healthcare providers, and pharmacies
  • A genuine passion for helping others and making a positive impact on their healthcare access
  • The ability to work efficiently and collaboratively within a team environment

Success Factors for Working from Home 

  • Private Workspace: A dedicated, quiet workspace with a door that closes, free from ambient noise. 
  • Ergonomics: A comfortable desk and chair setup that allows for the proper installation of necessary equipment. 
  • Reliable Internet Connection: Stable, high-speed internet with a minimum bandwidth of 10 Mbps downstream and 5 Mbps upstream. 
  • Quiet, Distraction-Free Workspace: A dedicated, quiet area where you can focus on delivering excellent customer service without interruptions. 
  • Tech-Savvy: Comfort with technology and ability to learn new systems quickly. 
  • Self-motivation & Independence: Ability to stay productive and manage your time effectively in a remote environment. 
  • Communication Skills: Strong verbal and written communication skills, especially in a virtual setting. 
  • Adaptability: Ability to adapt to changing technologies and procedures while working remotely. 


Compensation & Perks 

  • Hourly Pay: $16.50 per hour 
  • Company-Provided Equipment: All necessary equipment will be provided. 
  • Comprehensive Benefits: Full health insurance package including medical, dental, and vision coverage. 
  • Cell Phone Benefits: $25/month per line for unlimited phone, text, and data (restrictions may apply). 
  • Generous Referral Program: Earn $50 per paycheck for every person you refer—and your referral earns it too! No limits on payouts. 
  • Comprehensive Training: Paid training to ensure you are fully prepared for success. 
  • Career Growth: Opportunities for career advancement and professional development within a leading healthcare provider. 
  • Work-from-Home Convenience: Save time, and money, and reduce your environmental footprint. 
  • Inclusive Culture: We are an Equal Opportunity Employer, including individuals with disabilities and veterans. 

What Success Looks Like: 

  • Reduced out-of-pocket costs for patients through effective cost-sharing and copay assistance 
  • Timely and accurate processing of prescription claims and approvals 
  • High patient satisfaction with the program’s support and streamlined experience 
  • Compliance with program requirements and monitoring of patient eligibility for ongoing assistance 

Why Join Us? 

  • Be part of a team that makes a real difference in patients' lives by reducing the cost of necessary medications 
  • Opportunity for professional growth in the healthcare and insurance sectors 
  • Competitive compensation and benefits package 
  • A collaborative, supportive, and innovative work culture 

Ready to Make an Impact? 

Join us in making prescription medications more affordable and accessible for those who need them most. If you're ready to help make a difference, we'd love to hear from you! 

If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!

Caringhand Home Health Solutions, Inc. is committed to providing professional nursing and healthcare services that help patients achieve the highest possible level of independence in their daily activities. We strive to deliver high-quality home health care through comprehensive patient assessments, individualized care planning, and collaboration among healthcare professionals, patients, and families.

We are seeking a compassionate and dedicated Registered Nurse (RN) to provide skilled nursing care to patients in their homes and communities. jobs.title: Agile Program Manager
jobs.description:
We're looking for an experienced Agile Program Manager to lead delivery across multiple cross-functional teams working toward a shared set of business outcomes. You'll sit at the intersection of strategy and execution: translating roadmap priorities into coordinated, predictable delivery, keeping dependencies visible, and making sure the right people are making the right decisions at the right time.

This is a hands-on program role, not a status-reporting one. You'll own the cadence, the plan, and the risks across several Agile teams, and you'll be the person stakeholders trust to tell them where things really stand.

What You'll Do

  • Lead end-to-end delivery of a multi-team program, coordinating three or more Agile teams (Scrum, Kanban, or hybrid) toward shared quarterly objectives.
  • Run program-level planning, including quarterly/PI planning, roadmap alignment, capacity planning, and release planning.
  • Identify, map, and actively manage cross-team dependencies, risks, and blockers, escalating early and with clear options.
  • Facilitate program ceremonies such as Scrum of Scrums, program syncs, system demos, and retrospectives, and make sure they produce decisions, not just updates.
  • Partner with Product Owners and Product Managers to keep backlogs prioritized, refined, and aligned to business value.
  • Build and maintain program-level reporting: delivery health, burn-up/velocity trends, OKR or objective progress, and RAID logs, tailored for both team-level and executive audiences.
  • Drive continuous improvement in delivery practices, tooling, and team workflows, coaching teams and leaders on Agile principles where needed.
  • Manage stakeholder communication across engineering, product, design, business, and leadership, keeping expectations aligned as scope and priorities shift.
  • Track program budget, resourcing, and vendor or third-party deliverables where applicable.

What You Bring

  • 8+ years of experience in program or project management, with at least 5 years leading delivery in Agile environments.
  • Proven track record managing multi-team programs (not just single-team Scrum) from planning through release.
  • Deep, practical knowledge of Scrum and Kanban, plus experience with at least one scaling framework (SAFe, LeSS, Scrum@Scale, or similar).
  • Strong command of Agile tooling such as Jira, Jira Align, Azure DevOps, Rally, or equivalent, including building dashboards and program-level reporting.
  • Excellent facilitation skills: you can run a 50-person planning event as comfortably as a tense 1:1 escalation.
  • Clear, concise written and verbal communication in English, with the ability to tailor the message for engineers and executives alike.
  • Experience working with distributed or remote teams across time zones.
  • Comfort operating with ambiguity: you can stand up structure where there is none and adapt it as the program evolves.

Nice to Have

  • Agile or program management certifications such as SAFe RTE, SAFe SPC, PMI-ACP, PgMP, PMP, CSM/CSP, or ICAgile.
  • Experience with Agile transformations or introducing scaled frameworks into an organization.
  • Background in software, SaaS, data, or digital product delivery.
  • Familiarity with OKRs and value-stream or portfolio management.
  • Experience in regulated industries (financial services, healthcare, insurance, public sector) where Agile delivery coexists with compliance requirements.
  • Budget and vendor management experience on programs with multiple delivery partners.

You'll lead the technical direction of the platform, building multi-agent orchestration systems, self-improving agent harnesses, and AI-powered backend services. This is a highly technical leadership role that combines architectural decision-making with hands-on engineering.

  • Hands-on experience building and shipping multi-agent systems and orchestration frameworks to production.

  • Experience developing self-improving or self-evolving agent harnesses.

  • Strong backend engineering skills, including designing and maintaining APIs, services, and data flows.

  • Experience working with LLM-based systems, including prompt engineering, model configuration, structured outputs, embeddings, retrieval, and evaluation.
